```tsx
import { CaseDecidedParams, STANDING_DRAFTS, STANDING_RULES, type CaseDecision, type CaseView, type StaffMe } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { REDRESS_TEXTS, STATEMENT_WORDS, statementParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { ReactElement } from "react";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { AT_ONCE_DAYS, atOnceGroundOf, atOnceState, correctionChoices, correctionDraft, decisionParamsOf, newDraft, offeredDraft, previewOf, withAtOnce, type CaseDraft } from "../src/compose";
import { STANDING_WORDS } from "../src/messages";
import { parseCaseId } from "../src/router";
import { ComposerView, type ComposerViewProps } from "../src/screens/Composer";
import { atOnceCase, decision, NO_STANDING } from "./case-fixtures";

/**
 * The console's part of a suspension taken at once (3e design, sections 8.3, 8.7 and 10.3; Task 3): "Suspend at once" on
 * an account case's final restriction, offered to an admin on the ground of the chosen rule when the case answer says the
 * database would accept it, and greyed with its sentence otherwise; the four grounds marked; the drafted facts; the
 * params and the preview; the lift in a correction, and [review.basis] and [review.protective]. Pure parts are tested as
 * functions, screens server-rendered.
 */
const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
const esc = (text: string): string => text.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/'/g, "&#x27;");
const noop = () => undefined;
const caseId = (id: string) => parseCaseId(id)!;
const NOW = new Date("2026-10-12T09:30:00.000Z");
const ADMIN: StaffMe["role"] = "admin";
const MODERATOR: StaffMe["role"] = "moderator";
const HEX = "cd".repeat(32);
const DIGESTS = { snapshot: HEX, facts: "aa".repeat(32), reason: "bb".repeat(32), legalReference: null };
const SUSPENSION = "2d3e4f5a-6b7c-4d8e-9f0a-1b2c3d4e5f6a";
const SUSPEND_ACTION = "3e4f5a6b-7c8d-4e9f-8a1b-2c3d4e5f6a7b";

const final = (view: CaseView, role: StaffMe["role"], change: Partial<CaseDraft> = {}): CaseDraft => ({ ...newDraft(caseId(view.id), view, role), kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", ...change });

function composer(view: CaseView, role: StaffMe["role"], draft: CaseDraft) {
  const props: ComposerViewProps = { view, role, draft, now: NOW, busy: false, error: null, textErrors: {}, declining: null, onChange: noop, onTextBlur: noop, onSeal: noop, onConfirm: noop, onDeclineOpen: noop, onDeclineChange: noop, onDeclineSave: noop, onDeclineClose: noop, onCancelCorrection: noop };
  return html(<ComposerView {...props} />);
}

describe("3e: a suspension at once in the composer of an account case (design, section 8.3)", () => {
  test("the words are the design's, each number printed from STANDING_RULES", () => {
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.what).toBe(
      "A suspension at once restricts the account when you confirm. Only an admin takes one, and only on a ground the database checks. The statement goes at once; the account may reply and appeal from the first minute, and a reply does not pause it.",
    );
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.threat).toContain(`at most ${STANDING_RULES.basisAgeDays} days old. Up to ${STANDING_RULES.threatDays} days.`);
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.flood(23, "A", "B")).toBe(
      `Spam flood (R6): the account made 23 posts between A and B; the ground needs at least ${STANDING_RULES.floodPosts} in ${STANDING_RULES.floodMinutes} minutes. Up to ${STANDING_RULES.floodDays} days. The count alone is no flood: say in the facts what made the posts repetitive and unsolicited.`,
    );
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.protective("2026-10-01")).toContain(`on 2026-10-01, at most ${STANDING_RULES.basisAgeDays} days ago`);
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.admin).toBe("Only an admin suspends at once. You can withhold the content while deciding; the account measure waits for an admin.");
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.other).toBe("This rule allows no suspension at once: announce it.");
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.noSeal).toContain("A report alone, or a seal taken while deciding, is not enough.");
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.reportsFirst).toBe("Not open: this case holds a report that is not answered yet. Decide the reports in this case first; the measure gets a case of its own.");
    expect(AT_ONCE_DAYS).toEqual({ threat: STANDING_RULES.threatDays, terrorist: STANDING_RULES.terroristDays, flood: STANDING_RULES.floodDays, protective: STANDING_RULES.protectiveDays });
  });

  test("the ground follows the rule or the law, and the control is open to an admin on a ground the database would accept, greyed with its reason otherwise", () => {
    const view = atOnceCase();
    expect(atOnceGroundOf({ ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R5", terrorist: false })).toBe("threat");
    expect(atOnceGroundOf({ ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R6", terrorist: false })).toBe("flood");
    expect(atOnceGroundOf({ ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R2", terrorist: false })).toBe("protective");
    expect(atOnceGroundOf({ ground: "illegal", ruleId: "R1", terrorist: true })).toBe("terrorist");
    expect(atOnceGroundOf({ ground: "illegal", ruleId: "R1", terrorist: false })).toBeNull();
    expect(atOnceGroundOf({ ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R3", terrorist: false })).toBeNull();
    expect(atOnceState(view, ADMIN, final(view, ADMIN))).toEqual({ open: true, ground: "threat" });
    expect(atOnceState(view, MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR))).toMatchObject({ open: false, why: "admin" });
    expect(atOnceState(view, ADMIN, final(view, ADMIN, { ruleId: "R3" }))).toMatchObject({ open: false, why: "other" });
    expect(atOnceState(view, ADMIN, final(view, ADMIN, { ground: "illegal", terrorist: true }))).toMatchObject({ open: false, why: "unmet", ground: "terrorist" });
    expect(atOnceState(atOnceCase({ live: true }), ADMIN, final(view, ADMIN))).toMatchObject({ open: false, why: "conflict" });
    // The protective ground: no seal for good is no seal; a report that waits holds it back even with one.
    const r2 = atOnceCase({}, "R2");
    expect(atOnceState(r2, ADMIN, final(r2, ADMIN, { ruleId: "R2" }))).toMatchObject({ open: false, why: "noSeal" });
    const sealed = atOnceCase({ atOnce: ["protective"], seal: { decidedOn: "2026-10-05" }, basisDecidedAt: { threat: null, terrorist: null, protective: "2026-10-05T10:00:00.000Z" } }, "R2");
    expect(atOnceState(sealed, ADMIN, final(sealed, ADMIN, { ruleId: "R2" }))).toEqual({ open: true, ground: "protective" });
    expect(atOnceState({ ...sealed, standing: { ...sealed.standing!, openReports: true } }, ADMIN, final(sealed, ADMIN, { ruleId: "R2" }))).toMatchObject({ open: false, why: "reportsFirst" });
    // Not shown at all while deciding, on a post case or for an outcome that restricts nothing.
    expect(atOnceState(view, ADMIN, final(view, ADMIN, { kind: "interim" }))).toBeNull();
    expect(atOnceState(view, ADMIN, final(view, ADMIN, { outcome: "no_violation" }))).toBeNull();
  });

  test("an admin's composer lists the four grounds, each marked met or not, and the control with its days; a moderator's is greyed with [atOnce.admin]; the protective ground is greyed with [atOnce.noSeal]", () => {
    const view = atOnceCase();
    const out = composer(view, ADMIN, final(view, ADMIN));
    expect(out).toContain(STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.label);
    expect(out).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.what));
    expect(out).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.threat));
    expect(out).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.terrorist));
    expect(out).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.noSeal));
    expect(out.split(`<strong>${STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.met}</strong>`).length - 1).toBe(2);
    expect(out.split(`<strong>${STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.unmet}</strong>`).length - 1).toBe(2);
    expect(out).not.toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.admin));
    // On a case under R5 a final decision is an admin's anyway; under R6 a moderator decides it and meets [atOnce.admin].
    const r6 = atOnceCase({}, "R6");
    const greyed = composer(r6, MODERATOR, final(r6, MODERATOR, { ruleId: "R6" }));
    expect(greyed).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.admin));
    expect(greyed).toMatch(/<input type="checkbox" disabled=""\/> <span>Suspend at once<\/span>/);
    const r2 = atOnceCase({}, "R2");
    expect(composer(r2, ADMIN, final(r2, ADMIN, { ruleId: "R2" }))).toMatch(/<input type="checkbox" disabled=""\/> <span>Suspend at once/);
  });

  test("choosing it adds the suspension taken at once and the ground's drafted facts; the params sign its days and announced false; the preview is the statement the account will get", () => {
    const view = atOnceCase();
    const draft = withAtOnce(view, final(view, ADMIN, { ruleId: "R6" }), "flood", 5);
    expect(draft.actions).toEqual([{ kind: "suspend", mediaId: null, days: 5, announced: false }]);
    expect(draft.written.facts).toBe("The account made 23 posts between 2026-10-12T08:30:00.000Z and 2026-10-12T09:30:00.000Z.");
    expect(draft.written.reason).toBe("");
    expect(offeredDraft(view, ADMIN, draft).actions).toEqual(draft.actions);
    // A moderator's draft, and more days than the ground allows, lose the suspension.
    expect(offeredDraft(view, MODERATOR, draft).actions).toEqual([]);
    expect(offeredDraft(view, ADMIN, { ...draft, actions: [{ kind: "suspend", mediaId: null, days: STANDING_RULES.floodDays + 1, announced: false }] }).actions).toEqual([]);
    const params = CaseDecidedParams.parse(decisionParamsOf(view, { ...draft, written: { ...draft.written, reason: "The posts repeat one link." } }, DIGESTS));
    expect(params.actions).toEqual([{ kind: "suspend", mediaId: null, days: 5, announced: false }]);
    expect(params).toMatchObject({ kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", ruleId: "R6" });
    const paragraphs = statementParagraphs(previewOf(view, draft, NOW));
    expect(paragraphs[0]).toBe(`${STATEMENT_WORDS.suspendAtOnce(5, "2026-10-17 09:30 UTC")} ${STATEMENT_WORDS.basis.flood}`);
    expect(paragraphs).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.automationFlood);
    expect(paragraphs).toContain(REDRESS_TEXTS[2].replyAtOnce);
    // On a threat the basis sentence names the decision it rests on by the time the case answer gave.
    const threat = statementParagraphs(previewOf(view, withAtOnce(view, final(view, ADMIN), "threat", 7), NOW));
    expect(threat[0]).toBe(`${STATEMENT_WORDS.suspendAtOnce(7, "2026-10-19 09:30 UTC")} ${STATEMENT_WORDS.basis.threat("2026-10-10 08:00 UTC")}`);
    // A protective suspension's drafts: the seal's day, and the fixed reason; its preview never says that a rule is broken.
    const sealed = atOnceCase({ atOnce: ["protective"], seal: { decidedOn: "2026-10-05" }, basisDecidedAt: { threat: null, terrorist: null, protective: "2026-10-05T10:00:00.000Z" } }, "R2");
    const protective = withAtOnce(sealed, final(sealed, ADMIN, { ruleId: "R2" }), "protective", 14);
    expect(protective.written.facts).toBe(STANDING_DRAFTS.facts.protective.replace("{sealedOn}", "2026-10-05"));
    expect(protective.written.reason).toBe(STANDING_DRAFTS.reason.protective);
    expect(statementParagraphs(previewOf(sealed, protective, NOW)).join(" | ")).not.toContain("It breaks");
  });
});

describe("3e: the lift of a suspension at once and what a review says of one (design, section 8.7)", () => {
  /** The final decision that suspended the account at once on a threat, running. */
  function suspended(): CaseDecision {
    return decision({
      id: SUSPENSION,
      kind: "final",
      ruleId: "R5",
      rulesVersion: 3,
      redressVersion: 2,
      needsAdmin: true,
      actions: [
        {
          ...decision().actions[0]!,
          ...NO_STANDING,
          id: SUSPEND_ACTION,
          kind: "suspend",
          inForce: true,
          days: 7,
          announced: false,
          basis: "threat",
          earliestStart: "2026-10-11T09:00:00.000Z",
          period: { startsAt: "2026-10-11T09:00:00.000Z", endsAt: "2026-10-18T09:00:00.000Z", state: "running" },
        },
      ],
    });
  }

  test("an admin's correction offers Lift the suspension; its preview says it ended with the decision; a moderator is offered nothing", () => {
    const view = { ...atOnceCase({ live: true }), decisions: [suspended()] };
    const draft = correctionDraft(caseId(view.id), view, view.decisions[0]!, ADMIN);
    const choices = correctionChoices(view, draft, ADMIN);
    expect(choices.map((choice) => choice.reversal)).toEqual([{ kind: "lift_suspension", mediaId: null }]);
    expect(correctionChoices(view, correctionDraft(caseId(view.id), view, view.decisions[0]!, MODERATOR), MODERATOR)).toEqual([]);
    const lifting = { ...draft, actions: [{ kind: "lift_suspension" as const, mediaId: null }], written: { ...draft.written, review_reason: "The threat was a quote." } };
    expect(statementParagraphs(previewOf(view, lifting, NOW))).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.liftedRunning("suspension"));
    expect(CaseDecidedParams.parse(decisionParamsOf(view, lifting, DIGESTS))).toMatchObject({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", actions: [{ kind: "lift_suspension", mediaId: null }] });
  });

  test("[review.basis] beside a correction of a decision that a suspension at once rests on, [review.protective] beside one of a protective suspension", () => {
    const basis = decision({ id: SUSPENSION, kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", standingOn: [{ kind: "suspend", basis: "threat" }] });
    const view = { ...atOnceCase(), decisions: [basis] };
    const out = composer(view, ADMIN, correctionDraft(caseId(view.id), view, basis, ADMIN));
    expect(out).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reviewBasis));
    expect(out).not.toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reviewProtective));
    const protective = suspended();
    protective.actions[0] = { ...protective.actions[0]!, basis: "protective" };
    const sealedView = { ...atOnceCase({ live: true }), decisions: [protective] };
    const correction = composer(sealedView, ADMIN, correctionDraft(caseId(sealedView.id), sealedView, protective, ADMIN));
    expect(correction).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reviewProtective));
    expect(correction).not.toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reviewBasis));
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/standing-at-once.test.ts`

```ts
import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ACCOUNT_MEASURE_SCOPE, FlowResponse, MeResponse, STANDING_RULES, itemOutcomeWords } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { STATEMENT_WORDS, statementParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import { MemoryKv } from "../../src/auth/kv";
import { randomToken } from "../../src/auth/crypto";
import { GRANT_ROLE_WORDS, runGrantRole } from "../../src/cli/grant-role";
import { MemoryMailer } from "../../src/mail/memory";
import { ModerationError } from "../../src/moderation";
import { updateLine } from "../../src/moderation/dispatch";
import { itemStatus } from "../../src/moderation/intake";
import { noticeItems, pendingOutcomeLines } from "../../src/moderation/repo";
import { decisionStatement } from "../../src/moderation/statement";
import { Browser } from "./http-client";
import { deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import { aPost, act, actionsOf, ageStandingForTest, anAccount, ground, imagePost, intake, newPostRow, report, timed, untilBlocked, type DecisionInput } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { HUMAN, noticesWorld, type NoticesWorld } from "./notices-harness";

// Every test commits decisions confirmed with a real staff key, each a round of the step-up flow: slow on a loaded machine.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 240_000 });

/**
 * Suspensions taken at once, through the decide route's own code (3e design, sections 7.7, 7.11, 7.12, 7.15 and 7.16; section
 * 12.1, invariants 9 but `terminate`, 13 and 20): each of the four grounds of the closed list accepted on its facts and
 * refused without them, by an admin only; the route's second check, which refuses an announced suspension and every
 * termination before the transaction; the lift and a basis that breaks, with their statements and mails; /api/me's
 * standing, read fresh; grant-role's refusal, against a deciding transaction in both orders; and the line a reporter
 * reads. The accounts are auth accounts with profiles, so the statement mails reach their addresses through the auth
 * module; every decision is confirmed by a staff key on the software authenticator and recorded by moderation.forStaff.
 * What the file commits is removed at the end, and its last test holds the tables to that.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: suspensions at once", () => {
  let n: NoticesWorld;
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let second: RealStaff;
  let moderator: RealStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    n = noticesWorld();
    // The deciding module mails through the notices world's auth module, so the statements reach the scripted mailer.
    world = deciderWorld(n.apiDb, { auth: n.authForModeration });
    admin = await world.staff("admin");
    second = await world.staff("admin");
    moderator = await world.staff("moderator");
    before = await n.counts();
  }, 240_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    try {
      await n.cleanUp();
      await world.close();
    } finally {
      await n.close();
    }
  }, 240_000);

  /** A post of the account made now, in a statement of its own, so that it is later than every decision before it. */
  const postOf = (accountId: string) => newPostRow(n.apiDb, accountId, { createdAt: sql`clock_timestamp()`, body: "a post" });
  /** A confirmed decision through the route's code: its id, or a failure that says why none was recorded. */
  async function decided(member: RealStaff, caseId: string, input: DecisionInput): Promise<string> {
    const outcome = await world.decideAs(member, caseId, input);
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the decision was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
    return outcome.decisionId;
  }
  /** What a decision through the route was refused with: its code and the trigger's detail (null for the route's own refusal). */
  async function refused(member: RealStaff, caseId: string, input: DecisionInput): Promise<{ code: string; detail: string | null } | null> {
    try {
      await world.decideAs(member, caseId, input);
      return null;
    } catch (err) {
      if (!(err instanceof ModerationError)) throw err;
      return { code: err.code, detail: (err as ModerationError & { detail?: string | null }).detail ?? null };
    }
  }
  /** A final removal under R5 of a new post of the account, by an admin's own finding: the basis `threat` rests on. */
  async function threatOn(accountId: string): Promise<{ decisionId: string; caseId: string }> {
    const caseId = (await intake(n.apiDb, ground.finding(admin.id, "R5"), aPost(await postOf(accountId)))).items[0]!.caseId!;
    return { decisionId: await decided(admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: [act("remove")] }), caseId };
  }
  /** An admin's finding on the account under the rule: the account's case, where a measure at once is decided. */
  const accountCase = async (account: { id: string; handle: string }, rule: "R2" | "R5" | "R6") =>
    (await intake(n.apiDb, ground.finding(admin.id, rule), anAccount(account.id, account.handle))).items[0]!.caseId!;
  const atOnce = (days: number) => [timed("suspend", days, false)];
  /** The account's standing as /api/me reads it. */
  const standingOf = (accountId: string) => n.moderation.standingFor(accountId);
  /** The suspension row of a decision. */
  const suspendRow = async (decisionId: string) =>
    (await n.apiDb.execute<{ basis: string; rests_on: string[] | null; days: number; announced: boolean }>(
      sql`select basis, rests_on::text[] as rests_on, days, announced from decision_actions where decision_id = ${decisionId}::uuid and kind = 'suspend'`,
    ))[0]!;

  test("threat: an admin suspends at once on a final R5 decision about a post of the account; the suspension runs from the decision, /api/me says so, and the statement goes as suspension_started_at_once", async () => {
    const account = await n.account();
    const caseId = await accountCase(account, "R5");
    // Without the R5 decision no basis fits.
    expect(await refused(admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: atOnce(3) })).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_decision", detail: expect.stringMatching(/^basis: none fits/) });
    const threat = await threatOn(account.id);
    // A moderator meets admin_required. (The threat's most days are the params' own bound, 30.)
    expect(await refused(moderator, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: atOnce(3) })).toMatchObject({ code: "admin_required" });
    const decisionId = await decided(admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: atOnce(7) });
    expect(await suspendRow(decisionId)).toEqual({ basis: "threat", rests_on: [threat.decisionId], days: 7, announced: false });
    const standing = await standingOf(account.id);
    expect(standing?.measure).toMatchObject({ decisionId, kind: "suspend", days: 7, state: "running", replyOpen: true, appealPending: false });
    expect(Date.parse(standing!.measure!.endsAt!) - Date.parse(standing!.measure!.startsAt!)).toBe(7 * 24 * 60 * 60_000);
    expect(standing!.measure!.appealUntil).not.toBeNull();
    // A second standing measure is refused while this one runs.
    expect(await refused(admin, await accountCase(account, "R5"), { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: atOnce(3) })).toMatchObject({ code: "standing_conflict" });
    // The statement: what was done and why at once, the account's conduct under R5, the reply and the appeal.
    const found = (await decisionStatement(n.apiDb, decisionId))!;
    const measure = found.statement.measures[0]!;
    expect(measure).toMatchObject({ kind: "suspend", announced: false, days: 7, basis: "threat", restsOn: [{ ruleId: "R5", decidedAt: expect.any(String), postCreatedAt: expect.any(String) }] });
    const paragraphs = statementParagraphs(found.statement);
    expect(paragraphs[0]!.startsWith("korbat suspended your account for 7 days, from this decision until")).toBe(true);
    expect(paragraphs.some((paragraph) => paragraph.startsWith("Your account's conduct breaks korbat rule R5"))).toBe(true);
    // The mail, under its own subject and lead, with the statement's paragraphs.
    const [mail] = n.mailer.to(account.email, "suspension_started_at_once");
    expect(mail?.data).toMatchObject({ measure: "suspend", days: "7", statement: paragraphs.join(String.fromCharCode(10)) });
    expect(n.mailer.to(account.email, "moderation_decision").map((m) => m.data.statement)).not.toContain(paragraphs.join(String.fromCharCode(10)));
  });

  test("grant-role refuses to make a suspended account staff, changing nothing; in the other order a promotion that holds the account's row first makes the deciding transaction wait, and it then meets staff_target", async () => {
    const account = await n.account();
    await threatOn(account.id);
    await decided(admin, await accountCase(account, "R5"), { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: atOnce(3) });
    const deps = { authDb: n.authDb, kv: new MemoryKv(), mailer: new MemoryMailer() };
    expect(await runGrantRole(deps, account.email, "moderator")).toBe("standing");
    expect((await n.repo.findUserById(account.id))!.role).toBe("user");
    expect(GRANT_ROLE_WORDS.standing).toBe(
      "This account holds a suspension, a termination or a restriction of reporting that stands and has not ended, so it cannot be made staff. Nothing was changed. If the measure was wrong, an admin lifts it with a correction first.",
    );
    // A demotion is never refused.
    expect(await runGrantRole(deps, account.email, "user")).not.toBe("standing");

    // The other order: a promotion holds the account's row, as grant-role's transaction does, while a suspension is decided.
    const other = await n.account();
    await threatOn(other.id);
    const caseId = await accountCase(other, "R5");
    let release!: () => void;
    const gate = new Promise<void>((resolve) => (release = resolve));
    let taken!: () => void;
    const locked = new Promise<void>((resolve) => (taken = resolve));
    const promotion = n.authDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '20s'`);
      await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from auth.users where id = ${other.id}::uuid for no key update`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update auth.users set role = 'moderator' where id = ${other.id}::uuid`);
      taken();
      await gate;
    });
    let failed: unknown = null;
    promotion.catch((err: unknown) => {
      failed = err;
      taken();
    });
    try {
      await locked;
      expect(failed).toBeNull();
      const deciding = refused(admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: atOnce(3) });
      await untilBlocked(n.apiDb, "insert into decisions");
      release();
      await promotion;
      expect(await deciding).toMatchObject({ code: "staff_target" });
    } finally {
      release();
      await promotion.catch(() => undefined);
      await n.authDb.execute(sql`update auth.users set role = 'user' where id = ${other.id}::uuid`);
    }
  });

    // The dispatch job mails the same line: the item's mail is made pending as the release makes a mailed one.
    await world.migrateDb.execute(sql`update intake_items set outcome_mail = 'pending' where intake_id = ${notice.intakeId}::uuid`);
    const mailed = (await pendingOutcomeLines(n.apiDb)).find((line) => line.intakeId === notice.intakeId)!;
    expect(mailed).toMatchObject({ targetType: "account", measure: true, retired: false });
    expect(updateLine(world.moderation.deps, mailed).outcome).toBe(words);

  test("this file left no row behind: what it committed is removed, and the tables hold what they held before it", async () => {
```

```ts
import { randomBytes, randomInt, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, rmSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import pino from "pino";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ErrorEnvelope, FlowResponse, MeResponse, PostView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { createAccount } from "../../src/account";
import { createApp } from "../../src/app";
import { createAuth } from "../../src/auth";
import { randomToken } from "../../src/auth/crypto";
import { MemoryKv } from "../../src/auth/kv";
import { DEV_CODE, devProvider } from "../../src/auth/verify/dev";
import { loadConfig, type Config } from "../../src/config";
import { MemoryMailer } from "../../src/mail/memory";
import { createMedia } from "../../src/media";
import { MemoryStore } from "../../src/middleware/rate-limit";
import { createModeration } from "../../src/moderation";
import { createProfileStore } from "../../src/profiles/store";
import { createSocial, enforceWriteLimit, socialForModeration } from "../../src/social";
import { Browser } from "./http-client";
import { BYTES } from "./media-harness";
import { closeDecisions, suspendForTest } from "./moderation-decide";
import { removeFixtures, rowCounts } from "./moderation-fixtures";

// The suspension is a real, confirmed decision (a staff key's enrolment and sign-in, then two step-ups), and the walk
// calls every write route of the app once: slow on a loaded machine.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 240_000 });

type App = ReturnType<typeof createApp>;

/**
 * What a suspended or terminated account gets from each write route of the app (3e design, section 7.3): refused with 403
 * account_suspended, or its ordinary answer, whatever that is for the request the walk sends. A route that only reads is
 * allowed and is not listed; the staff console's routes are untouched (no staff account can hold a measure of 3e). The walk
 * below is driven from the app's own route table and fails on a write route this table does not list, so a route added
 * later fails until someone has decided what a suspended account gets from it.
 */
export const SUSPENDED_WRITES: Record<string, "refused" | "allowed"> = {
  "POST /api/posts": "refused",
  "DELETE /api/posts/:id": "allowed",
  "POST /api/posts/:id/like": "refused",
  "POST /api/posts/:id/repost": "refused",
  "POST /api/posts/:id/bookmark": "refused",
  "DELETE /api/posts/:id/like": "allowed",
  "DELETE /api/posts/:id/repost": "allowed",
  "DELETE /api/posts/:id/bookmark": "allowed",
  "POST /api/profiles/:handle/follow": "refused",
  "DELETE /api/profiles/:handle/follow": "allowed",
  "POST /api/profiles/:handle/block": "allowed",
  "DELETE /api/profiles/:handle/block": "allowed",
  "POST /api/profiles/:handle/mute": "allowed",
  "DELETE /api/profiles/:handle/mute": "allowed",
  "PATCH /api/me/profile": "refused",
  "POST /api/me/handle": "refused",
  "POST /api/me/explore": "allowed",
  "DELETE /api/me/explore": "allowed",
  "POST /api/media": "refused",
  "DELETE /api/media/:id": "allowed",
  "POST /api/auth/badge/start": "refused",
  "POST /api/auth/badge/verify": "refused",
  "DELETE /api/auth/badge": "allowed",
  "POST /api/auth/onboarding/handle": "allowed",
  "POST /api/auth/email/start": "allowed",
  "POST /api/auth/email/verify": "allowed",
  "POST /api/auth/signup/complete": "allowed",
  "POST /api/auth/password/signin": "allowed",
  "POST /api/auth/password/set": "allowed",
  "POST /api/auth/passkey/signin/options": "allowed",
  "POST /api/auth/passkey/signin/verify": "allowed",
  "POST /api/auth/passkeys/register/options": "allowed",
  "POST /api/auth/passkeys/register/verify": "allowed",
  "PATCH /api/auth/passkeys/:id": "allowed",
  "DELETE /api/auth/passkeys/:id": "allowed",
  "POST /api/auth/passkeys/:id/not-mine": "allowed",
  "POST /api/auth/passkeys/remove-link": "allowed",
  "POST /api/auth/mfa/verify": "allowed",
  "POST /api/auth/mfa/totp/setup": "allowed",
  "POST /api/auth/mfa/totp/confirm": "allowed",
  "POST /api/auth/mfa/totp/disable": "allowed",
  "POST /api/auth/mfa/recovery-codes/regenerate": "allowed",

  "POST /api/auth/reauth/passkey/options": "allowed",
  "POST /api/auth/email/change/start": "allowed",
  "POST /api/auth/email/change/verify": "allowed",
  "POST /api/auth/email/revert": "allowed",
  "POST /api/auth/not-me": "allowed",
  "DELETE /api/auth/sessions/:id": "allowed",
  "POST /api/auth/sessions/revoke-all": "allowed",
  "POST /api/auth/signout": "allowed",
  "POST /api/account/delete/start": "allowed",
  "POST /api/account/delete/confirm": "allowed",
  "POST /api/account/export": "allowed",
  // Signed in, a report under a rule is refused; a notice of illegality is taken (the walk sends both).
  "POST /api/notices": "refused",
  "POST /api/notices/status": "allowed",
  "POST /api/notices/contact": "allowed",
  "POST /api/notices/reexamine": "allowed",
  "POST /api/moderation/decisions/:id/appeal": "allowed",

  "POST /api/moderation/report-mail/resume": "allowed",
};

/** The routes that end the session: called last, so that every other route is called with it. */
const LAST = ["POST /api/auth/sessions/revoke-all", "POST /api/auth/signout"];

/** The write routes of an app's route table, as "METHOD path": every method but GET, HEAD, OPTIONS and middleware's ALL, outside the staff console. */
export function writeRoutes(app: { routes: readonly { method: string; path: string }[] }): string[] {
  const keys = app.routes.filter((route) => !["GET", "HEAD", "OPTIONS", "ALL"].includes(route.method) && route.path !== "/api/staff" && !route.path.startsWith("/api/staff/")).map((route) => `${route.method} ${route.path}`);
  return [...new Set(keys)];
}

/**
 * The route walk (3e design, section 12.2; invariant 10, its pass for an account suspended at once): the real app with
 * every module, an account signed up over HTTP and suspended at once through the decide route's own code, and then every
 * write route of the app's route table called once with that account's session. Each answers as section 7.3 says: 403
 * account_suspended, or not that. Task 4 adds the passes for a terminated account and for an announced suspension before
 * its start.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the route walk of a suspended account", () => {
  let config: Config;
  let authDb: Db;
  let apiDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let app: App;
  const root = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "korbat-route-walk-"));
  const mailer = new MemoryMailer();
  const made: string[] = [];
  let before: Record<string, number>;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    config = loadConfig();
    const logger = pino({ level: "silent" });

    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 6 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 1 });
    const rateLimitStore = new MemoryStore();
    const auth = createAuth({
      config,
      logger,
      authDb,
      kv: new MemoryKv(),
      mailer,
      profiles: createProfileStore(apiDb),
      turnstile: { verify: async () => true },
      breachChecker: { isBreached: async () => false },
      verify: devProvider(),
    });
    const media = createMedia({
      apiDb,
      uploadsDir: path.join(root, "uploads"),
      storeDir: path.join(root, "store"),
      formats: config.MEDIA_FORMATS,
      minFreeBytes: 0,
      logger,
      requireSession: auth.requireSession,
      resolveSession: auth.resolveSession,
      rateLimitStore,
      enforceUploadLimit: (userId, accountCreatedAt, at) => enforceWriteLimit(rateLimitStore, userId, "upload", accountCreatedAt, at),
    });
    // The store volume, which the image worker owns and the upload's free-space check reads.
    mkdirSync(path.join(root, "store"), { recursive: true });
    await media.prepare();
    const moderation = createModeration({ apiDb, auth: auth.forModeration, social: socialForModeration(apiDb), media: media.forCases, requireSession: auth.requireSession, rateLimitStore, config, logger });
    const social = createSocial({ apiDb, rateLimitStore, logger, requireSession: auth.requireSession, requireFreshAuth: auth.requireFreshAuth(), media: media.forPosts, moderation: moderation.forSocial, events: { append: auth.appendEvent } });
    const account = createAccount({
      auth: auth.forAccount,
      social: social.forAccount,
      media: media.forAccount,
      moderation: moderation.forAccount,
      requireSession: auth.requireSession,
      requireFreshAuth: auth.requireFreshAuth(),
      requireStrongFreshAuth: auth.requireStrongFreshAuth(),
      rateLimitStore,
      logger,
    });
    app = createApp({ config, logger, rateLimitStore, healthChecks: {}, auth, social, media, account, moderation });
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb);
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    try {
      await closeDecisions();
      await removeFixtures(migrateDb, made.splice(0));
    } finally {
      rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
      await Promise.all([closeDb(authDb), closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
    }
  }, 240_000);

  /** A signed-in, onboarded web account, its profile three days old so that no new-account tier gets in the way. */
  async function signUp() {
    const b = new Browser(app, config.APP_ORIGIN);
    const email = `walk-${randomUUID()}@korbat.local`;
    const handle = `w${randomBytes(4).toString("hex")}`;
    const start = await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/start", { json: { email, turnstileToken: "ok", deviceId: randomToken(), platform: "web" } });
    const { flowId } = FlowResponse.parse(await start.json());
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/verify", { json: { flowId, code: mailer.lastCodeFor(email) } })).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/signup/complete", { json: { flowId, dateOfBirth: "1990-05-17", termsVersion: config.TERMS_VERSION } })).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/onboarding/handle", { json: { handle, displayName: `User ${handle}` } })).status).toBe(200);
    const id = MeResponse.parse(await (await b.fetch("/api/me")).json()).user.id;
    made.push(id);
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`update profiles set created_at = now() - interval '3 days' where id = ${id}::uuid`);
    return { b, handle, id, email };
  }

  test("every write route of the app's route table is listed in section 7.3's table, and none is listed that the app does not have", () => {
    const routes = writeRoutes(app).sort();
    expect(routes.filter((route) => !(route in SUSPENDED_WRITES))).toEqual([]);
    expect(Object.keys(SUSPENDED_WRITES).filter((route) => !routes.includes(route))).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("an account suspended at once: each write route answers 403 account_suspended or its ordinary answer, as the table says, and /api/me then shows the suspension", async () => {
    const ada = await signUp();
    const bob = await signUp();
    const bobsPost = PostView.parse(await (await bob.b.fetch("/api/posts", { json: { body: "bob's post" } })).json());
    const adasPost = PostView.parse(await (await ada.b.fetch("/api/posts", { json: { body: "ada's post" } })).json());
    expect((await ada.b.fetch(`/api/posts/${bobsPost.id}/like`, { method: "POST" })).status).toBe(200);
    // A badge verification started before the suspension, which its verify step then meets.
    const badge = await ada.b.fetch("/api/auth/badge/start", { json: { phone: `+4477${String(randomInt(10_000_000, 100_000_000))}` } });
    const { flowId } = FlowResponse.parse(await badge.json());
    const { decisionId } = await suspendForTest(apiDb, ada.id, { days: 7 });
    expect(MeResponse.parse(await (await ada.b.fetch("/api/me")).json()).standing?.measure?.state).toBe("running");

    type Call = { path: string; method: string; json?: unknown; raw?: { type: string; body: Uint8Array } };
    const calls: Record<string, Call[]> = {
      "POST /api/posts": [{ method: "POST", path: "/api/posts", json: { body: "while suspended" } }],
      "DELETE /api/posts/:id": [{ method: "DELETE", path: `/api/posts/${adasPost.id}` }],
      "POST /api/posts/:id/like": [{ method: "POST", path: `/api/posts/${bobsPost.id}/like` }],
      "POST /api/posts/:id/repost": [{ method: "POST", path: `/api/posts/${bobsPost.id}/repost` }],
      "POST /api/posts/:id/bookmark": [{ method: "POST", path: `/api/posts/${bobsPost.id}/bookmark` }],
      "DELETE /api/posts/:id/like": [{ method: "DELETE", path: `/api/posts/${bobsPost.id}/like` }],
      "DELETE /api/posts/:id/repost": [{ method: "DELETE", path: `/api/posts/${bobsPost.id}/repost` }],
      "DELETE /api/posts/:id/bookmark": [{ method: "DELETE", path: `/api/posts/${bobsPost.id}/bookmark` }],
      "POST /api/profiles/:handle/follow": [{ method: "POST", path: `/api/profiles/${bob.handle}/follow` }],
      "DELETE /api/profiles/:handle/follow": [{ method: "DELETE", path: `/api/profiles/${bob.handle}/follow` }],
      "POST /api/profiles/:handle/block": [{ method: "POST", path: `/api/profiles/${bob.handle}/block` }],
      "DELETE /api/profiles/:handle/block": [{ method: "DELETE", path: `/api/profiles/${bob.handle}/block` }],
      "POST /api/profiles/:handle/mute": [{ method: "POST", path: `/api/profiles/${bob.handle}/mute` }],
      "DELETE /api/profiles/:handle/mute": [{ method: "DELETE", path: `/api/profiles/${bob.handle}/mute` }],
      "PATCH /api/me/profile": [
        { method: "PATCH", path: "/api/me/profile", json: { displayName: "korbat moderation" } },
        { method: "PATCH", path: "/api/me/profile", json: { bio: "" } },
      ],
      "POST /api/me/handle": [{ method: "POST", path: "/api/me/handle", json: { handle: `w${randomBytes(4).toString("hex")}` } }],
      "POST /api/me/explore": [{ method: "POST", path: "/api/me/explore" }],
      "DELETE /api/me/explore": [{ method: "DELETE", path: "/api/me/explore" }],
      "POST /api/media": [{ method: "POST", path: "/api/media", raw: { type: "image/jpeg", body: BYTES.jpeg } }],
      "DELETE /api/media/:id": [{ method: "DELETE", path: `/api/media/${randomUUID()}` }],
      "POST /api/auth/badge/start": [{ method: "POST", path: "/api/auth/badge/start", json: { phone: `+4477${String(randomInt(10_000_000, 100_000_000))}` } }],
      "POST /api/auth/badge/verify": [{ method: "POST", path: "/api/auth/badge/verify", json: { flowId, code: DEV_CODE } }],
      "POST /api/notices": [
        { method: "POST", path: "/api/notices", json: { ground: "rule", ruleId: "R1", targets: [{ kind: "post", id: bobsPost.id }] } },
        { method: "POST", path: "/api/notices", json: { ground: "illegal", targets: [{ kind: "post", id: bobsPost.id }], category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH", explanation: "It is a threat.", bonaFide: true } },
      ],
      "POST /api/moderation/decisions/:id/appeal": [{ method: "POST", path: `/api/moderation/decisions/${decisionId}/appeal`, json: {} }],
      "POST /api/moderation/items/:item/reexamine": [{ method: "POST", path: `/api/moderation/items/${randomUUID()}/reexamine`, json: {} }],
    };
    const callsOf = (route: string): Call[] => {
      const given = calls[route];
      if (given) return given;
      // Every other route: called with its path's parameters filled in and an empty body, which is its ordinary answer here.
      const [method, template] = route.split(" ") as [string, string];
      return [{ method, path: template.replace(/:[a-z]+/g, randomUUID()), json: method === "DELETE" ? undefined : {} }];
    };
    const order = writeRoutes(app).sort((a, b) => Number(LAST.includes(a)) - Number(LAST.includes(b)));
    const answers: Record<string, string[]> = {};
    for (const route of order) {
      for (const call of callsOf(route)) {
        const res = await ada.b.fetch(call.path, { method: call.method, json: call.json, raw: call.raw });
        const code = res.status === 403 ? ErrorEnvelope.safeParse(await res.json()).data?.error.code : undefined;
        (answers[route] ??= []).push(code === "account_suspended" ? "refused" : `${res.status}`);
      }
    }
    for (const route of order) {
      const got = answers[route]!;
      if (route === "POST /api/notices") {
        // A report under a rule is refused; a notice of illegality is taken.
        expect(got, route).toEqual(["refused", "201"]);
        continue;
      }
      if (SUSPENDED_WRITES[route] === "refused") expect(got.every((answer) => answer === "refused"), `${route} answered ${got.join(", ")}`).toBe(true);
      else expect(got.some((answer) => answer === "refused"), `${route} answered ${got.join(", ")}`).toBe(false);
    }
    // What the refusals left: no visible post (its own was deleted; the one the suspension's basis removed is not shown),
    // no follow, the profile and the handle as they were, no badge.
    const [counts] = await apiDb.execute<{ posts: number; follows: number; verified: boolean; handle: string }>(
      sql`select (select count(*)::int from posts where author_id = ${ada.id}::uuid and state = 'visible') as posts,
                 (select count(*)::int from follows where follower_id = ${ada.id}::uuid) as follows,
                 (select verified_at is not null from profiles where id = ${ada.id}::uuid) as verified,
                 (select handle from profiles where id = ${ada.id}::uuid) as handle`,
    );
    expect({ ...counts! }).toEqual({ posts: 0, follows: 0, verified: false, handle: ada.handle });
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: what it committed is removed, and the tables hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await closeDecisions();
    await removeFixtures(migrateDb, made.splice(0));
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb)).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

```tsx
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";

});

const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
/** The markup's text as a reader sees it: tags dropped, entities read, spaces collapsed. */
const textOf = (markup: string): string =>
  markup
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ")
    .replace(/&#x27;/g, "'")
    .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
    .replace(/&amp;/g, "&")
    .split(" ")

    reply: null,
    replyOpen: true,
    appealUntil: "2027-04-12T10:00:00.000Z",

});
const NONE: AccountStanding = { activeStrikes: 0, measure: null, reporting: null, handleRetired: false };

describe("3e: the words of a suspension in the app", () => {
  test("the banner's, the refusal's, the report form's and the retired handle's sentences are the design's, with the end printed as standingTime prints it", () => {
    expect(STANDING_TEXTS.banner.running(ENDS)).toBe(
      `Your account is suspended until ${standingTime(ENDS)}. You can read, reply to korbat, appeal, export your data and delete your account. You cannot post, like, repost, bookmark, follow, edit your profile, upload images or report under korbat's rules.`,
    );
    expect(STANDING_TEXTS.banner.label).toBe("Your account's standing");
    expect(STANDING_TEXTS.refused.suspended(ENDS)).toBe(`Your account is suspended until ${standingTime(ENDS)}, so you cannot do this now.`);
    expect(STANDING_TEXTS.refused.terminated).toBe("korbat has terminated your account, so you cannot do this.");
    expect(STANDING_TEXTS.refused.over).toBe("The suspension has just ended. Try again.");

});

describe("3e: the report form, Your standing and Settings, Profile while the suspension runs (design, sections 9.4 to 9.6)", () => {
```

```ts
  type FixtureApi,
} from "./fixture-api";
import { startConsoleSite, type ConsoleSiteServer } from "./server";
import { inspect, userTexts, watch, type Watcher } from "./watch";

/**
 * The console's browser check (3a design, section 12). It builds the console, serves the build with the routes and headers
 * of Caddy's console site read from infra/caddy/Caddyfile, answers /api/staff/* from fixtures whose user-written strings
 * are hostile (markup, javascript: URLs, a direction override, the longest names allowed), and drives Chromium through
 * playwright-core with a CDP virtual authenticator over every screen: the console switched off, enrolment (a synced
 * passkey refused, then a device-bound key that verifies its user, whose success page signs in with that key), home, a
 * session revoked with the key, step-up options that bind another action refused before the key is asked, the audit log,
 * an address the console does not have, the ended session, a second key enrolled while signed in, whose success page
 * asks that key and no other, sign-out, and sign-in options that carry a step-up challenge refused before the key is
 * asked. For moderation cases (3c design, section 8) it walks the home screen's overview, the queue with a finding, a
 * case with its images shown on request, an image the API refuses, a case whose images cannot be opened, an account's
 * case with a fresh snapshot, a reveal, and a save that the API answers with the digest of another text. For deciding
 * (sections 7.5 and 8) it lifts a measure taken while deciding, meets step-up options that bind another decision before
 * the key is asked, confirms a final decision whose texts were saved when their fields lost focus, seals an account's
 * images with the fixed drafts through a session that ended and a sign-in, records a choice not to seal, answers a report
 * of child sexual abuse material without a measure as an admin, meets a case that another staff member decided meanwhile,
 * brings a draft's saved texts back after a reload (one of them answered with other words under its digest, and dropped),
 * and reads the home screen's three lists of the path. Each step fails on any policy report through any channel
 * console-lab.md names, any page error and any dialog. It needs no database and writes nothing but a temporary build.
 *
 * It never downloads a browser. By default it drives the Chromium build playwright-core 1.63.0 names (chromium-1243 under
 * ms-playwright), which must already be installed; KORBAT_BROWSER_CHANNEL=chrome drives the machine's own Chrome instead,
 * as CI does with the runner's.
 */
const CHANNEL = process.env.KORBAT_BROWSER_CHANNEL || "chromium";

/** 3e: what the two runs of Task 1 type: the facts of a removal that gives a strike, and the reason of a review that overrules one. */
const STRIKE_FACTS = `The post sells followers again ${HOSTILE.img}`;
const OVERRULE_REASON = `The post quotes the offer to report it ${HOSTILE.quote}`;

let out = "";
let site: ConsoleSiteServer | undefined;
let browser: Browser | undefined;
let context: BrowserContext;
let page: Page;
let watcher: Watcher;
let fixtures: FixtureApi;
let origin = "";
/** The device-bound authenticator that holds the first staff key enrolled. */
let staffAuthenticator = "";
/** Every device-bound authenticator the walk enrolled a staff key on. */
const staffAuthenticators: string[] = [];
/** Every person-written string the walk has found shown as text. */
const seen = new Set<string>();
/** The headers each static file was served with, by path. */
const served = new Map<string, Record<string, string>>();

/** The text of every element holding a person-written string or an action, kept in `seen`. */
async function texts(): Promise<string[]> {
  const found = await userTexts(page);
  for (const text of found) seen.add(text);
  return found;
}

/** Waits for a locator to show, failing with what it looked for. */
async function shown(locator: Locator, timeout = 15_000): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await locator.first().waitFor({ state: "visible", timeout });
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`not shown within ${timeout} ms: ${locator.toString()}`);
  }
}

/** A virtual CTAP2 authenticator that verifies its user: a security key on USB, or a platform one whose passkeys sync. */
async function addAuthenticator(kind: "device-bound security key" | "synced platform passkey"): Promise<string> {
  const synced = kind === "synced platform passkey";
  const { authenticatorId } = await watcher.cdp.send("WebAuthn.addVirtualAuthenticator", {
    options: {
      protocol: "ctap2",
      transport: synced ? "internal" : "usb",
      hasResidentKey: true,
      hasUserVerification: true,
      isUserVerified: true,
      automaticPresenceSimulation: true,
      // The flags a password manager's passkey reports, and a security key never does.
      defaultBackupEligibility: synced,
      defaultBackupState: synced,
    },
  });
  return authenticatorId;
}

/** How many times an authenticator's keys have signed: the virtual authenticator counts every signature. */
async function signaturesOf(authenticatorId: string): Promise<number> {
  const { credentials } = await watcher.cdp.send("WebAuthn.getCredentials", { authenticatorId });
  return credentials.reduce((sum, credential) => sum + credential.signCount, 0);
}

/** How many times every staff key of the walk has signed. */
async function signatures(): Promise<number> {
  let sum = 0;
  for (const id of staffAuthenticators) sum += await signaturesOf(id);
  return sum;
}

/**
 * Waits until an expression is true in the page. The expression is plain text, sent as page.evaluate sends it: nothing
 * of the test runner's is put into the page, and nothing in the page evaluates it under the page's policy.
 */
async function until(expression: string, what: string): Promise<void> {
  for (let tries = 0; tries < 150; tries++) {
    if (await page.evaluate(expression)) return;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
  }
  throw new Error(`not within 15 s: ${what}`);
}

/**
 * Waits until the fixtures have seen something. A text is saved when its field loses focus, and the request arrives a
 * moment after the key press that moved the focus.
 */
async function arrived(check: () => boolean, what: string): Promise<void> {
  for (let tries = 0; tries < 150 && !check(); tries++) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
  if (!check()) throw new Error(`not within 15 s: ${what}`);
}

/** The one image of the page: whether it is there, loaded as a real image of 2 by 2 pixels, from this address, drawn with this class. */
const imageIs = (src: string, className: string) =>
  `(() => { const all = document.querySelectorAll("img"); const i = all[0]; return all.length === 1 && i.getAttribute("src") === ${JSON.stringify(src)} && i.className === ${JSON.stringify(className)} && i.complete && i.naturalWidth === 2 && i.naturalHeight === 2; })()`;

/** The end of every step: no report, error or dialog on any channel, nothing in the page the console never writes, and no request the fixtures refused for the page's fault. */
async function clean(): Promise<void> {
  expect(watcher.take()).toEqual([]);
  expect(await inspect(page)).toEqual([]);
  expect(fixtures.state.problems).toEqual([]);
}

beforeAll(async () => {
  out = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "korbat-admin-browser-"));
  await buildConsole({ outdir: out });
  fixtures = createFixtureApi();
  site = await startConsoleSite({ dist: out, api: fixtures.handle });
  origin = site.origin;
  fixtures.state.origin = origin;
  browser = await chromium.launch({ channel: CHANNEL, headless: true });
  context = await browser.newContext({ timezoneId: "UTC", locale: "en-GB", viewport: { width: 1280, height: 900 } });
  page = await context.newPage();
  page.setDefaultTimeout(15_000);
  watcher = await watch(context, page, origin);
  await watcher.cdp.send("WebAuthn.enable", { enableUI: false });
  page.on("response", (response) => {
    const url = new URL(response.url());
    if (!url.pathname.startsWith("/api/")) served.set(url.pathname, response.headers());
  });
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await browser?.close();
  await site?.close();
  if (out) rmSync(out, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

describe("the staff console in Chromium, under the console site's policy", () => {
  test("the page, its script and its stylesheet come with the Caddyfile's console headers, the policy of section 3 among them", async () => {
    fixtures.state.off = true;
    await page.goto(`${origin}/`);
    await shown(page.getByText(UNAVAILABLE_TEXT));
    const headersFor = consoleSiteHeadersFromCaddyfile();
    expect(headersFor("/", false)["Content-Security-Policy"]).toBe(CONSOLE_CSP);
    const assets = [...served.keys()].filter((p) => p.startsWith("/assets/"));
    expect(assets.map((p) => path.extname(p)).sort()).toEqual([".css", ".js"]);
    // The page is index.html answered for "/", which names no file; the script and the stylesheet are files of the build.
    for (const p of ["/", ...assets]) {
      const sent = served.get(p)!;
      for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(headersFor(p, p !== "/"))) expect(sent[name.toLowerCase()], `${p} ${name}`).toBe(value);
    }
    expect(served.get("/")!["cache-control"]).toBe("no-store, no-transform");
    for (const p of assets) expect(served.get(p)!["cache-control"]).toBe("public, max-age=31536000, immutable");
  });

  test("a console that is off shows only that it is not available at this address", async () => {
    expect(await page.locator("#root").innerText()).toBe(UNAVAILABLE_TEXT);
    expect(await page.getByRole("button").count()).toBe(0);
    fixtures.state.off = false;
    await clean();
  });

  test("enrolment: a synced passkey is refused and explained while the link still works, then a device-bound key registers", async () => {
    const synced = await addAuthenticator("synced platform passkey");
    await page.goto(`${origin}/enroll/${fixtures.state.enrolmentToken}`);
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Register a staff key" }));
    await page.getByLabel("Name of this key").fill(TYPED_KEY_NAME);
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Use Windows Hello on this computer" }).click();
    await shown(page.getByText(STAFF_MESSAGES.staff_key_not_device_bound));
    await shown(page.getByText("This link still works", { exact: false }));
    // The console's relying party ID is not the app's here, so the page asked the browser to drop the refused passkey, or
    // says to delete it by hand where the browser could not.
    await shown(page.getByText(/asked to remove the refused passkey|Delete the refused entry/));
    expect(fixtures.state.enrolmentUsed).toBe(false);
    await clean();

    await watcher.cdp.send("WebAuthn.removeVirtualAuthenticator", { authenticatorId: synced });
    staffAuthenticator = await addAuthenticator("device-bound security key");
    staffAuthenticators.push(staffAuthenticator);
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Register a security key" }).click();
    await shown(page.getByText("is registered", { exact: false }));
    expect(await texts()).toContain(TYPED_KEY_NAME);
    expect(fixtures.state.enrolmentUsed).toBe(true);
    await clean();
  });

  test("the success page signs in with the new key, which opens the console, and home follows", async () => {
    // The registration counted as one use of the key; the sign-in is the next.
    const before = await signatures();
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Sign in with this key" }).click();
    await shown(page.getByText("opened the console", { exact: false }));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    await page.getByRole("link", { name: "Go to the home page" }).click();
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Home" }));
    expect(page.url()).toBe(`${origin}/`);
    await clean();
  });

  test("home: who is signed in, the sign-ins of 7 days, the sessions and the keys, every written string as text", async () => {
    const current = [...fixtures.state.sessions.values()].find((s) => s.browser === CURRENT_BROWSER)!;
    await shown(page.getByText(`Signed in until ${clockTime(new Date(current.createdAt + 12 * 60 * 60_000).toISOString())}.`));
    await shown(page.locator("ul.signins"));
    await shown(page.locator("ul.keys"));
    await shown(page.getByRole("cell", { name: "This session" }));
    // Every sign-in of the last 7 days, read page by page, and none older.
    const since = Date.now() - SIGN_IN_WINDOW_MS;
    const recent = fixtures.state.audit.filter((row) => row.action === "staff_sign_in" && Date.parse(row.createdAt) >= since);
    expect(recent.length).toBeGreaterThan(50);
    expect(await page.locator("ul.signins li").count()).toBe(recent.length);
    expect(fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.path.startsWith("/api/staff/audit?action=staff_sign_in")).length).toBe(2);
    // The sessions: this one and the two others; the keys: the two the person held and the new one.
    expect(await page.locator("table tbody tr").count()).toBe(3);
    expect(await page.locator("ul.keys li").count()).toBe(EXISTING_KEY_NAMES.length + 1);
    const shownTexts = await texts();
    for (const text of [PERSON_HANDLE, CURRENT_BROWSER, ...OTHER_BROWSERS, ...EXISTING_KEY_NAMES, TYPED_KEY_NAME]) expect(shownTexts, text).toContain(text);
    await clean();
  });

  test("a session revoked with the key: the step-up's options check out, the key signs once, and the session goes", async () => {
    const before = await signatures();
    const target = [...fixtures.state.sessions.values()].find((s) => s.browser === OTHER_BROWSERS[0])!;
    const row = page.locator("table tbody tr").filter({ hasText: OTHER_BROWSERS[0] });
    await row.getByRole("button", { name: "Sign out that session" }).click();
    await shown(page.getByText("That session is signed out."));
    await row.waitFor({ state: "detached" });
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    expect(fixtures.state.revoked).toEqual([target.handle]);
    expect(await page.locator("table tbody tr").count()).toBe(2);
    await clean();
  });

  test("step-up options that bind another action are refused before the key is asked", async () => {
    const before = await signatures();
    const optionsBefore = fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed;
    const deletes = fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.method === "DELETE").length;
    fixtures.state.mismatchNextStepUp = true;
    const row = page.locator("table tbody tr").filter({ hasText: OTHER_BROWSERS[1] });
    await row.getByRole("button", { name: "Sign out that session" }).click();
    await shown(page.getByText(messageFor("step_up_mismatch")));
    expect(fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed).toBe(optionsBefore + 1);
    // The key signed nothing, no revocation was sent, and the session is still listed.
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    expect(fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.method === "DELETE").length).toBe(deletes);
    expect(await row.count()).toBe(1);
    await clean();
  });

  test("the audit log: the newest page, Load older, Go to place and back to the newest", async () => {
    await page.getByRole("link", { name: "Audit log" }).click();
    await page.waitForURL(`${origin}/audit`);
    const rows = page.locator("table.audit tbody tr");
    await shown(rows);
    const newest = fixtures.state.audit[0]!.seq;
    expect(await rows.count()).toBe(50);
    expect(await rows.first().locator("td").first().textContent()).toBe(String(newest));
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Load older" }).click();
    await rows.nth(50).waitFor();
    expect(await rows.count()).toBe(100);
    await page.getByLabel("Place").fill("75");
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Go to place" }).click();
    await shown(page.getByText("From place 75, newest first."));
    expect(await rows.first().locator("td").first().textContent()).toBe("75");
    const shownTexts = await texts();
    for (const row of fixtures.state.audit.filter((r) => r.seq <= 75 && r.seq > 25)) {
      for (const text of [row.actorHandle, row.action, row.targetType, row.targetId, row.hash]) if (text !== null) expect(shownTexts, text).toContain(text);
    }
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Newest" }).click();
    await page.getByText("From place 75, newest first.").waitFor({ state: "detached" });
    expect(await rows.first().locator("td").first().textContent()).toBe(String(newest));
    await clean();
  });

  test("home shows the cases' overview: the lanes, the appeals waiting and every reveal with its staff handle and its case", async () => {
    await page.getByRole("link", { name: "Home" }).click();
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Home" }));
    await shown(page.getByText("Urgent: 2 cases, oldest", { exact: false }));
    await shown(page.getByText("Lane 1: no open case"));
    // The appeal the fixtures' appealed case holds, which this person may review, and one nobody at korbat can review now.
    await shown(page.getByText("2 appeals wait; you may review 1; 1 has no possible reviewer now."));
    await shown(page.getByText(APPEAL_WORDS.reviewerRule));
    // The first list of the kind is the reveals'; the three lists of the path for child sexual abuse material follow it.
    const reveals = page.locator("ul.reveals").first();
    expect(await reveals.locator("li").count()).toBe(1);
    expect(await reveals.locator("a").getAttribute("href")).toBe(`/cases/${CASE_POST}`);
    await shown(page.locator("ul.signins"));
    await shown(page.locator("ul.keys"));
    await shown(page.getByRole("cell", { name: "This session" }));
    await texts();
    await clean();
  });

  test("home says which erasures are more than a day late, with the runbook's sentence, as an alert", async () => {
    await page.getByRole("link", { name: "Home" }).click();
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Home" }));
    const late = page.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: "Erasures more than a day late" });
    await shown(late);
    expect(await late.innerText()).toBe(`Erasures more than a day late: image rows nothing retains: 60; notifiers' contacts and confirmations: 2. ${ERASURE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK}`);
    // A count of zero is not on the screen at all.
    expect(await page.getByText("unconfirmed drafts").count()).toBe(0);
    await texts();
    await clean();
  });

  test("the queue: open cases by lane and age with their marks, Load more, and Open a case on a finding", async () => {
    await page.getByRole("link", { name: "Queue" }).click();
    await page.waitForURL(`${origin}/queue`);
    const rows = page.locator("table.queue tbody tr");
    await shown(rows);
    expect(await rows.count()).toBe(2);
    expect(await rows.first().innerText()).toContain("CSAM: no images");
    expect(await rows.first().innerText()).toContain("re-examination");
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Load more" }).click();
    await rows.nth(2).waitFor();
    expect(await rows.count()).toBe(3);
    expect(await rows.nth(2).innerText()).toContain("deferred");
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Load more" }).waitFor({ state: "detached" });
    expect(await page.evaluate(`[...document.querySelectorAll("table.queue a")].map((link) => link.getAttribute("href"))`)).toEqual([`/cases/${CASE_FROZEN}`, `/cases/${CASE_ACCOUNT}`, `/cases/${CASE_POST}`]);

    // A link that is no web address is never sent; a link that names nothing is worded in the form's own words.
    const sent = () => fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.path === "/api/staff/findings").length;
    await page.getByLabel("Link on korbat").fill("javascript:alert(1)");
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Open a case" }).click();
    await shown(page.getByText(FINDING_WORDS.invalid_request));
    expect(sent()).toBe(0);
    await page.getByLabel("Link on korbat").fill(DEAD_LINK);
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Open a case" }).click();
    await shown(page.getByText(FINDING_WORDS.not_found));
    expect(sent()).toBe(1);
    expect(fixtures.state.findings).toEqual([]);
    await clean();

    // A finding under R6 with its preset category opens the case it joined.
    const link = `http://localhost:8081/post/${POST_ID}`;
    await page.getByLabel("Link on korbat").fill(link);
    await page.getByLabel("Rule", { exact: true }).selectOption("R6");
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Open a case" }).click();
    await page.waitForURL(`${origin}/cases/${CASE_POST}`);
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    expect(fixtures.state.findings).toEqual([{ target: { kind: "link", url: link }, ground: "rule", ruleId: "R6", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD" }]);
    await clean();
  });

  test("a case: every written string as text in its frame, an image only when asked for, first small and blurred, then large and clear, one at a time; a note saved with its digest", async () => {
    // Nothing was asked of the image route by opening the case.
    expect(fixtures.state.imageRequests).toEqual([]);
    expect(await page.locator(".placeholder").count()).toBe(2);
    expect(await page.locator("img").count()).toBe(0);
    const small = `/api/staff/cases/${CASE_POST}/media/${IMAGE_ONE}/small`;
    const large = `/api/staff/cases/${CASE_POST}/media/${IMAGE_ONE}/large`;
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Show image" }).first().click();
    await until(imageIs(small, "evidence blurred"), "the small image, blurred");
    expect(fixtures.state.imageRequests).toEqual([small]);
    // The image is the console's own, drawn by its one image site: the page holds nothing else it does not write.
    expect(await inspect(page)).toEqual([]);
    expect(await page.evaluate(`getComputedStyle(document.querySelector("img.evidence")).filter`)).toContain("blur");
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Show clearly" }).click();
    await until(imageIs(large, "evidence"), "the large image, clear");
    expect(await page.evaluate(`getComputedStyle(document.querySelector("img.evidence")).filter`)).toBe("none");
    expect(fixtures.state.imageRequests).toEqual([small, large]);
    // The second image takes the first one's place.
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Show image" }).click();
    await until(imageIs(`/api/staff/cases/${CASE_POST}/media/${IMAGE_TWO}/small`, "evidence blurred"), "the second image alone");
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Hide image" }).click();
    await page.locator("img").waitFor({ state: "detached" });
    expect(fixtures.state.imageRequests).toHaveLength(3);
    // No image request carried anything but the session's cookie: the route's answer came from this origin alone.
    expect(fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => IMAGE_PATH.test(r.path)).map((r) => r.status)).toEqual([200, 200, 200]);

    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Show hidden characters" }).first().click();
    await shown(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Show the text as written" }));
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Show the text as written" }).click();

    await page.getByLabel("Add a note").fill(TYPED_NOTE);
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Save the note" }).click();
    await shown(page.getByText("The note is saved."));
    expect(fixtures.state.texts.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_POST, kind: "note", text: TYPED_NOTE });
    const shownTexts = await texts();
    for (const text of [TYPED_NOTE, LOOKALIKE.label, LONGEST_EXPLANATION, LONGEST_NOTE]) expect(shownTexts, text.slice(0, 40)).toContain(text);
    // The post's text names two hosts and one address whose host no browser reads (a direction override ends it): the
    // frame lists the two, and says that the third is there.
    expect(await page.locator("p.hint", { hasText: "Mentions addresses at:" }).first().innerText()).toBe("Mentions addresses at: korbat.example.evil.test, evil.test and an address this console cannot read");
    // The page holds no link but the console's own navigation.
    expect(await page.locator("main a").count()).toBe(0);
    await clean();
  });

  test("an image the API refuses says so in its place, in the console's words, and the case is read again", async () => {
    const reads = () => fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.method === "GET" && r.path === `/api/staff/cases/${CASE_POST}`).length;
    const [asked, read] = [fixtures.state.imageRequests.length, reads()];
    // The post was frozen between the page's read of the case and the browser's request, as far as the page can tell.
    fixtures.state.refuseNextImage = true;
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Show image" }).first().click();
    await shown(page.locator(".placeholder").first().getByText(messageFor("image_refused"), { exact: true }));
    expect(await page.locator("img").count()).toBe(0);
    expect(fixtures.state.imageRequests).toHaveLength(asked + 1);
    expect(fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => IMAGE_PATH.test(r.path)).at(-1)!.status).toBe(404);
    // What may be opened may have changed, so the page read the case again, once.
    for (let tries = 0; tries < 150 && reads() === read; tries++) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
    expect(reads()).toBe(read + 1);
    // Nothing offers to show the refused image more clearly; its person puts it away, and it is asked for only on a new click.
    expect(await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Show clearly" }).count()).toBe(0);
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Hide image" }).click();
    await shown(page.getByText("Image 1, not shown"));
    expect(fixtures.state.imageRequests).toHaveLength(asked + 1);
    await clean();
  });

  test("a case whose images cannot be opened: the banners, the sentence above the images' entries, each entry without its image, a re-examination item, the quoted post's case as the only link, and no image request", async () => {

  test("a reveal: nothing to confirm until a reason is chosen and written; the reason saved first, the key confirming its digest; the name in a frame of its own, kept when the case cannot be read again and gone once the dialog is closed; options that bind another item are refused before the key is asked", async () => {
    await page.goto(`${origin}/cases/${CASE_POST}`);
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    const before = await signatures();
    const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog");
    const confirm = dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" });
    const why = dialog.getByLabel("Why");
    const written = dialog.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true });
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Reveal who sent this" }).first().click();
    await shown(dialog);
    // No reason is chosen for the person and none is written: there is nothing to confirm yet.
    expect(await why.inputValue()).toBe("");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await why.selectOption("abuse_of_reporting");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await written.fill("   ");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await written.fill("The same account reported forty posts of one author in an hour.");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);
    // The read of the case that follows the reveal will be refused: the page, and the name it has just shown, must stay.
    fixtures.state.recuseNextCaseRead = true;
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(dialog.getByText("Revealed to you; recorded and shown to every staff member"));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    const reason = fixtures.state.texts.find((text) => text.kind === "reveal_reason")!;
    expect(reason).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_POST, text: "The same account reported forty posts of one author in an hour." });
    expect(fixtures.state.reveals).toEqual([{ itemId: ITEM_REPORTER, reasonDigest: reason.digest }]);
    // The name alone in its frame, under the console's own line that says what it is, with its hidden characters to show.
    await shown(dialog.getByText("The reporter's handle:", { exact: true }));
    expect(await dialog.locator(".frame p.frame-text").textContent()).toBe(REVEALED_HANDLE);
    await shown(dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Show hidden characters" }));
    // The refused read left the case on the page and says why on the page's error line; the name is still there.
    await shown(page.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: messageFor("staff_recused") }));
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    expect(fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.path === `/api/staff/cases/${CASE_POST}`).at(-1)!.status).toBe(403);
    expect(await dialog.locator(".frame p.frame-text").textContent()).toBe(REVEALED_HANDLE);
    expect(await texts()).toContain(REVEALED_HANDLE);
    // Shown once: with the dialog closed the page holds the name nowhere.
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Close" }).click();
    await dialog.waitFor({ state: "detached" });
    expect(await userTexts(page)).not.toContain(REVEALED_HANDLE);
    expect(await page.locator("#root").innerText()).not.toContain("a_reporter");
    await clean();

    // The server asks the key to confirm the reveal of another item: the key is never asked, and nothing is revealed.
    const reveals = fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.path.endsWith("/reveal")).length;
    fixtures.state.mismatchNextStepUp = true;
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Reveal who sent this" }).nth(1).click();
    await why.selectOption("impersonation_claim");
    await written.fill("The notifier claims to be impersonated.");
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(page.getByText(messageFor("step_up_mismatch")));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    expect(fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.path.endsWith("/reveal")).length).toBe(reveals);
    expect(fixtures.state.reveals).toHaveLength(1);
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" }).click();
    await clean();
  });
```
