```ts
  test("a decision whose step-up options bind other params is refused before the key is asked; the draft stays, and confirmed again it is recorded without its texts being saved twice", async () => {
    const before = await signatures();
    const sent = () => fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.method === "POST" && r.path.endsWith("/decisions")).length;
    const composer = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    const confirm = composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" });
    // The outcome comes first, with every outcome this person may decide on the case; the page opens on a restriction.
    expect(await composer.locator("fieldset legend").first().textContent()).toBe("Outcome");
    for (const outcome of Object.values(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES)) expect(await composer.getByLabel(outcome, { exact: true }).count(), outcome).toBe(1);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.restricted, { exact: true }).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_KINDS.final).check();
    // A restriction needs a measure, its facts and its reason before anything can be confirmed.
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.previewNeedsMeasure));
    await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.remove.label, { exact: true }).check();
    const saved = fixtures.state.texts.length;
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").fill(TYPED_FACTS);
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill("It sells followers, which the rule names.");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);
    // Each text is saved, without the key, when its field loses focus: the facts when the reason was begun, the reason now.
    await arrived(() => fixtures.state.texts.length === saved + 1, "the facts saved when their field lost focus");
    expect(fixtures.state.texts.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_POST, kind: "facts", text: TYPED_FACTS });
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => fixtures.state.texts.length === saved + 2, "the reason saved when its field lost focus");
    expect(fixtures.state.texts.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_POST, kind: "reason", text: "It sells followers, which the rule names." });
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    // Under both fields of a restriction: the rule on personal data, and that the author receives the text.
    expect(await composer.getByText(COMPOSER.personalData, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(2);
    const preview = composer.locator(".frame.preview p.frame-text");
    expect(await preview.first().textContent()).toBe(STATEMENT_WORDS.done.remove("2026-09-30 12:00 UTC"));
    expect(await preview.allTextContents()).toContain(`The facts: ${TYPED_FACTS}`);
    expect(await preview.last().textContent()).toMatch(/^You can appeal this decision once, free of charge, within six months of being told, until /);
    expect(await inspect(page)).toEqual([]);

    // The API asks the key to confirm another decision than the one the page built: the key is never asked.
    const [options, posted] = [fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed, sent()];
    fixtures.state.mismatchNextStepUp = true;
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(composer.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: messageFor("step_up_mismatch") }));
    expect(fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed).toBe(options + 1);
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    expect(sent()).toBe(posted);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions).toHaveLength(1);
    // The confirmation saved nothing more: both texts were on the server before it. What was chosen and written is still there.
    expect(fixtures.state.texts).toHaveLength(saved + 2);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Facts").inputValue()).toBe(TYPED_FACTS);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.remove.label, { exact: true }).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    await clean();

    // Confirmed again, with options that bind the decision itself: the saved texts are used as they are.
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(page.getByText(COMPOSER.recorded));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    expect(sent()).toBe(posted + 1);
    expect(fixtures.state.texts).toHaveLength(saved + 2);
    const [facts, reason] = fixtures.state.texts.slice(-2);
    expect(facts).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_POST, kind: "facts", text: TYPED_FACTS });
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions[1]).toMatchObject({
      caseId: CASE_POST,
      // 3e: the case answer says a strike is due, so the key confirmed it with the removal.
      params: { kind: "final", stateVersion: 4, throughSeq: 2, reviewsDecisionId: null, outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC", categoryKeyword: null, actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }, { kind: "strike", mediaId: null }], factsDigest: facts!.digest, reasonDigest: reason!.digest, legalReferenceDigest: null },
    });
    // The answer is the case as it now stands: closed, with nothing more to decide on it.
    await shown(page.getByText("; closed ", { exact: false }));
    await shown(page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" }).getByText(COMPOSER.closed));
    expect(await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" }).count()).toBe(0);
    await texts();
    await clean();
  });

    fixtures.state.role = "admin";
    await page.goto(`${origin}/cases/${CASE_ADMIN}`);
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    const composer = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    const confirm = composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" });
    // The outcome comes first, with every outcome an admin may decide; beside them, that an answer now is given unseen.
    expect(await composer.locator("fieldset legend").first().textContent()).toBe("Outcome");
    for (const outcome of Object.values(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES)) expect(await composer.getByLabel(outcome, { exact: true }).count(), outcome).toBe(1);
    expect(await composer.getByText(COMPOSER.adminFinal).count()).toBe(0);
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.unseen));
    // While deciding, the seal and the choice not to seal stand side by side.
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_KINDS.interim).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    await shown(composer.getByRole("button", { name: MEASURES.seal_media.label }));
    await shown(composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Do not seal now" }));
    // Deciding the case, an admin seals for good or answers without a seal: the choice not to seal is not offered.
    await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_KINDS.final).check();
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.admin.endsFreeze));
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.admin.unseen));
    await shown(composer.getByRole("button", { name: MEASURES.seal_media.label }));
    expect(await composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Do not seal now" }).count()).toBe(0);

    // An answer without a measure: no kind is asked, the category the key will confirm is shown, and the facts are needed.
    await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.no_violation, { exact: true }).check();
    expect(await composer.locator("legend", { hasText: "When" }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await composer.locator("legend", { hasText: "Measures" }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Ground").count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Do not seal now" }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Category").inputValue()).toBe("STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC");
    await composer.getByLabel("Category").selectOption("STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    // Under both fields: never to say what the images are, and that the author never receives the text.
    expect(await composer.getByText(COMPOSER.neverWrite, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(2);
    expect(await composer.getByText(`${COMPOSER_WORDS.personalDataRule} ${COMPOSER_WORDS.staysInRecord}`, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(2);
    expect(await composer.getByText(COMPOSER_WORDS.toAuthor, { exact: false }).count()).toBe(0);
    // Nothing was done while deciding on this case, so the answer is told to nobody, and the page says so in the preview's place.
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER_WORDS.noStatement));
    expect(await composer.locator(".frame.preview").count()).toBe(0);
    const saved = fixtures.state.texts.length;
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill("Nothing in the report or in the post supports it.");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").fill(TYPED_ADMIN_FACTS);
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);
    // Each text is saved, without the key, when its field loses focus.
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => fixtures.state.texts.length === saved + 2, "the reason and the facts saved when their fields lost focus");
    const written = (kind: string) => fixtures.state.texts.slice(saved).find((text) => text.kind === kind)!;
    expect(written("facts")).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_ADMIN, text: TYPED_ADMIN_FACTS });
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    await clean();

    await confirm.click();
    // The answer reaches the newest report of child sexual abuse material: the rule report that arrived after it stays open.
    await shown(page.getByText(`${COMPOSER.recorded} ${COMPOSER.leftForLater(1)}`));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    expect(fixtures.state.texts).toHaveLength(saved + 2);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions.at(-1)).toMatchObject({
      caseId: CASE_ADMIN,
      params: { kind: "final", stateVersion: 3, throughSeq: 2, reviewsDecisionId: null, outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS", categoryKeyword: null, actions: [], factsDigest: written("facts").digest, reasonDigest: written("reason").digest, legalReferenceDigest: null },
    });
    // The case as the answer gave it: the answer with its facts, for staff, and a composer for the report left open.
    await shown(page.getByText("; version 4", { exact: false }));
    expect(await texts()).toContain(TYPED_ADMIN_FACTS);
    const after = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    expect(await after.getByText(COMPOSER.neverWrite, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await after.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.no_violation, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(1);
    expect(await after.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.not_evident, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(fixtures.state.imageRequests).toHaveLength(asked);
    expect(await page.locator("img").count()).toBe(0);
    // The steps that follow are a moderator's again: each opens its page anew, and reads who is signed in.
    fixtures.state.role = "moderator";
    await clean();
  });

  test("a case that another staff member decided meanwhile: a save that failed is worded under its field and made again by the confirmation, the refusal is worded in place, the case is read again with the draft kept, and confirmed again the decision is recorded without a text saved twice", async () => {

    // One image withheld while deciding: a measure that still stands once another staff member has hidden the post.

    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill(REASON);

    fixtures.state.refuseNextSave = "rate_limited";

    await shown(composer.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: NOTE_WORDS.rate_limited }));
    expect(requests("POST", "/texts")).toEqual([201, 429]);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).inputValue()).toBe(REASON);
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);
    await clean();

    // Another staff member withholds the post while this page still shows the case as it read it.
    fixtures.decideBehindThePage(CASE_CHANGED);
    const read = requests("GET", "").length;
    await confirm.click();
    // The confirmation saved the reason, the key signed the decision the page showed, and the API refused it: in place.
    await shown(composer.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: messageFor("case_changed") }));
    expect(requests("POST", "/texts")).toEqual([201, 429, 201]);
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    expect(requests("POST", "/decisions")).toEqual([409]);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions.filter((made) => made.caseId === CASE_CHANGED)).toEqual([]);
    // The page read the case again, once: the other decision is on it, and the composer follows the case as it now stands.
    await arrived(() => requests("GET", "").length === read + 1, "the case read again");
    await shown(page.getByText("; version 2", { exact: false }));
    expect(await texts()).toContain(OTHER_STAFF);
    // The case hides the post now: a second withhold of the post is not offered, and the image measure changes nothing now.
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.alreadyHidden));
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.withhold.label, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(0);
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.noEffect));
    expect(await composer.locator(".frame.preview p.frame-text").first().textContent()).toBe(`${STATEMENT_WORDS.done.withhold_media("2026-09-30 12:00 UTC")} ${STATEMENT_WORDS.already("image")}`);
    // The refusal's words stay, the reason's own refusal is gone now that it is saved, and the draft is as its person left it.
    await shown(composer.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: messageFor("case_changed") }));
    expect(await composer.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: NOTE_WORDS.rate_limited }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Facts").inputValue()).toBe(TYPED_CHANGED_FACTS);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).inputValue()).toBe(REASON);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.withhold_media.label, { exact: true }).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    expect(requests("GET", "")).toHaveLength(read + 1);
    await clean();

    // Confirmed again, on the version the page now shows: the texts are used as they were saved.
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(page.getByText(COMPOSER.recorded));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 2);
    expect(requests("POST", "/texts")).toEqual([201, 429, 201]);
    expect(requests("POST", "/decisions")).toEqual([409, 201]);
    const mine = fixtures.state.texts.filter((text) => text.caseId === CASE_CHANGED);
    expect(mine.map((text) => [text.kind, text.text])).toEqual([
      ["facts", TYPED_CHANGED_FACTS],
      ["reason", REASON],
    ]);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions.at(-1)).toMatchObject({
      caseId: CASE_CHANGED,
      params: { kind: "interim", stateVersion: 2, throughSeq: 0, outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1", actions: [{ kind: "withhold_media", mediaId: IMAGE_ONE }], factsDigest: mine[0]!.digest, reasonDigest: mine[1]!.digest, legalReferenceDigest: null },
    });
    await shown(page.getByText("; version 3", { exact: false }));
    expect(await page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" }).getByRole("alert").count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await texts()).toContain(TYPED_CHANGED_FACTS);
    await clean();
  });

  test("a draft's texts come back after a reload: each was saved when its field lost focus, a refused save is worded under its field with the text kept, a saved text is restored with its digest, one answered with other words under its digest is dropped, and the decision names the text saved before the reload", async () => {
    const [before, options] = [await signatures(), fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed];
    const QUOTING = 'The reporter wrote "this account spams one link everywhere".';
    const REASON = "The post repeats one link, which the rule names.";
    const saves = () => fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.method === "POST" && r.path === `/api/staff/cases/${CASE_DRAFTS}/texts`).map((r) => r.status);
    const mine = () => fixtures.state.texts.filter((text) => text.caseId === CASE_DRAFTS);
    await page.goto(`${origin}/cases/${CASE_DRAFTS}`);
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    const composer = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").fill(TYPED_DRAFT_FACTS);
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => mine().length === 1, "the facts saved when their field lost focus");
    expect(mine()[0]).toMatchObject({ kind: "facts", text: TYPED_DRAFT_FACTS });
    // A text that quotes what someone wrote about the case is refused where it was written, and nothing of it is lost.
    fixtures.state.refuseNextSave = "text_quotes_user";
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill(QUOTING);
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).press("Tab");
    await shown(composer.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: messageFor("text_quotes_user") }));
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).inputValue()).toBe(QUOTING);
    expect(saves()).toEqual([201, 422]);
    expect(mine()).toHaveLength(1);
    // Written again in the person's own words, the refusal's words go, and the text is saved when its field loses focus.
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill(REASON);
    await composer.getByRole("alert").waitFor({ state: "detached" });
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => mine().length === 2, "the reason saved when its field lost focus");
    expect(mine()[1]).toMatchObject({ kind: "reason", text: REASON });
    // No key was asked for any of it.
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    expect(fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed).toBe(options);
    await clean();

    // A reload before any confirmation: the case's answer brings the saved texts back. This one answers the reason with
    // other words under the digest of what was saved: the page holds each text to its digest, and drops that one.
    fixtures.state.forgedDraft = { caseId: CASE_DRAFTS, kind: "reason" };
    await page.goto(`${origin}/cases/${CASE_DRAFTS}`);
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    const again = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    await shown(again);
    expect(await again.getByLabel("Facts").inputValue()).toBe(TYPED_DRAFT_FACTS);
    expect(await again.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).inputValue()).toBe("");
    expect(await page.content()).not.toContain(FORGED_DRAFT);
    expect(saves()).toEqual([201, 422, 201]);
    await clean();

    // A measure and a reason later the key confirms the decision. The click that confirms takes the focus from the
    // reason's field: that save ends first, the confirmation saves nothing, and the facts are the ones saved before the reload.
    await again.getByLabel(MEASURES.withhold.label, { exact: true }).check();
    await again.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill(REASON);
    await again.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" }).click();
    await shown(page.getByText(COMPOSER.recorded));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    expect(saves()).toEqual([201, 422, 201, 201]);
    expect(mine().map((text) => text.kind)).toEqual(["facts", "reason", "reason"]);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions.at(-1)).toMatchObject({
      caseId: CASE_DRAFTS,
      params: { kind: "interim", stateVersion: 1, throughSeq: 0, outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1", actions: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null }], factsDigest: mine()[0]!.digest, reasonDigest: mine()[2]!.digest, legalReferenceDigest: null },
    });
    fixtures.state.forgedDraft = null;
    expect(await texts()).toContain(TYPED_DRAFT_FACTS);
    await clean();
  });

    // What the key confirmed is the review the page showed: of that decision, answering that appeal, with that reversal

    expect(await page.locator("table.queue tbody tr").count()).toBe(1);
    await clean();
  });

  test("a post decision signs the strike the case answer says is due: the author's standing in bands above the evidence, the strike line under Restrict, the preview's strike, and the key confirming the removal with its strike", async () => {

    await shown(composer.getByText(STANDING_WORDS.strike.none.interim, { exact: true }));
    await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_KINDS.final).check();

  test("every request the walk sent was its person's own, marked, and every string the fixtures wrote was shown as text", () => {
    expect(watcher.take()).toEqual([]);

    // while it is open, unmarked so that it never keeps a session alive (should a step of the walk ever last that long).
    // Every other request was the person's own.
    const pagesOwn = (r: { method: string; path: string }) => IMAGE_PATH.test(r.path) || (r.method === "GET" && (r.path === "/api/staff/queue" || r.path.startsWith("/api/staff/queue?")));
    expect(fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => !r.activity && !pagesOwn(r))).toEqual([]);
    expect(fixtures.state.problems).toEqual([]);
    expect(HOSTILE_TEXTS.filter((text) => !seen.has(text))).toEqual([]);
```

```ts
/**

export function frozenCase(overrides: Partial<CaseView> = {}): CaseView {

/** An account's case that holds an unanswered suspect item and reaches no image: an account case never shows one. */
export function accountCase(overrides: Partial<CaseView> = {}): CaseView {

/**
 * An account's case that holds an unanswered report of child sexual abuse material and reaches images that are still
 * served: the seal and "Do not seal now" are offered on it. Its newest snapshot holds the account's fields as they read
 * now, so nothing asks for a fresh one.
 */
export function sealableCase(id: string, accountId: string): CaseView {
  const fields = { handle: "an_account", displayName: HOSTILE.quote, bio: LOOKALIKE.label };
  const base = accountCase();
  const [copied] = base.snapshots;
  if (!copied || copied.withheld) throw new Error("the account case's snapshot shows its content");
  return accountCase({
    id,
    target: { type: "account", id: accountId, ...fields, deleted: false },
    suspicion: { open: true, reach: { posts: 2, images: 3, sealed: 0, served: 3, newestPostOn: "2026-09-30" }, earlier: { target: { count: 0, lastOn: null, imagesOpenedOn: null }, author: { count: 0, lastOn: null } } },
    snapshots: [{ ...copied, id: accountId.replace(/^.{8}/, "5a5a5a5a"), targetId: accountId, authorHandle: fields.handle, ...fields }],
    // An item of its own, so that no two fixture cases hold the same one.
    items: base.items.map((each) => ({ ...each, id: accountId.replace(/^.{8}/, "6b6b6b6b") })),
    history: [],
  });
}

 */
export function adminCase(): CaseView {

}

/** A post's case in lane 2 that holds one rule report and nothing else: no decision, no note, an item of its own. */

/** 3e: an account case's standing with nothing on the record: no strike, nothing live, and the snapshot's handle not retired. */
export const NO_ACCOUNT_STANDING: CaseStanding = {
  activeStrikes: 0,
  strikes: [],

/**
 * 3e: an account's case in lane 2 that holds one rule report under R4 about its handle, unanswered, with a snapshot
 * whose handle is the one the profile holds now unless told otherwise, and the account's standing. `live` is the handle
 * the profile holds now; `snapped` the one the newest snapshot copied.
 */
export function retireCase(live = "Ada_L", snapped = "Ada_L", standing: Partial<CaseStanding> = {}): CaseView {
  const base = accountCase();
  const [copied] = base.snapshots;
  if (!copied || copied.withheld) throw new Error("the account case's snapshot shows its content");
  return accountCase({
    id: CASE_RETIRE,
    lane: 2,
    stateVersion: 1,
    intakeSeq: 1,
    suspicion: null,
    target: { type: "account", id: ACCOUNT_ID, handle: live, displayName: "Ada", bio: "", deleted: false },
    snapshots: [{ ...copied, authorHandle: snapped, handle: snapped, displayName: "Ada", bio: "" }],
    items: [item({ id: ITEM_RETIRE, ruleId: "R4", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS", link: "http://localhost:8081/u/ada_l" })],
    history: [],
    standing: { ...NO_ACCOUNT_STANDING, ...standing },
  });
}

// 3e Task 3 (design, section 8.3): an account case on an admin's own finding, where a suspension at once is decided.
export const CASE_AT_ONCE = "8a9b0c1d-2e3f-4a5b-9c6d-7e8f9a0b1c2d";
export const ITEM_AT_ONCE = "9b0c1d2e-3f4a-4b5c-8d6e-8f9a0b1c2d3e";

/**
 * 3e Task 3: an account's case that holds an admin's own finding under R5, unanswered (no report waits, so a measure that
 * answers findings only is open), with the account's standing: the grounds of a suspension at once that the database
 * would accept now (`atOnce`), and the decisions each would rest on. A test passes what differs.
 */
export function atOnceCase(standing: Partial<CaseStanding> = {}, rule: "R2" | "R5" | "R6" = "R5"): CaseView {
  return accountCase({
    id: CASE_AT_ONCE,
    lane: 1,
    stateVersion: 1,
    intakeSeq: 1,
    suspicion: rule === "R2" ? accountCase().suspicion : null,
    target: { type: "account", id: ACCOUNT_ID, handle: "flood_er", displayName: "Flooder", bio: "", deleted: false },
    items: [item({ id: ITEM_AT_ONCE, ruleId: rule, suspect: rule === "R2", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC", link: "http://localhost:8081/u/flood_er", explanation: null, source: SOURCES.staff })],
    history: [],
    standing: {
      ...NO_ACCOUNT_STANDING,
      openReports: false,
      atOnce: ["threat", "flood"],
      flood: { posts: 23, from: "2026-10-12T08:30:00.000Z", to: "2026-10-12T09:30:00.000Z" },
      basisDecidedAt: { threat: "2026-10-10T08:00:00.000Z", terrorist: null, protective: null },
      ...standing,
    },
  });
}
```

```ts
import { mkdtempSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";

import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import pino from "pino";
import { HealthResponse } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { createDb } from "@korbat/db";
import { createAccount } from "../src/account";
import { createApp } from "../src/app";
import { AuthError, createAuth } from "../src/auth";
import { MemoryKv } from "../src/auth/kv";
import { loadConfig } from "../src/config";
import { MemoryMailer } from "../src/mail/memory";
import { createMedia } from "../src/media";
import { MemoryStore } from "../src/middleware/rate-limit";
import { createSocial } from "../src/social";

const key = Buffer.alloc(32, 7).toString("base64");

const config = loadConfig({
  DATABASE_URL_API: "postgres://a:b@localhost:55432/k",
  DATABASE_URL_AUTH: "postgres://a:b@localhost:55432/k",
  REDIS_URL: "redis://localhost:56379",
  KORBAT_VERSION: "9.9.9",
  APP_ORIGIN: "http://localhost:8081",
  AUTH_HMAC_KEY: key,
  IP_HASH_KEY: key,
  TOTP_ENC_KEY: `v1:${key}`,
  NOTIFIER_ENC_KEY: `v1:${key}`,
  TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY: "1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA",
  SMTP_URL: "smtp://localhost:1025",
  MAIL_FROM: "korbat <no-reply@korbat.local>",
  TERMS_VERSION: "draft-2026-09",
});

const mediaRoot = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "korbat-app-test-"));

/** The real app with every module; the database pools are created but never connect in these tests. */
function app(checks: Record<string, () => Promise<void>>, advisoryChecks?: Record<string, () => Promise<void>>) {
  const logger = pino({ level: "silent" });
  const rateLimitStore = new MemoryStore();
  const auth = createAuth({
    config,
    logger,
    authDb: createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 1 }),
    kv: new MemoryKv(),
    mailer: new MemoryMailer(),
    profiles: { create: async () => ({ ok: false, reason: "handle_taken" }), find: async () => null, setVerified: async () => true, suspended: async () => false },
  });
  const apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 1 });
  const social = createSocial({ apiDb, rateLimitStore, logger, requireSession: auth.requireSession, requireFreshAuth: auth.requireFreshAuth() });
  const media = createMedia({
    apiDb,
    uploadsDir: path.join(mediaRoot, "uploads"),
    storeDir: path.join(mediaRoot, "store"),
    formats: config.MEDIA_FORMATS,
    minFreeBytes: 0,
    logger,
    requireSession: auth.requireSession,
    resolveSession: auth.resolveSession,
    rateLimitStore,
    enforceUploadLimit: async () => undefined,
  });
  const account = createAccount({
    auth: auth.forAccount,
    social: social.forAccount,
    media: media.forAccount,
    requireSession: auth.requireSession,
    requireFreshAuth: auth.requireFreshAuth(),
    requireStrongFreshAuth: auth.requireStrongFreshAuth(),
    rateLimitStore,
    logger,
  });
  return createApp({ config, logger, rateLimitStore, healthChecks: checks, advisoryChecks, auth, social, media, account });
}

describe("GET /api/health", () => {
  test("200 ok when all checks pass", async () => {
    const res = await app({ postgres: async () => {}, redis: async () => {} }).request("/api/health");
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    const body = HealthResponse.parse(await res.json());
    expect(body).toEqual({ status: "ok", version: "9.9.9", checks: { postgres: "ok", redis: "ok" } });
  });
  test("503 degraded when a check throws", async () => {
    const res = await app({ postgres: async () => { throw new Error("down"); }, redis: async () => {} }).request("/api/health");
    expect(res.status).toBe(503);
    expect(HealthResponse.parse(await res.json()).checks).toEqual({ postgres: "fail", redis: "ok" });
  });
});

describe("advisory health checks", () => {
  const down = async () => {
    throw new Error("stale heartbeat");
  };
  test("a failing advisory check is reported as degraded, with status 200", async () => {
    const res = await app({ postgres: async () => {} }, { image_worker: down }).request("/api/health");
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(HealthResponse.parse(await res.json())).toEqual({ status: "degraded", version: "9.9.9", checks: { postgres: "ok", image_worker: "fail" } });
  });
  test("a failing critical check is still 503, whatever the advisory ones say", async () => {
    const res = await app({ postgres: down }, { image_worker: async () => {} }).request("/api/health");
    expect(res.status).toBe(503);
    expect(HealthResponse.parse(await res.json()).checks).toEqual({ postgres: "fail", image_worker: "ok" });
  });
});

describe("caching", () => {
  test("responses are no-store unless the handler set its own Cache-Control", async () => {
    const a = app({});
    a.get("/api/cached", (c) => {
      c.header("Cache-Control", "public, max-age=300");
```

```ts
import { readdirSync, readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join, posix, relative, sep } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";

/**
 * Module boundaries (1a spec section 2.2, 2a spec section 2.2, 3a design section 5, 3c design section 5). Paths are relative to apps/api/src
 * with forward slashes. The rules are plain functions so the tests below can prove each one catches
 * a deliberate violation.
 */
interface SourceFile {
  path: string;
  source: string;
}

const SRC_ROOT = fileURLToPath(new URL("../src", import.meta.url));
const SCHEMA_ROOT = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../../packages/db/src/schema", import.meta.url));

/** Schema files that define auth-schema objects or shared helpers; every other schema file is public. */
const NON_PUBLIC_SCHEMA_FILES = new Set(["auth.ts", "helpers.ts", "index.ts"]);
const AUTH_SCHEMA_FILE = "auth.ts";
// The command lines open both pools: grant-role changes a role on the auth pool, and staff.js reads there the staff keys
// that audit-verify checks the record against.
const AUTH_POOL_ALLOWED = new Set(["config.ts", "index.ts", "cli/grant-role.ts", "cli/staff.ts"]);
const AUTH_KEYS_ALLOWED = new Set(["config.ts"]);

/** Modules that may only be entered through their index file. */
const MODULES = ["auth", "social", "media", "account", "staff", "moderation"] as const;

function walk(dir: string): string[] {
  return readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap((entry) => {
    const full = join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) return walk(full);
    return entry.name.endsWith(".ts") ? [full] : [];
  });
}

function loadSources(): SourceFile[] {
  return walk(SRC_ROOT).map((full) => ({ path: relative(SRC_ROOT, full).split(sep).join("/"), source: readFileSync(full, "utf8") }));
}

function exportedNames(file: string): string[] {
  const source = readFileSync(join(SCHEMA_ROOT, file), "utf8");
  return [...source.matchAll(/^export (?:const|function|type|interface|enum) ([A-Za-z0-9_]+)/gm)].map((m) => m[1]!);
}

/** Names exported by the public-schema files of @korbat/db (tables and enums the auth module must not touch). */
function publicSchemaNames(): Set<string> {
  const names = new Set<string>();
  for (const file of readdirSync(SCHEMA_ROOT)) {
    if (!file.endsWith(".ts") || NON_PUBLIC_SCHEMA_FILES.has(file)) continue;
    for (const name of exportedNames(file)) names.add(name);
  }
  return names;
}

/** Names exported by the auth-schema file of @korbat/db (tables and enums the social module must not touch). */
function authSchemaNames(): Set<string> {
  return new Set(exportedNames(AUTH_SCHEMA_FILE));
}

/** Every module specifier in static imports, re-exports, side-effect imports and dynamic imports. */
function specifiers(source: string): string[] {
  return [...source.matchAll(/(?:\bfrom\s+|\bimport\s*\(\s*|\bimport\s+)["']([^"']+)["']/g)].map((m) => m[1]!);
}

/** Named bindings of every `import { ... } from "@korbat/db"`; a namespace import yields the marker "*". */
function dbImports(source: string): string[] {
  const names: string[] = [];
  for (const match of source.matchAll(/\bimport\s+(type\s+)?(\*\s+as\s+\w+|\{[^}]*\})\s+from\s+["'](@korbat\/db(?:\/[^"']*)?)["']/g)) {
    const bindings = match[2]!;
    if (bindings.startsWith("*")) {
      names.push("*");
      continue;
    }
    for (const part of bindings.slice(1, -1).split(",")) {
      const name = part.trim().replace(/^type\s+/, "").split(/\s+as\s+/)[0]!.trim();
      if (name) names.push(name);
    }
  }
  return names;
}

const insideAuth = (path: string) => path.startsWith("auth/");
const insideSocial = (path: string) => path.startsWith("social/");
const insideMedia = (path: string) => path.startsWith("media/");
const insideAccount = (path: string) => path.startsWith("account/");
const insideStaff = (path: string) => path.startsWith("staff/");
const insideModeration = (path: string) => path.startsWith("moderation/");

function findViolations(files: SourceFile[], publicNames: Set<string>, authNames: Set<string>): string[] {
  const violations: string[] = [];
  for (const { path, source } of files) {
    for (const spec of specifiers(source)) {
      if (!spec.startsWith(".")) continue;
      const target = posix.normalize(posix.join(posix.dirname(path), spec)).replace(/\.ts$/, "");
      for (const module of MODULES) {
        if (path.startsWith(`${module}/`)) continue;
        if (target.startsWith(`${module}/`) && target !== `${module}/index`) {
          violations.push(`${path}: imports ${spec}, which is inside the ${module} module (use ./${module})`);
        }
      }
    }
    if (!insideAuth(path) && !AUTH_POOL_ALLOWED.has(path) && /\b(DATABASE_URL_AUTH|authDb)\b/.test(source)) {
      violations.push(`${path}: references the auth database pool`);
    }
    // Each encryption key with the list of the keys it replaced: after a rotation those still open what was stored before it.
    if (!insideAuth(path) && !AUTH_KEYS_ALLOWED.has(path) && /\b(TOTP_ENC_KEY|TOTP_ENC_KEYS_PREVIOUS|NOTIFIER_ENC_KEY|NOTIFIER_ENC_KEYS_PREVIOUS|AUTH_HMAC_KEY|IP_HASH_KEY)\b/.test(source)) {
      violations.push(`${path}: references an auth key`);
    }
    if (insideAuth(path)) {
      for (const name of dbImports(source)) {
        if (name === "*") violations.push(`${path}: namespace import of @korbat/db (import auth-schema names explicitly)`);
        else if (publicNames.has(name)) violations.push(`${path}: imports public-schema ${name} from @korbat/db`);
      }
    }
    if (!insideMedia(path) && /\b(postMedia|post_media)\b/.test(source)) {
      violations.push(`${path}: references post_media, which only the media module may touch`);
    }
    // The staff module (role korbat_api) reads and writes the public audit log; staff keys, staff sessions and enrolments
    // are credentials, the auth module's alone (3a design, section 5). The moderation module owns the moderation tables on
    // the same role: a notifier's contact and the staff links live in the auth schema, out of its reach (3c design, section 5).
    if (insideSocial(path) || insideMedia(path) || insideStaff(path) || insideModeration(path)) {
      for (const name of dbImports(source)) {
        if (name === "*") violations.push(`${path}: namespace import of @korbat/db (import public-schema names explicitly)`);
        else if (authNames.has(name)) violations.push(`${path}: imports auth-schema ${name} from @korbat/db`);
      }
    }
    // The account module sequences the other three through their index files and holds no table access of its own
    // (1b spec, section 5): no table or enum of either schema may be named in it. Db and DbTx, which are not schema
    // names, stay allowed, since a transaction is passed through it.
    if (insideAccount(path)) {
      for (const name of dbImports(source)) {
        if (name === "*") violations.push(`${path}: namespace import of @korbat/db (the account module holds no table access)`);
        else if (publicNames.has(name)) violations.push(`${path}: imports public-schema ${name} from @korbat/db (the account module holds no table access)`);
        else if (authNames.has(name)) violations.push(`${path}: imports auth-schema ${name} from @korbat/db (the account module holds no table access)`);
      }
    }
    // The staff module uses the auth module's interface as the other modules do, never its repository or its session
    // store, which would hand it the auth tables; the moderation module likewise. Any mention counts, so a renamed,
    // namespace or dynamic import is caught as surely as a named one.
    if (insideStaff(path) || insideModeration(path)) {
      const module = insideStaff(path) ? "staff" : "moderation";
      for (const name of new Set([...source.matchAll(/\b(createAuthRepo|createSessions)\b/g)].map((m) => m[1]!))) {
        violations.push(`${path}: uses the auth module's ${name} (the ${module} module goes through the auth module's interface)`);
      }
    }
  }
  return violations;
}

/**
 * The source pins of the freeze (3c design, sections 6.1 and 6.5). The freeze of the path for suspected child sexual abuse
 * material holds only while every path of a kind passes one gate, so who may name what is pinned here, beside the
 * database's own pins of who names the predicate there:
 *   - `post_frozen` is named only in the media repository and the moderation repository, and `frozen_for` nowhere in the
 *     API: no other file decides by itself what is frozen;
 *   - a delete of `post_media` is written only in the media repository, whose every delete the keep trigger judges and
 *     whose every answer names only rows that are gone;
 *   - `requestDeletion` (asking the worker to delete an image's files) and `openImage` (opening an image file of the
 *     store) are named in a pinned list of files, each a pinned number of times, comments included: a new caller of
 *     either fails the test until whoever adds it has checked it against the gates and listed it.
 */
const POST_FROZEN_ALLOWED = new Set(["media/repo.ts", "moderation/repo.ts"]);
const POST_MEDIA_DELETE_ALLOWED = new Set(["media/repo.ts"]);
const POST_MEDIA_DELETE = /\bdelete\s+from\s+(?:only\s+)?(?:"?public"?\s*\.\s*)?"?post_media\b|\btruncate\b[^;`]*\bpost_media\b|\.delete\(\s*postMedia\b/i;

function findFreezeViolations(files: SourceFile[]): string[] {
  const violations: string[] = [];
  for (const { path, source } of files) {
    if (/\bfrozen_for\b/.test(source)) violations.push(`${path}: names frozen_for, which only the database's own functions name`);
    if (/\bpost_frozen\b/.test(source) && !POST_FROZEN_ALLOWED.has(path)) violations.push(`${path}: names post_frozen, which only the media and moderation repositories may`);
    if (POST_MEDIA_DELETE.test(source) && !POST_MEDIA_DELETE_ALLOWED.has(path)) violations.push(`${path}: deletes from post_media, which only the media repository may`);
  }
  return violations;
}

/** Every file that names `name` as a whole word, with how often, comments included. */
function mentions(files: SourceFile[], name: string): Record<string, number> {
  const found: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const { path, source } of files) {
    // Cut at every word boundary: a whole word is then a piece of its own.
    const count = source.split(/\b/).filter((piece) => piece === name).length;
    if (count > 0) found[path] = count;
  }
  return found;
}

/**
 * Where `requestDeletion` is named. A deletion request names an id that a delete of post_media answered, an upload that
 * failed before it could be put on a post, or a file that has no row: the files module writes the request; the upload's
 * removal, the sweeper, the author's deletion (after its commit), the account's purge (after its commit) and the
 * disposal's caller (after its commit) ask for it through the module's interfaces; and the one retry of what the purge
 * and the disposal owe asks for it only for a row that is gone.
 */
const REQUEST_DELETION = {
  "account/flows/deletion.ts": 1,
  "media/cases.ts": 4,
  "media/context.ts": 2,
  "media/files.ts": 1,
  "media/flows/remove.ts": 1,
  "media/index.ts": 5,
  // The retry of owed deletions, which asks only for ids whose row it found gone.
  "media/owed.ts": 1,
  "media/sweeper.ts": 2,
  // The retention job, which asks for a batch's files after the commit of the transaction that deleted their rows.
  "moderation/retention.ts": 1,
  "social/context.ts": 1,
  "social/flows/posts.ts": 1,
};

/**
 * Where `openImage` is named: the files module, which opens a file of the store under its checks, and its three callers,
 * each behind its own reader's rule: serve (gate S), the export's open (which reads the row again) and the staff's image
 * (gate V).
 */
const OPEN_IMAGE = {
  "media/cases.ts": 1,
  "media/files.ts": 1,
  "media/flows/serve.ts": 1,
  "media/index.ts": 1,
};

describe("the freeze's source pins", () => {
  test("apps/api/src names post_frozen only in the two repositories, frozen_for nowhere, and deletes from post_media only in the media repository", () => {
    expect(findFreezeViolations(loadSources())).toEqual([]);
    // The media repository does name the predicate and does delete: the pins are about a file that exists.
    const repo = loadSources().find((file) => file.path === "media/repo.ts")!;
    expect(repo.source).toMatch(/\bpost_frozen\b/);
    expect(POST_MEDIA_DELETE.test(repo.source)).toBe(true);
  });

  test("catches the predicate named outside the two repositories, and its core named anywhere", () => {
    const files: SourceFile[] = [
      { path: "media/repo.ts", source: "sql`select public.post_frozen(m.post_id) as frozen from post_media m`" },
      { path: "moderation/repo.ts", source: "sql`select not public.post_frozen(${postId}::uuid) as images_allowed`" },
      { path: "moderation/cases.ts", source: "const [row] = await tx.execute(sql`select public.post_frozen(${postId}::uuid) as frozen`);" },
      { path: "media/flows/serve.ts", source: "const frozen = await db.execute(sql`select post_frozen(${postId})`);" },
      { path: "staff/cases.ts", source: "await db.execute(sql`select public.frozen_for(${postId}::uuid, ${authorId}::uuid)`);" },
      { path: "media/repo.ts", source: "sql`select public.frozen_for(m.post_id, m.owner_id) from post_media m`" },
      // Another word that only contains the name is not the name.
      { path: "social/views.ts", source: "const post_frozen_label = 1; const unfrozen_for_now = 2;" },
    ];
    expect(findFreezeViolations(files)).toEqual([
      "moderation/cases.ts: names post_frozen, which only the media and moderation repositories may",
      "media/flows/serve.ts: names post_frozen, which only the media and moderation repositories may",
      "staff/cases.ts: names frozen_for, which only the database's own functions name",
      "media/repo.ts: names frozen_for, which only the database's own functions name",
    ]);
  });

  test("catches a delete of post_media outside the media repository, in SQL and through the query builder", () => {
    const files: SourceFile[] = [
      { path: "media/repo.ts", source: "await tx.execute(sql`delete from post_media where id in (select id from post_media where post_id = ${postId}::uuid order by id for update) returning id`);\nawait db.delete(postMedia).where(eq(postMedia.id, id));" },
      { path: "media/sweeper.ts", source: "await db.execute(sql`delete from post_media where post_id is null and created_at < ${before}`);" },
      { path: "media/flows/remove.ts", source: "await deps.db.delete(postMedia).where(eq(postMedia.id, id));" },
      { path: "media/cases.ts", source: 'await tx.execute(sql`DELETE FROM "public"."post_media" WHERE "id" = ${id}`);' },
      { path: "media/index.ts", source: "await tx.execute(sql`truncate table post_media cascade`);" },
      // Reading and updating image rows, and deleting something else, is not a delete of image rows.
      { path: "media/flows/status.ts", source: "await db.update(postMedia).set({ status }).where(eq(postMedia.id, id));\nawait db.delete(posts).where(eq(posts.id, id));\nconst rows = await db.execute(sql`select id from post_media`);" },
    ];
    expect(findFreezeViolations(files)).toEqual([
      "media/sweeper.ts: deletes from post_media, which only the media repository may",
      "media/flows/remove.ts: deletes from post_media, which only the media repository may",
      "media/cases.ts: deletes from post_media, which only the media repository may",
      "media/index.ts: deletes from post_media, which only the media repository may",
    ]);
  });

  test("requestDeletion and openImage are named in exactly the pinned files, each the pinned number of times", () => {
    expect(mentions(loadSources(), "requestDeletion")).toEqual(REQUEST_DELETION);
    expect(mentions(loadSources(), "openImage")).toEqual(OPEN_IMAGE);
  });

  test("catches a new caller of either, in a file of the list and in one outside it", () => {
    const real = loadSources();
    // A second request in the purge's flow, and a first one in a file that had none.
    const withCallers = real
      .map((file) => (file.path === "account/flows/deletion.ts" ? { ...file, source: `${file.source}\nawait deps.media.requestDeletion(kept);` } : file))
      .concat([{ path: "moderation/decide.ts", source: "await deps.media.requestDeletion(ids);" }]);
    expect(mentions(withCallers, "requestDeletion")).not.toEqual(REQUEST_DELETION);
    expect(mentions(withCallers, "requestDeletion")).toMatchObject({ "account/flows/deletion.ts": 2, "moderation/decide.ts": 1 });
    // A fourth opener of the store's files.
    const withOpener = real.concat([{ path: "staff/cases.ts", source: 'const file = await files.openImage(id, "large");' }]);
    expect(mentions(withOpener, "openImage")).not.toEqual(OPEN_IMAGE);
    // A name that only contains the word is not counted.
    expect(mentions([{ path: "x.ts", source: "requestDeletions(); reopenImage(); openImages();" }], "requestDeletion")).toEqual({});
    expect(mentions([{ path: "x.ts", source: "requestDeletions(); reopenImage(); openImages();" }], "openImage")).toEqual({});
  });
});

/**
 * The source pins of account sanctions (3e design, sections 11 and 12.2; invariant 23): no write of an account is added
 * without the one predicate.
 *   - The predicate's three fragments, exported by lib/standing.ts (`liveNotSuspended`, and the two halves that a locking
 *     statement answers separately, `suspendedAt` and `reportsRestrictedAt`), are named in a pinned list of files, each a
 *     pinned number of times, comments included, as REQUEST_DELETION is: whoever adds a write on behalf of an account adds
 *     its site to the list, and the auth module never names one.
 *   - The profile's three derived columns are named in apps/api/src only in lib/standing.ts, social/repo.ts's
 *     lockAccounts and the moderation module's standing-repo.ts, in SQL or by drizzle's names: no other file decides by
 *     itself whether an account is suspended. Their one writer is the database's standing_apply (the function pin of 6.6).
 */
const STANDING_PREDICATE = {
  liveNotSuspended: { "lib/standing.ts": 1, "media/repo.ts": 2, "profiles/store.ts": 3, "social/repo.ts": 2 },
  suspendedAt: { "lib/standing.ts": 2, "social/repo.ts": 6 },
  reportsRestrictedAt: { "lib/standing.ts": 1, "social/repo.ts": 2 },
};
const STANDING_COLUMNS_ALLOWED = new Set(["lib/standing.ts", "social/repo.ts", "moderation/standing-repo.ts"]);
const STANDING_COLUMNS = ["suspended_from", "suspended_until", "reports_restricted_until", "suspendedFrom", "suspendedUntil", "reportsRestrictedUntil"];
/** Whether a file names one of the derived columns as a whole word, by the same cut as `mentions`. */
const namesStandingColumn = (file: SourceFile): boolean => STANDING_COLUMNS.some((name) => mentions([file], name)[file.path] !== undefined);

function findStandingViolations(files: SourceFile[]): string[] {
  return files.filter((file) => namesStandingColumn(file) && !STANDING_COLUMNS_ALLOWED.has(file.path)).map(({ path }) => `${path}: names a derived column of an account's standing, which only lib/standing.ts, social/repo.ts and moderation/standing-repo.ts may`);
}

describe("the source pins of account sanctions (3e)", () => {
  test("the predicate's fragments are named in exactly the pinned files, each the pinned number of times; the auth module names none", () => {
    for (const [name, pinned] of Object.entries(STANDING_PREDICATE)) expect(mentions(loadSources(), name), name).toEqual(pinned);
    // The auth module names none: no file of it is in any of the pinned lists.
    for (const pinned of Object.values(STANDING_PREDICATE)) expect(Object.keys(pinned).filter((path) => path.startsWith("auth/"))).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("catches a new write that names the predicate, in a pinned file and in one outside the list", () => {
    const real = loadSources();
    const withWrites = real
      .map((file) => (file.path === "media/repo.ts" ? { ...file, source: file.source + String.fromCharCode(10) + 'sql`update post_media set alt = null where ${liveNotSuspended("p", WRITE_CLOCK)}`;' } : file))
      .concat([{ path: "moderation/texts.ts", source: 'await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from profiles p where ${suspendedAt("p", WRITE_CLOCK)}`);' }]);
    expect(mentions(withWrites, "liveNotSuspended")).not.toEqual(STANDING_PREDICATE.liveNotSuspended);
    expect(mentions(withWrites, "liveNotSuspended")).toMatchObject({ "media/repo.ts": 3 });
    expect(mentions(withWrites, "suspendedAt")).toMatchObject({ "moderation/texts.ts": 1 });
    expect(mentions(withWrites, "suspendedAt")).not.toEqual(STANDING_PREDICATE.suspendedAt);
  });

  test("the three derived columns are named only in lib/standing.ts, social/repo.ts and moderation/standing-repo.ts, and lib/standing.ts does name them", () => {
    expect(findStandingViolations(loadSources())).toEqual([]);
    expect(namesStandingColumn(loadSources().find((file) => file.path === "lib/standing.ts")!)).toBe(true);
  });

  test("catches a derived column named elsewhere, in SQL and by drizzle's name", () => {
    const files: SourceFile[] = [
      { path: "lib/standing.ts", source: "sql`(${p}.suspended_from is not null and ${p}.suspended_from <= ${at} and ${at} < ${p}.suspended_until)`" },
      { path: "moderation/standing-repo.ts", source: "sql`select reports_restricted_until from profiles`" },
      { path: "social/flows/posts.ts", source: "const [row] = await db.execute(sql`select suspended_until from profiles where id = ${viewer}::uuid`);" },
      { path: "media/repo.ts", source: "await db.select({ until: profiles.suspendedUntil }).from(profiles);" },
      { path: "auth/flows/badge.ts", source: "if (profile.reportsRestrictedUntil) return;" },
      // A word that only contains the name is not the name.
      { path: "social/views.ts", source: "const unsuspended_from_now = 1;" },
    ];
    expect(findStandingViolations(files)).toEqual([
      "social/flows/posts.ts: names a derived column of an account's standing, which only lib/standing.ts, social/repo.ts and moderation/standing-repo.ts may",
      "media/repo.ts: names a derived column of an account's standing, which only lib/standing.ts, social/repo.ts and moderation/standing-repo.ts may",
      "auth/flows/badge.ts: names a derived column of an account's standing, which only lib/standing.ts, social/repo.ts and moderation/standing-repo.ts may",
    ]);
  });
});
```

### Replace `apps/api/test/auth/badge.test.ts` (whole file)

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { AuthError } from "../../src/auth/context";
import { randomToken } from "../../src/auth/crypto";
import {
  BADGE_STARTS_PER_DAY,
  BADGE_STARTS_PER_HOUR,
  BADGE_STARTS_PER_IP_PER_HOUR,
  badgeAttemptsKey,
  badgeKey,
  removeBadge,
  startBadge,
  verifyBadge,
  type PendingBadge,
} from "../../src/auth/flows/badge";
import { CODE_TTL_MS, MAX_CODE_ATTEMPTS } from "../../src/auth/flows/email";
import { phoneHash } from "../../src/auth/identifiers";
import { HOUR } from "../../src/auth/limits";
import type { Session } from "../../src/auth/sessions";
import { DEV_CODE, devProvider } from "../../src/auth/verify/dev";
import { VerifyUnavailable, type VerificationProvider } from "../../src/auth/verify/provider";
import { memoryFlowHarness, type MemoryFlowHarness } from "./flow-harness";

const PHONE = "+447911123456";
const OTHER_PHONE = "+33612345678";
const WRONG = "123456";

/** The AuthError a flow rejects with; anything else fails the test. */
async function failure(promise: Promise<unknown>): Promise<AuthError> {
  try {
    await promise;
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof AuthError) return err;
    throw err;
  }
  throw new Error("expected the flow to reject");
}

/** A provider whose check answers as told, for the paths the development provider never takes. */
function answering(outcome: "code_expired" | "invalid_code" | "verified"): VerificationProvider {
  return { start: async () => ({ reference: "fixed-reference" }), check: async () => outcome };
}

/** A provider whose gateway is down. */
const unreachable: VerificationProvider = {
  start: async () => {
    throw new VerifyUnavailable("the gateway answered 503");
  },
  check: async () => {
    throw new VerifyUnavailable("the gateway timed out");
  },
};

/** The development provider with every call counted, so a test can tell how many requests reached it. */
function counting(): { provider: VerificationProvider; calls: { start: number; check: number } } {
  const inner = devProvider();
  const calls = { start: 0, check: 0 };
  return {
    calls,
    provider: {
      start: async (phone) => {
        calls.start += 1;
        return inner.start(phone);
      },
      check: async (reference, code) => {
        calls.check += 1;
        return inner.check(reference, code);
      },
    },
  };
}

const pending = async (h: MemoryFlowHarness, flowId: string) => JSON.parse((await h.kv.get(badgeKey(flowId)))!) as PendingBadge;

/** Starts a verification for the number and returns its flow id. */
async function start(h: MemoryFlowHarness, session: Session, phone = PHONE): Promise<string> {
  return (await startBadge(h.deps, session, { phone }, h.ctx)).flowId;
}

/** Four wrong codes and then the right one: the right one is the fifth attempt, the last the flow allows. */
async function fourWrongThenRight(h: MemoryFlowHarness, session: Session, flowId: string): Promise<void> {
  for (let i = 0; i < MAX_CODE_ATTEMPTS - 1; i++) {
    expect(await failure(verifyBadge(h.deps, session, { flowId, code: WRONG }))).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_code" });
  }
  expect(await verifyBadge(h.deps, session, { flowId, code: DEV_CODE })).toEqual({ verified: true });
}

/** Starts and verifies with the development code, so the account holds the badge for the number. */
async function earn(h: MemoryFlowHarness, session: Session, phone = PHONE): Promise<string> {
  const flowId = await start(h, session, phone);
  expect(await verifyBadge(h.deps, session, { flowId, code: DEV_CODE })).toEqual({ verified: true });
  return flowId;
}

describe("badge: the start step", () => {
  test("is badge_unavailable, before any limit is counted, when no provider is configured", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const ada = h.user("ada@korbat.local");
    h.deps.verify = null;
    expect(await failure(startBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { phone: PHONE }, h.ctx))).toMatchObject({ code: "badge_unavailable", status: 404 });
    expect(await h.kv.get(`rl:badge-start:${ada.user.id}`)).toBeNull();
    expect(await h.kv.get(`rl:badge-start:phone:${phoneHash(h.deps.config.authHmacKey, PHONE)}`)).toBeNull();
  });

  test("asks the provider for a code and keeps the pending verification, under the hashed flow id and without the number, for 10 minutes", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const ada = h.user("ada@korbat.local");
    const { flowId } = await startBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { phone: PHONE }, h.ctx);
    expect(flowId).toMatch(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/);
    const raw = (await h.kv.get(badgeKey(flowId)))!;
    expect(raw).not.toContain(PHONE);
    expect(JSON.parse(raw)).toEqual({
      userId: ada.user.id,
      phoneHash: phoneHash(h.deps.config.authHmacKey, PHONE),
      reference: expect.any(String),
      expiresAt: h.now().getTime() + CODE_TTL_MS,
    });
    // Nothing about the account changes until the code is right, and nobody is told.
    expect(h.users.get(ada.user.id)!.phoneHash).toBeNull();
    expect(h.verified.has(ada.user.id)).toBe(false);
    expect(h.mailer.sent).toEqual([]);
    expect(h.events).toEqual([]);
    h.advance(CODE_TTL_MS + 1);
    expect(await h.kv.get(badgeKey(flowId))).toBeNull();
  });

  test("allows 3 starts an hour per account, then rate_limited with a Retry-After until the window passes", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const ada = h.user("ada@korbat.local");
    for (let i = 0; i < BADGE_STARTS_PER_HOUR; i++) await start(h, ada.session, `+44791112345${i}`);
    expect(await failure(start(h, ada.session, "+447911123459"))).toMatchObject({ code: "rate_limited", status: 429, retryAfterSeconds: HOUR / 1000 });
    // Another account's window is its own.
    const bob = h.user("bob@korbat.local");
    await start(h, bob.session, "+447911123459");
    h.advance(HOUR + 1);
    await start(h, ada.session, "+447911123459");
  });

  test("allows 3 starts an hour per number, whoever asks, then rate_limited until the window passes", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const [a, b, c, d] = ["a", "b", "c", "d"].map((name) => h.user(`${name}@korbat.local`));
    await start(h, a!.session);
    await start(h, b!.session);
    await start(h, c!.session);
    expect(await h.kv.get(`rl:badge-start:phone:${phoneHash(h.deps.config.authHmacKey, PHONE)}`)).toBe("3");
    expect(await failure(start(h, d!.session))).toMatchObject({ code: "rate_limited", status: 429, retryAfterSeconds: HOUR / 1000 });
    // Another number is not affected by that one's window.
    await start(h, d!.session, OTHER_PHONE);
    h.advance(HOUR + 1);
    await start(h, d!.session);
  });

  test("an unreachable provider is verify_unavailable, after the limits were counted, and nobody is told", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const ada = h.user("ada@korbat.local");
    h.deps.verify = unreachable;
    expect(await failure(startBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { phone: PHONE }, h.ctx))).toMatchObject({ code: "verify_unavailable", status: 503 });
    expect(await h.kv.get(`rl:badge-start:${ada.user.id}`)).toBe("1");
    expect(await h.kv.get(`rl:badge-start:ip:${h.ctx.ipHash}`)).toBe("1");
    expect(await h.kv.get("rl:badge-start:all")).toBe("1");
    expect(h.mailer.sent).toEqual([]);
    expect(h.events).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("allows 10 starts an hour from one address, whatever the accounts and numbers, then rate_limited before the provider is asked", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const { provider, calls } = counting();
    h.deps.verify = provider;
    // Four accounts, each within its own three an hour, and a new number every time: only the address is shared.
    const accounts = ["a", "b", "c", "d"].map((name) => h.user(`${name}@korbat.local`));
    for (let i = 0; i < BADGE_STARTS_PER_IP_PER_HOUR; i++) await start(h, accounts[Math.floor(i / BADGE_STARTS_PER_HOUR)]!.session, `+4479111234${String(i).padStart(2, "0")}`);
    expect(calls.start).toBe(BADGE_STARTS_PER_IP_PER_HOUR);
    const refused = await failure(start(h, accounts[3]!.session, "+447911123499"));
    expect(refused).toMatchObject({ code: "rate_limited", status: 429, retryAfterSeconds: HOUR / 1000 });
    expect(calls.start).toBe(BADGE_STARTS_PER_IP_PER_HOUR);
    // Another address has a window of its own, and this one opens again after the hour.
    await startBadge(h.deps, accounts[3]!.session, { phone: "+447911123498" }, { ...h.ctx, ipHash: randomToken() });
    expect(calls.start).toBe(BADGE_STARTS_PER_IP_PER_HOUR + 1);
    h.advance(HOUR + 1);
    await start(h, accounts[0]!.session, "+447911123497");
    expect(calls.start).toBe(BADGE_STARTS_PER_IP_PER_HOUR + 2);
  });

  test("allows 200 starts a day on the whole instance, then rate_limited for a day before the provider is asked", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const { provider, calls } = counting();
    h.deps.verify = provider;
    // Every start from a fresh account, address and number, so only the instance-wide ceiling is shared.
    const fresh = (i: number) => ({ session: h.user(`crowd-${i}@korbat.local`).session, ctx: { ...h.ctx, ipHash: randomToken() }, phone: `+3361${String(i).padStart(7, "0")}` });
    for (let i = 0; i < BADGE_STARTS_PER_DAY; i++) {
      const { session, ctx, phone } = fresh(i);
      await startBadge(h.deps, session, { phone }, ctx);
    }
    expect(calls.start).toBe(BADGE_STARTS_PER_DAY);
    const next = fresh(BADGE_STARTS_PER_DAY);
    const refused = await failure(startBadge(h.deps, next.session, { phone: next.phone }, next.ctx));
    expect(refused).toMatchObject({ code: "rate_limited", status: 429, retryAfterSeconds: (24 * HOUR) / 1000 });
    expect(calls.start).toBe(BADGE_STARTS_PER_DAY);
    // Still closed an hour later, when every per-account, per-address and per-number window has passed; open again after the day.
    h.advance(HOUR + 1);
    expect(await failure(startBadge(h.deps, next.session, { phone: next.phone }, next.ctx))).toMatchObject({ code: "rate_limited" });
    h.advance(23 * HOUR);
    await startBadge(h.deps, next.session, { phone: next.phone }, next.ctx);
    expect(calls.start).toBe(BADGE_STARTS_PER_DAY + 1);
  });

  test("a start refused by the account's own limit does not count against the address or the instance", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const ada = h.user("ada@korbat.local");
    for (let i = 0; i < BADGE_STARTS_PER_HOUR; i++) await start(h, ada.session, `+44791112345${i}`);
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) expect(await failure(start(h, ada.session, "+447911123459"))).toMatchObject({ code: "rate_limited" });
    // One account cannot use up the address's or the instance's allowance with starts it was never going to get.
    expect(await h.kv.get(`rl:badge-start:ip:${h.ctx.ipHash}`)).toBe(String(BADGE_STARTS_PER_HOUR));
    expect(await h.kv.get("rl:badge-start:all")).toBe(String(BADGE_STARTS_PER_HOUR));
  });
});

describe("badge: the verification step", () => {
  test("a wrong code is invalid_code and leaves the pending verification as it was; the right one still works within the limit", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const ada = h.user("ada@korbat.local");
    const flowId = await start(h, ada.session);
    const before = await pending(h, flowId);
    expect(await failure(verifyBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { flowId, code: WRONG }))).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_code", status: 400 });
    // The attempt is counted in a counter of its own; the state is never written back.
    expect(await pending(h, flowId)).toEqual(before);
    expect(await h.kv.get(badgeAttemptsKey(flowId))).toBe("1");
    expect(h.users.get(ada.user.id)!.phoneHash).toBeNull();
    expect(h.mailer.sent).toEqual([]);
    expect(h.events).toEqual([]);
    expect(await verifyBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { flowId, code: DEV_CODE })).toEqual({ verified: true });
  });

  test("the right code after four wrong ones succeeds", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const ada = h.user("ada@korbat.local");
    await fourWrongThenRight(h, ada.session, await start(h, ada.session));
    expect(h.users.get(ada.user.id)!.phoneHash).toBe(phoneHash(h.deps.config.authHmacKey, PHONE));
  });

  test("ten verifications at once with wrong codes: at most five reach the provider, the rest are too_many_attempts", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const ada = h.user("ada@korbat.local");
    const { provider, calls } = counting();
    h.deps.verify = provider;
    const flowId = await start(h, ada.session);
    const outcomes = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: 10 }, () => failure(verifyBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { flowId, code: WRONG }))));
    expect(calls.check).toBeLessThanOrEqual(MAX_CODE_ATTEMPTS);
    expect(outcomes.filter((err) => err.code === "invalid_code")).toHaveLength(calls.check);
    expect(outcomes.filter((err) => err.code === "too_many_attempts")).toHaveLength(10 - calls.check);
    // Whatever order they ran in, the flow is spent: even the right code is refused now.
    expect(await failure(verifyBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { flowId, code: DEV_CODE }))).toMatchObject({ code: "too_many_attempts", status: 429 });
    expect(calls.check).toBeLessThanOrEqual(MAX_CODE_ATTEMPTS);
  });

  test("counting an attempt keeps the flow's original expiry", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const ada = h.user("ada@korbat.local");
    const flowId = await start(h, ada.session);
    h.advance(CODE_TTL_MS - 1000);
    expect(await failure(verifyBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { flowId, code: WRONG }))).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_code" });
    h.advance(1001);
    // The flow ends with its ten minutes, not ten minutes after the last attempt.
    expect(await h.kv.get(badgeKey(flowId))).toBeNull();
    expect(await failure(verifyBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { flowId, code: DEV_CODE }))).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_code", status: 400 });
  });

  test("five wrong codes exhaust the flow: too_many_attempts even for the right one", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const ada = h.user("ada@korbat.local");
    const flowId = await start(h, ada.session);
    for (let i = 0; i < MAX_CODE_ATTEMPTS; i++) {
      expect(await failure(verifyBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { flowId, code: WRONG }))).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_code" });
    }
    expect(await failure(verifyBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { flowId, code: DEV_CODE }))).toMatchObject({ code: "too_many_attempts", status: 429 });
    expect(h.users.get(ada.user.id)!.phoneHash).toBeNull();
    expect(h.verified.has(ada.user.id)).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a flow another account started is invalid_code for this one and costs its owner no attempt; so is an unknown flow id", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const ada = h.user("ada@korbat.local");
    const bob = h.user("bob@korbat.local");
    const flowId = await start(h, ada.session);
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      expect(await failure(verifyBadge(h.deps, bob.session, { flowId, code: DEV_CODE }))).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_code", status: 400 });
    }
    expect(h.users.get(bob.user.id)!.phoneHash).toBeNull();
    const unknown = randomToken();
    expect(await failure(verifyBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { flowId: unknown, code: DEV_CODE }))).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_code", status: 400 });
    expect(await h.kv.get(badgeAttemptsKey(unknown))).toBeNull();
    // All five of the owner's attempts are still there.
    await fourWrongThenRight(h, ada.session, flowId);
    expect(h.users.get(bob.user.id)!.phoneHash).toBeNull();
  });

  test("an expired flow is invalid_code and counts no attempt, even while the store still holds its state", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const ada = h.user("ada@korbat.local");
    const flowId = await start(h, ada.session);
    // A straggler: the state outlives its ten minutes in the store (Redis expires keys lazily), and the flow still treats it as gone.
    const state = await pending(h, flowId);
    await h.kv.set(badgeKey(flowId), JSON.stringify(state), HOUR);
    h.advance(CODE_TTL_MS);
    expect(await failure(verifyBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { flowId, code: DEV_CODE }))).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_code", status: 400 });
    expect(await h.kv.get(badgeAttemptsKey(flowId))).toBeNull();
    expect(h.users.get(ada.user.id)!.phoneHash).toBeNull();
    h.advance(1);
    expect(await failure(verifyBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { flowId, code: DEV_CODE }))).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_code", status: 400 });
    expect(await h.kv.get(badgeAttemptsKey(flowId))).toBeNull();
  });

  test("a code the provider reports expired is code_expired and ends the flow", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const ada = h.user("ada@korbat.local");
    h.deps.verify = answering("code_expired");
    const flowId = await start(h, ada.session);
    expect(await failure(verifyBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { flowId, code: DEV_CODE }))).toMatchObject({ code: "code_expired", status: 400 });
    expect(await h.kv.get(badgeKey(flowId))).toBeNull();
    expect(await failure(verifyBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { flowId, code: DEV_CODE }))).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_code" });
    expect(h.users.get(ada.user.id)!.phoneHash).toBeNull();
  });

  test("an unreachable provider is verify_unavailable; the flow stays for a retry, its attempt counted", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const ada = h.user("ada@korbat.local");
    const flowId = await start(h, ada.session);
    h.deps.verify = unreachable;
    expect(await failure(verifyBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { flowId, code: DEV_CODE }))).toMatchObject({ code: "verify_unavailable", status: 503 });
    expect(h.users.get(ada.user.id)!.phoneHash).toBeNull();
    h.deps.verify = devProvider();
    expect(await verifyBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { flowId, code: DEV_CODE })).toEqual({ verified: true });
  });

  test("an attempt the provider could not answer still counts: after it and four wrong codes the right one is too_many_attempts", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const ada = h.user("ada@korbat.local");
    const flowId = await start(h, ada.session);
    h.deps.verify = unreachable;
    expect(await failure(verifyBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { flowId, code: DEV_CODE }))).toMatchObject({ code: "verify_unavailable" });
    h.deps.verify = devProvider();
    for (let i = 0; i < MAX_CODE_ATTEMPTS - 1; i++) {
      expect(await failure(verifyBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { flowId, code: WRONG }))).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_code" });
    }
    expect(await failure(verifyBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { flowId, code: DEV_CODE }))).toMatchObject({ code: "too_many_attempts", status: 429 });
    expect(h.users.get(ada.user.id)!.phoneHash).toBeNull();
  });

  test("a number another account verified is phone_in_use only now, and the flow is spent", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const ada = h.user("ada@korbat.local");
    const bob = h.user("bob@korbat.local");
    await earn(h, bob.session);
    const flowId = await start(h, ada.session);
    expect(await failure(verifyBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { flowId, code: DEV_CODE }))).toMatchObject({ code: "phone_in_use", status: 409 });
    expect(h.users.get(ada.user.id)!.phoneHash).toBeNull();
    expect(h.verified.has(ada.user.id)).toBe(false);
    expect(h.mailer.sent.map((m) => m.to)).toEqual(["bob@korbat.local"]);
    expect(h.events.map((e) => e.userId)).toEqual([bob.user.id]);
    // The provider accepted the code, so the flow is over: the owner starts again with another number.
    expect(await h.kv.get(badgeKey(flowId))).toBeNull();
    expect(await failure(verifyBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { flowId, code: DEV_CODE }))).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_code" });
    // The account that holds the number keeps its badge.
    expect(h.users.get(bob.user.id)!.phoneHash).toBe(phoneHash(h.deps.config.authHmacKey, PHONE));
  });

  test("writes the hash and the badge, forgets the flow, tells the account and records the event, all without the number", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const ada = h.user("ada@korbat.local");
    const flowId = await start(h, ada.session);
    h.advance(1000);
    expect(await verifyBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { flowId, code: DEV_CODE })).toEqual({ verified: true });
    expect(h.users.get(ada.user.id)!.phoneHash).toBe(phoneHash(h.deps.config.authHmacKey, PHONE));
    expect(h.verified.get(ada.user.id)).toEqual(h.now());
    expect(await h.kv.get(badgeKey(flowId))).toBeNull();
    expect(h.mailer.sent).toEqual([{ to: "ada@korbat.local", template: "badge_verified", data: {} }]);
    expect(h.events).toEqual([{ userId: ada.user.id, type: "badge_verified", deviceId: ada.session.deviceId, metadata: {} }]);
    expect(JSON.stringify([h.mailer.sent, h.events])).not.toContain(PHONE);
    expect(await failure(verifyBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { flowId, code: DEV_CODE }))).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_code" });
  });

  test("verifying another number replaces the account's one hash, and the number it holds is no conflict", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const ada = h.user("ada@korbat.local");
    await earn(h, ada.session);
    await earn(h, ada.session, OTHER_PHONE);
    expect(h.users.get(ada.user.id)!.phoneHash).toBe(phoneHash(h.deps.config.authHmacKey, OTHER_PHONE));
    await earn(h, ada.session, OTHER_PHONE);
    expect(h.events.map((e) => e.type)).toEqual(["badge_verified", "badge_verified", "badge_verified"]);
  });

  test("the notice is best effort: a mail failure does not undo the badge", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const ada = h.user("ada@korbat.local");
    const flowId = await start(h, ada.session);
    h.mailer.failing = true;
    expect(await verifyBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { flowId, code: DEV_CODE })).toEqual({ verified: true });
    expect(h.users.get(ada.user.id)!.phoneHash).not.toBeNull();
    expect(h.events.map((e) => e.type)).toEqual(["badge_verified"]);
    expect(h.mailer.sent).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("is badge_unavailable, without counting an attempt, when no provider is configured", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const ada = h.user("ada@korbat.local");
    const flowId = await start(h, ada.session);
    h.deps.verify = null;
    expect(await failure(verifyBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { flowId, code: DEV_CODE }))).toMatchObject({ code: "badge_unavailable", status: 404 });
    // Back on, the flow still has all five attempts.
    h.deps.verify = devProvider();
    await fourWrongThenRight(h, ada.session, flowId);
  });
});

describe("badge: removal", () => {
  test("clears the hash and the badge, tells the account and records the event; without a badge it is a silent no-op", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const ada = h.user("ada@korbat.local");
    await removeBadge(h.deps, ada.session);
    expect(h.mailer.sent).toEqual([]);
    expect(h.events).toEqual([]);
    await earn(h, ada.session);
    h.advance(1000);
    await removeBadge(h.deps, ada.session);
    expect(h.users.get(ada.user.id)!.phoneHash).toBeNull();
    expect(h.verified.get(ada.user.id)).toBeNull();
    expect(h.mailer.sent.map((m) => [m.to, m.template])).toEqual([
      ["ada@korbat.local", "badge_verified"],
      ["ada@korbat.local", "badge_removed"],
    ]);
    expect(h.events.map((e) => [e.type, e.deviceId, e.metadata])).toEqual([
      ["badge_verified", ada.session.deviceId, {}],
      ["badge_removed", ada.session.deviceId, {}],
    ]);
    await removeBadge(h.deps, ada.session);
    expect(h.mailer.sent).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(h.events).toHaveLength(2);
    // The number is free for another account once the badge is gone.
    const bob = h.user("bob@korbat.local");
    await earn(h, bob.session);
  });

  test("works without a provider, and the notice is best effort", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const ada = h.user("ada@korbat.local");
    await earn(h, ada.session);
    h.deps.verify = null;
    h.mailer.failing = true;
    await removeBadge(h.deps, ada.session);
    expect(h.users.get(ada.user.id)!.phoneHash).toBeNull();
    expect(h.verified.get(ada.user.id)).toBeNull();
    expect(h.events.map((e) => e.type)).toEqual(["badge_verified", "badge_removed"]);
  });
});

describe("badge: a suspended account (3e design, sections 7.2 and 7.3)", () => {
  test("the start is refused account_suspended before any limit is counted or any code is texted", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const ada = h.user("ada@korbat.local");
    const provider = counting();
    h.deps.verify = provider.provider;
    h.suspended.add(ada.user.id);
    expect(await failure(start(h, ada.session))).toMatchObject({ code: "account_suspended", status: 403 });
    expect(provider.calls.start).toBe(0);
    expect(await h.kv.get(`rl:badge-start:${ada.user.id}`)).toBeNull();
  });

  test("a code that is right after the suspension began is refused: the phone hash written a moment before is cleared again, nobody is told and nothing is recorded", async () => {
    const h = memoryFlowHarness();
    const ada = h.user("ada@korbat.local");
    const flowId = await start(h, ada.session);
    h.suspended.add(ada.user.id);
    expect(await failure(verifyBadge(h.deps, ada.session, { flowId, code: DEV_CODE }))).toMatchObject({ code: "account_suspended", status: 403 });
    expect(h.users.get(ada.user.id)!.phoneHash).toBeNull();
    expect(h.verified.has(ada.user.id)).toBe(false);
    expect(h.mailer.sent).toEqual([]);
    expect(h.events).toEqual([]);

    await removeBadge(h.deps, ada.session);
    expect(h.verified.get(ada.user.id)).toBeNull();
```
