    appOrigin: "http://localhost:8081",
    allowedOrigins: ["http://localhost:8081"],
    authHmacKey: Buffer.alloc(32, 3),
    ipHashKey: Buffer.alloc(32, 4),
    totpKey: parseVersionedKey(`v1:${Buffer.alloc(32, 5).toString("base64")}`),
    totpPreviousKeys: [],
    notifierKey: parseVersionedKey(`v1:${Buffer.alloc(32, 6).toString("base64")}`),
    notifierPreviousKeys: [],
    termsVersion: TEST_TERMS,
    trustProxy: "none",
    verifyProvider: "dev",
    webauthn: { rpId: "localhost", rpName: "korbat", origins: ["http://localhost:8081"] },
    // The staff console is off: no flow this harness runs reaches it.
    console: null,
  };
  const deps: AuthDeps = {
    repo: authRepo,
    kv,
    sessions: createSessions({ repo: authRepo, kv, now }),
    lockout: createLockout({ repo: authRepo, kv, now }),
    mailer,
    turnstile: { verify: async () => true },
    breachChecker: { isBreached: async () => false },
    // The flows this harness runs create no profile; the badge flows only set and clear verified_at, kept above by
    // account, and the deletion flow reads the handle, kept by account as `user` registers it. No flow here changes the
    // Explore switch, which reads as the column's default.
    profiles: {
      create: async () => {
        throw new Error("the memory harness has no profile store");
      },
      find: async (id) => {
        const handle = handles.get(id);
        return handle === undefined ? null : { id, handle, displayName: handle, handleChangedAt: null, verified: (verified.get(id) ?? null) !== null, showInExplore: true };
      },
      // 3e: setting the badge is refused while the account's suspension runs, as the predicate refuses the real write.
      setVerified: async (id, at) => {
        if (at !== null && suspended.has(id)) return false;
        verified.set(id, at);
        return true;
      },
      suspended: async (id) => suspended.has(id),
    },
    // The development provider, which accepts exactly 000000; a test swaps it for null or a scripted one.
    verify: devProvider(),
    config,
    log: pino({ level: "silent" }),
    now,
  };
  const ctx: RequestContext = { ipHash: randomToken(), userAgent: undefined };
  /**
   * A live session on a device of its own, both recorded as the deletion flow will find them. It proved an email code
   * just now unless given other factors, as a session behind requireFreshAuth has, and started from no passkey unless told so.
   * The device is a web browser labelled as the sign-in labels one, unless the test says otherwise.
   */
  const session = (userId: string, options: { factors?: Factors; passkeyId?: string | null; platform?: Platform; label?: string | null } = {}): Session => {
    const s: Session = {
      sessionId: sha256Hex(randomToken()),
      userId,
      deviceId: randomUUID(),
      role: "user",
      onboarded: true,
      mfaEnabled: false,
      reauthAt: now(),
      handle: randomUUID(),
      factors: options.factors ?? { email: t },
      passkeyId: options.passkeyId ?? null,
    };
    sessions.push({
      id: s.sessionId,
      userId,
      revokedAt: null,
      deviceId: s.deviceId,
      handle: s.handle,
      factors: s.factors,
      passkeyId: s.passkeyId,
      reauthAt: s.reauthAt,
      createdAt: now(),
      lastUsedAt: now(),
      expiresAt: new Date(t + SESSION_IDLE_MS),
      absoluteExpiresAt: new Date(t + SESSION_ABSOLUTE_MS),
    });
    devices.push({ id: s.deviceId, userId, revokedAt: null, platform: options.platform ?? "web", label: options.label === undefined ? "Chrome on Windows" : options.label });
    return s;
  };
  return {
    deps,
    kv,
    mailer,
    ctx,
    users,
    codes,
    events,
    sessions,
    devices,
    passkeys,
    verified,
    suspended,
    faults,
    now,
    advance(ms: number) {
      t += ms;
    },
    /** Another session of an existing account, on another device. */
    session,
    /**
     * A passkey of an existing account, created at `createdAt` (now unless given) with the row's defaults (a plain,
     * unnamed synced key added from no device) unless overridden; answers its id.
     */
    passkey(userId: string, createdAt: Date = now(), overrides: Partial<Omit<RecordedPasskey, "id" | "userId" | "createdAt">> = {}): string {
      const id = randomUUID();
      passkeys.push({
        id,
        userId,
        createdAt,
        credentialId: randomToken(),
        publicKey: "cose-key",
        counter: 0,
        transports: [],
        backedUp: false,
        name: "Passkey",
        lastUsedAt: null,
        aaguid: null,
        backupEligible: false,
        uvInitialized: false,
        createdDeviceId: null,
        suspectAt: null,
        ...overrides,
      });
      return id;
    },
    /**
     * An onboarded account holding a verified address, with a session that just proved a credential, as a route
     * behind requireFreshAuth passes it on. Its profile's handle is the address's local part unless given.
     */
    user(email: string, handle: string = email.split("@")[0]!.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_]/g, "_")): { user: UserRow; session: Session } {
      const id = randomUUID();
      const user: UserRow = {
        id,
        email,
        emailVerifiedAt: now(),
        phoneHash: null,
        passwordHash: null,
        totpSecretEnc: null,
        totpEnabledAt: null,
        recoveryCodesHash: [],
        failedLogins: 0,
        lockedUntil: null,
        createdAt: now(),
        deletedAt: null,
        role: "user",
        ageConfirmedAt: now(),
        termsVersion: TEST_TERMS,
        termsAcceptedAt: now(),
        onboardedAt: now(),
        passwordChangedAt: null,
        totpLastStep: null,
        purgedAt: null,
        webauthnUserId: null,
      };
      users.set(id, user);
      handles.set(id, handle);
      return { user, session: session(id) };
    },
  };
}

export type MemoryFlowHarness = ReturnType<typeof memoryFlowHarness>;

      await closeDb(holder);

    const demoted = await runGrantRole({ authDb, kv, mailer: new MemoryMailer() }, user.email, "user");
    expect(demoted).toMatchObject({ userId: user.id, previousRole: "user" });

});

import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import type { MeProfile } from "@korbat/contracts";
import pino from "pino";
import type { AuthConfig, AuthDeps, ProfileStore, RequestContext } from "../../src/auth/context";
import { decrypt, parseVersionedKey, randomToken } from "../../src/auth/crypto";
import { signIn } from "../../src/auth/flows/signin";
import { MemoryKv } from "../../src/auth/kv";
import { createLockout } from "../../src/auth/lockout";
import { hashPassword } from "../../src/auth/passwords";
import type { AuthRepo } from "../../src/auth/repo";
import { createSessions } from "../../src/auth/sessions";
import { currentStep, hotp } from "../../src/auth/totp";
import { devProvider } from "../../src/auth/verify/dev";
import { MemoryMailer } from "../../src/mail/memory";
import { fakeClock } from "./auth-fixtures";

/**
 * Handles unique per store, like the real public.profiles index. A new profile has never changed its handle, holds no
 * badge and shows its posts in Explore, as the column's default has it.
 */
export function memoryProfiles(): ProfileStore {
  const byHandle = new Map<string, MeProfile>();
  const byId = new Map<string, MeProfile>();
  return {
    async create({ id, handle, displayName }) {
      if (byHandle.has(handle) || byId.has(id)) return { ok: false, reason: "handle_taken" };
      const profile = { id, handle, displayName, handleChangedAt: null, verified: false, showInExplore: true };
      byHandle.set(handle, profile);
      byId.set(id, profile);
      return { ok: true, profile: { id, handle, displayName } };
    },
    async find(id) {
      return byId.get(id) ?? null;
    },
    async setVerified(id, at) {
      const profile = byId.get(id);
      if (profile) profile.verified = at !== null;
      return true;
    },
    // No account of these suites is suspended: the real store and its predicate are http-badge.test.ts's.
    async suspended() {
      return false;
    },
  };
}

export const TEST_TERMS = "draft-test";
export const CHROME_WINDOWS = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/139.0.0.0 Safari/537.36";

/**
 * Real auth repository (Postgres) with an in-memory key-value store, mailer and profile store, a fake
 * clock shared by all of them, Turnstile that fails only for the token "fail", and a breach checker
 * that flags passwords containing "breached". A suite whose profiles live in the public schema (the
 * deletion flow compares the typed handle with the profile's) passes the real profile store instead. The staff
 * console is off unless a suite names its origin and relying party ID, as the staff suites do (3a design, section 12).
 */
export function flowHarness(repo: AuthRepo, options: { profiles?: ProfileStore; console?: { origin: string; rpId: string } } = {}) {
  const clock = fakeClock();
  const kv = new MemoryKv(clock.ms);
  const mailer = new MemoryMailer();
  const config: AuthConfig = {
    appOrigin: "http://localhost:8081",
    allowedOrigins: ["http://localhost:8081"],
    authHmacKey: Buffer.alloc(32, 3),
    ipHashKey: Buffer.alloc(32, 4),
    totpKey: parseVersionedKey(`v1:${Buffer.alloc(32, 5).toString("base64")}`),
    totpPreviousKeys: [],
    notifierKey: parseVersionedKey(`v1:${Buffer.alloc(32, 6).toString("base64")}`),
    notifierPreviousKeys: [],
    termsVersion: TEST_TERMS,
    trustProxy: "none",
    verifyProvider: "dev",
    webauthn: { rpId: "localhost", rpName: "korbat", origins: ["http://localhost:8081"] },
    console: options.console ?? null,
  };
  const deps: AuthDeps = {
    repo,
    kv,
    mailer,
    config,
    now: clock.now,
    sessions: createSessions({ repo, kv, now: clock.now }),
    lockout: createLockout({ repo, kv, now: clock.now }),
    turnstile: { verify: async (token) => token !== "fail" },
    breachChecker: { isBreached: async (password) => password.includes("breached") },
    profiles: options.profiles ?? memoryProfiles(),
    verify: devProvider(),
    log: pino({ level: "silent" }),
  };
  const ctx: RequestContext = { ipHash: randomToken(), userAgent: CHROME_WINDOWS };
  return { deps, clock, kv, mailer, ctx };
}

export type FlowHarness = ReturnType<typeof flowHarness>;

export const newTestEmail = (prefix = "flow") => `${prefix}-${randomUUID()}@korbat.local`;
export const newTestDevice = () => ({ deviceId: randomToken(), platform: "web" as const });
export const wrongCode = (code: string) => String((Number(code) + 1) % 1_000_000).padStart(6, "0");

/** An onboarded account, optionally with a password, signed in on one web device. */
export async function onboardedUser(h: FlowHarness, repo: AuthRepo, options: { password?: string } = {}) {
  const email = newTestEmail("account");
  const created = await repo.createUser({ email, termsVersion: TEST_TERMS, now: new Date() });
  await repo.markOnboarded(created.id, new Date());
  if (options.password) await repo.setPasswordHash(created.id, await hashPassword(options.password), new Date());
  const user = (await repo.findUserById(created.id))!;
  const device = newTestDevice();
  const signed = await signIn(h.deps, user, device, h.ctx, { alertNewDevice: false, factors: { email: h.clock.ms() }, method: "email" });
  return { email, user, device, session: signed.issued.session, token: signed.issued.token };
}

export type OnboardedUser = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof onboardedUser>>;

/** The TOTP code for a user's stored secret at the harness clock. */
export async function currentTotpCode(h: FlowHarness, repo: AuthRepo, userId: string): Promise<string> {
  const user = (await repo.findUserById(userId))!;
  const secret = new Uint8Array(decrypt(user.totpSecretEnc!, [h.deps.config.totpKey]));
  return hotp(secret, currentStep(h.clock.ms()));
}

import { randomBytes, randomInt, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import pino from "pino";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { BadgeVerifyResponse, ErrorEnvelope, FlowResponse, MeResponse, ProfileView } from "@korbat/contracts";

import { loadConfig, type Config } from "../../src/config";
import { MemoryMailer } from "../../src/mail/memory";

import { Browser } from "./http-client";

const newPhone = () => `+4477${String(randomInt(10_000_000, 100_000_000))}`;

/**
 * The badge routes through the real app: 1a sign-up for the accounts, cookie sessions with CSRF, the
 * auth module's freshness check, the development provider, the real profile store (so /me and the

 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the verified badge over HTTP", () => {

  let apiDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;

  beforeAll(() => {

    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    // 3e: only the migrator writes a suspension into a profile row, as the ledger's standing_apply does.
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 1 });
    const shared = { config, logger, authDb, mailer, turnstile: { verify: async () => true }, breachChecker: { isBreached: async () => false } };
    auth = createAuth({ ...shared, kv: new MemoryKv(), profiles: createProfileStore(apiDb), verify: devProvider() });
    const rateLimitStore = new MemoryStore();
    const social = createSocial({ apiDb, rateLimitStore, logger, requireSession: auth.requireSession, requireFreshAuth: auth.requireFreshAuth(), events: { append: auth.appendEvent } });
    app = createApp({ config, logger, rateLimitStore, healthChecks: {}, auth, social });
    const authOff = createAuth({ ...shared, kv: new MemoryKv(), profiles: createProfileStore(apiDb) });
    appOff = createApp({ config, logger, rateLimitStore: new MemoryStore(), healthChecks: {}, auth: authOff });
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await Promise.all([closeDb(authDb), closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  /** A signed-in web account on the given app, onboarded unless told otherwise. */
  async function signUp(on: App = app, onboard = true) {
    const b = new Browser(on, config.APP_ORIGIN);
    const email = `badge-${randomUUID()}@korbat.local`;
    const handle = newHandle();
    const start = await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/start", { json: { email, turnstileToken: "ok", deviceId: randomToken(), platform: "web" } });
    expect(start.status).toBe(200);
    const { flowId } = FlowResponse.parse(await start.json());
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/verify", { json: { flowId, code: mailer.lastCodeFor(email) } })).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/signup/complete", { json: { flowId, dateOfBirth: "1990-05-17", termsVersion: config.TERMS_VERSION } })).status).toBe(200);
    if (onboard) expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/onboarding/handle", { json: { handle, displayName: `User ${handle}` } })).status).toBe(200);
    const me = MeResponse.parse(await (await b.fetch("/api/me")).json());

  const errorCode = async (res: Response) => ErrorEnvelope.parse(await res.json()).error.code;
  /** The session's only factor is the sign-up's email code; moved ten minutes back, nothing within the window is left, so the freshness check fails. */
  async function makeStale(b: Browser) {
    const sessionId = sha256Hex(b.cookie("__Host-korbat_session")!);

    await auth.deps.kv.del(`sess:2:${sessionId}`);

  const verifiedOnMe = async (b: Browser) => MeResponse.parse(await (await b.fetch("/api/me")).json()).profile!.verified;
  const verifiedInPublic = async (handle: string) => ProfileView.parse(await (await app.request(`/api/profiles/${handle}`)).json()).verified;
  const storedHash = async (userId: string) => (await auth.deps.repo.findUserById(userId))!.phoneHash;
  const mailsTo = (email: string) => mailer.sent.filter((m) => m.to === email).map((m) => m.template);

  /** Starts a verification for the number and returns the flow id. */
  async function start(b: Browser, phone: string) {
    const res = await b.fetch("/api/auth/badge/start", { json: { phone } });
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    return FlowResponse.parse(await res.json()).flowId;
  }
  const verify = (b: Browser, flowId: string, code: string) => b.fetch("/api/auth/badge/verify", { json: { flowId, code } });

  test("all three routes need an onboarded, fresh session", async () => {
    const routes = [
      ["POST", "/api/auth/badge/start", { phone: newPhone() }],
      ["POST", "/api/auth/badge/verify", { flowId: randomToken(), code: DEV_CODE }],
      ["DELETE", "/api/auth/badge", undefined],
    ] as const;
    for (const [method, path, body] of routes) {

      expect(anonymous.status, path).toBe(401);
      expect(await errorCode(anonymous), path).toBe("unauthenticated");
    }
    const notOnboarded = await signUp(app, false);
    for (const [method, path, body] of routes) {
      const early = await notOnboarded.b.fetch(path, { method, json: body });
      expect(early.status, path).toBe(403);
      expect(await errorCode(early), path).toBe("onboarding_required");
    }
    const stale = await signUp();
    await makeStale(stale.b);
    for (const [method, path, body] of routes) {
      const refused = await stale.b.fetch(path, { method, json: body });
      expect(refused.status, path).toBe(403);
      expect(await errorCode(refused), path).toBe("reauth_required");
    }
  });

  test("the development provider end to end: a wrong code, the right one, the badge on /me and the public profile, the notices and events, then removal", async () => {
    const ada = await signUp();
    const phone = newPhone();
    const malformed = await ada.b.fetch("/api/auth/badge/start", { json: { phone: "0044 7911" } });
    expect(malformed.status).toBe(400);
    expect(await errorCode(malformed)).toBe("invalid_request");
    const flowId = await start(ada.b, phone);
    const wrong = await verify(ada.b, flowId, "123456");
    expect(wrong.status).toBe(400);
    expect(await errorCode(wrong)).toBe("invalid_code");
    expect(await verifiedOnMe(ada.b)).toBe(false);

    const right = await verify(ada.b, flowId, DEV_CODE);
    expect(right.status).toBe(200);
    expect(BadgeVerifyResponse.parse(await right.json())).toEqual({ verified: true });
    expect(await verifiedOnMe(ada.b)).toBe(true);
    expect(await verifiedInPublic(ada.handle)).toBe(true);
    expect(await storedHash(ada.userId)).toBe(phoneHash(auth.deps.config.authHmacKey, phone));
    expect(mailsTo(ada.email).at(-1)).toBe("badge_verified");
    expect(await eventTypes(ada.userId)).toContain("badge_verified");
    const replay = await verify(ada.b, flowId, DEV_CODE);
    expect(replay.status).toBe(400);
    expect(await errorCode(replay)).toBe("invalid_code");

    expect((await ada.b.fetch("/api/auth/badge", { method: "DELETE" })).status).toBe(204);
    expect(await verifiedOnMe(ada.b)).toBe(false);
    expect(await verifiedInPublic(ada.handle)).toBe(false);
    expect(await storedHash(ada.userId)).toBeNull();
    expect(mailsTo(ada.email).at(-1)).toBe("badge_removed");
    expect(await eventTypes(ada.userId)).toContain("badge_removed");
    // Removing a badge the account does not hold answers the same and tells nobody.
    const before = mailer.sent.length;
    expect((await ada.b.fetch("/api/auth/badge", { method: "DELETE" })).status).toBe(204);
    expect(mailer.sent).toHaveLength(before);
    // Nothing that left the server carries the number.
    expect(JSON.stringify(mailer.sent)).not.toContain(phone);
  });

  test("one number per account: the second account learns of the conflict only after its code, and the first keeps the badge", async () => {
    const ada = await signUp();
    const bob = await signUp();
    const phone = newPhone();
    expect((await verify(ada.b, await start(ada.b, phone), DEV_CODE)).status).toBe(200);
    // The start answers alike for a number another account holds: nothing is revealed before the code proves the phone.
    const bobFlow = await start(bob.b, phone);
    const conflict = await verify(bob.b, bobFlow, DEV_CODE);
    expect(conflict.status).toBe(409);
    expect(await errorCode(conflict)).toBe("phone_in_use");
    expect(await verifiedOnMe(ada.b)).toBe(true);
    expect(await verifiedOnMe(bob.b)).toBe(false);
    expect(await storedHash(bob.userId)).toBeNull();
    expect(await eventTypes(bob.userId)).not.toContain("badge_verified");
    // The holder can verify the same number again without conflict.
    expect((await verify(ada.b, await start(ada.b, phone), DEV_CODE)).status).toBe(200);
    expect(await verifiedOnMe(ada.b)).toBe(true);
  });

  test("with the provider off the badge routes answer badge_unavailable, and a badge can still be removed", async () => {
    const ada = await signUp(appOff);
    const started = await ada.b.fetch("/api/auth/badge/start", { json: { phone: newPhone() } });
    expect(started.status).toBe(404);
    expect(await errorCode(started)).toBe("badge_unavailable");
    const verified = await ada.b.fetch("/api/auth/badge/verify", { json: { flowId: randomToken(), code: DEV_CODE } });
    expect(verified.status).toBe(404);
    expect(await errorCode(verified)).toBe("badge_unavailable");
    expect((await ada.b.fetch("/api/auth/badge", { method: "DELETE" })).status).toBe(204);
  });
  test("3e: while the account's suspension runs, the start answers 403 account_suspended before any code is texted; a code that is right once the suspension began is refused the same, and the phone hash it wrote is cleared; removing the badge stays open", async () => {
    const ada = await signUp();
    const phone = newPhone();
    const flowId = await start(ada.b, phone);
    await suspendRowForTest(migrateDb, ada.userId);
    const refusedStart = await ada.b.fetch("/api/auth/badge/start", { json: { phone: newPhone() } });
    expect(refusedStart.status).toBe(403);
    expect(await errorCode(refusedStart)).toBe("account_suspended");
    const refusedVerify = await verify(ada.b, flowId, DEV_CODE);
    expect(refusedVerify.status).toBe(403);
    expect(await errorCode(refusedVerify)).toBe("account_suspended");
    expect(await storedHash(ada.userId)).toBeNull();
    expect(await verifiedOnMe(ada.b)).toBe(false);
    expect(mailsTo(ada.email)).not.toContain("badge_verified");
    expect(await eventTypes(ada.userId)).not.toContain("badge_verified");
    expect((await ada.b.fetch("/api/auth/badge", { method: "DELETE" })).status).toBe(204);
    await liftRowForTest(migrateDb, ada.userId);
    const again = await start(ada.b, phone);
    expect((await verify(ada.b, again, DEV_CODE)).status).toBe(200);
    expect(await verifiedOnMe(ada.b)).toBe(true);
  });
});

import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";

type App = ReturnType<typeof createApp>;

/**
 * Images through the real app: 1a sign-up for the accounts, cookie sessions with CSRF, the media and
 * social modules wired as the server wires them, and a stand-in for the worker on the store directory.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: images over HTTP", () => {
  let config: Config;
  let authDb: Db;
  let apiDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let app: App;
  const root = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "korbat-http-media-"));
  const uploads = uploadsLayout(path.join(root, "uploads"));
  const worker = fakeWorker(path.join(root, "store"));
  const mailer = new MemoryMailer();
  let offsetMs = 0;
  let tick = 0;
  const now = () => new Date(Date.now() + offsetMs + ++tick);

  beforeAll(async () => {
    config = loadConfig();
    const logger = pino({ level: "silent" });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 4 });
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    // 3e: only the migrator writes a suspension into a profile row, as the ledger's standing_apply does.
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 1 });
    const rateLimitStore = new MemoryStore(() => now().getTime());
    const auth = createAuth({
      config,
      logger,
      authDb,
      kv: new MemoryKv(),
      mailer,
      profiles: createProfileStore(apiDb),
      turnstile: { verify: async () => true },
      breachChecker: { isBreached: async () => false },
    });
    const media = createMedia({
      apiDb,
      uploadsDir: uploads.root,
      storeDir: path.join(root, "store"),
      formats: config.MEDIA_FORMATS,
      minFreeBytes: 0,
      logger,
      requireSession: auth.requireSession,
      resolveSession: auth.resolveSession,
      rateLimitStore,
      enforceUploadLimit: (userId, accountCreatedAt, at) => enforceWriteLimit(rateLimitStore, userId, "upload", accountCreatedAt, at),
      now,
    });
    await media.prepare();
    const social = createSocial({ apiDb, rateLimitStore, logger, requireSession: auth.requireSession, requireFreshAuth: auth.requireFreshAuth(), media: media.forPosts, now });
    app = createApp({ config, logger, rateLimitStore, healthChecks: {}, advisoryChecks: { image_worker: media.healthCheck }, auth, social, media });
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
    await closeDecisions();
    await Promise.all([closeDb(authDb), closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  async function signUp() {
    const b = new Browser(app, config.APP_ORIGIN);
    const email = `media-${randomUUID()}@korbat.local`;
    const handle = `m${randomBytes(4).toString("hex")}`;
    const start = await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/start", { json: { email, turnstileToken: "ok", deviceId: randomToken(), platform: "web" } });
    const { flowId } = FlowResponse.parse(await start.json());

    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/signup/complete", { json: { flowId, dateOfBirth: "1990-05-17", termsVersion: config.TERMS_VERSION } })).status).toBe(200);

  const jpeg = { type: "image/jpeg", body: BYTES.jpeg };

  async function readyImage(b: Browser): Promise<string> {
    const res = await b.fetch("/api/media", { raw: jpeg });
    expect(res.status).toBe(202);
    const { id } = UploadResponse.parse(await res.json());
    worker.ready(id, { width: 1200, height: 800 });
    expect(MediaStatusResponse.parse(await (await b.fetch(`/api/media/${id}`)).json()).status).toBe("ready");
    return id;
  }

  test("upload, wait, post, and read the image back, signed in and signed out", async () => {
    offsetMs = 3 * DAY_MS;
    const ada = await signUp();
    const sent = await ada.b.fetch("/api/media", { raw: jpeg });
    expect(sent.status).toBe(202);
    const { id } = UploadResponse.parse(await sent.json());
    expect(MediaStatusResponse.parse(await (await ada.b.fetch(`/api/media/${id}`)).json())).toEqual({ id, status: "processing" });
    expect((await app.request(`/api/media/${id}/large.webp`)).status).toBe(404);

    worker.ready(id, { width: 1200, height: 800 });
    expect(MediaStatusResponse.parse(await (await ada.b.fetch(`/api/media/${id.toUpperCase()}`)).json())).toMatchObject({ id, status: "ready", width: 1200, height: 800 });
    expect(existsSync(uploads.upload(id))).toBe(false);

    const created = await ada.b.fetch("/api/posts", { json: { body: "a photo", media: [{ id, alt: "  a harbour\n at dawn " }] } });
    expect(created.status).toBe(201);
    const post = PostView.parse(await created.json());
    expect(post.media).toEqual([{ id, width: 1200, height: 800, blurhash: "L2Eo_P_3jb_3~qoL", alt: "a harbour at dawn", small: `/api/media/${id}/small.webp`, large: `/api/media/${id}/large.webp` }]);

    const first = MediaView.parse(post.media[0]);
    const image = await app.request(first.large);
    expect(image.status).toBe(200);
    expect(image.headers.get("content-type")).toBe("image/webp");
    expect(image.headers.get("cache-control")).toBe("public, max-age=300");
    expect(image.headers.get("x-content-type-options")).toBe("nosniff");
    expect(await image.text()).toBe(`large-webp-of-${id}`);
    const again = await app.request(first.large, { headers: { "if-none-match": image.headers.get("etag")! } });
    expect(again.status).toBe(304);

    const latest = TimelinePage.parse(await (await app.request("/api/timeline/latest?limit=50")).json());
    expect(latest.items.find((item) => item.post.id === post.id)?.post.media[0]).toMatchObject({ alt: "a harbour at dawn" });
  });

import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import pino from "pino";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { EngagementResponse, ErrorEnvelope, FlowResponse, MeResponse, PostPage, PostView, ProfilePage, ProfileView, ThreadResponse, TimelinePage } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db } from "@korbat/db";

import { createAuth } from "../../src/auth";
import { randomToken } from "../../src/auth/crypto";
import { MemoryKv } from "../../src/auth/kv";
import { loadConfig, type Config } from "../../src/config";
import { MemoryMailer } from "../../src/mail/memory";
import { MemoryStore } from "../../src/middleware/rate-limit";
import { createProfileStore } from "../../src/profiles/store";
import { createSocial } from "../../src/social";
import { DAY_MS } from "../../src/social/tiers";
import { Browser } from "./http-client";
import { liftRowForTest, suspendRowForTest } from "./moderation-fixtures";

type App = ReturnType<typeof createApp>;

/**
 * The social endpoints through the real app: 1a sign-up for the accounts, cookie sessions with CSRF,
 * and a clock the tests move so accounts can age past the new-account tier.
 */

  let config: Config;
  let authDb: Db;
  let apiDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let app: App;
  const mailer = new MemoryMailer();
  let offsetMs = 0;
  let tick = 0;
  /** Strictly increasing even within one millisecond, so list order never depends on a tie-breaker. */
  const now = () => new Date(Date.now() + offsetMs + ++tick);

    config = loadConfig();
    const logger = pino({ level: "silent" });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 4 });
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    // 3e: only the migrator writes a suspension into a profile row, as the ledger's standing_apply does.
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 1 });
    const rateLimitStore = new MemoryStore(() => now().getTime());
    const auth = createAuth({
      config,
      logger,
      authDb,
      kv: new MemoryKv(),
      mailer,
      profiles: createProfileStore(apiDb),
      turnstile: { verify: async () => true },
      breachChecker: { isBreached: async () => false },
    });
    const social = createSocial({ apiDb, rateLimitStore, logger, requireSession: auth.requireSession, requireFreshAuth: auth.requireFreshAuth(), now });
    app = createApp({ config, logger, rateLimitStore, healthChecks: {}, auth, social });
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await Promise.all([closeDb(authDb), closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  /** A signed-in, onboarded web account. Accounts are as old as the clock offset says. */
  async function signUp() {
    const b = new Browser(app, config.APP_ORIGIN);
    const email = `social-${randomUUID()}@korbat.local`;
    const handle = `s${randomBytes(4).toString("hex")}`;
    const start = await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/start", { json: { email, turnstileToken: "ok", deviceId: randomToken(), platform: "web" } });
    expect(start.status).toBe(200);
    const { flowId } = FlowResponse.parse(await start.json());
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/verify", { json: { flowId, code: mailer.lastCodeFor(email) } })).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/signup/complete", { json: { flowId, dateOfBirth: "1990-05-17", termsVersion: config.TERMS_VERSION } })).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/onboarding/handle", { json: { handle, displayName: `User ${handle}` } })).status).toBe(200);
    return { b, handle };
  }

  const json = async (res: Response) => res.json() as Promise<unknown>;
  const errorCode = async (res: Response) => ErrorEnvelope.parse(await res.json()).error.code;
  const post = async (b: Browser, body: string, extra: Record<string, string> = {}) => {
    const res = await b.fetch("/api/posts", { json: { body, ...extra } });
    expect(res.status).toBe(201);
    return PostView.parse(await res.json());
  };

  test("posting, replying, quoting, reading a thread, and reading signed out", async () => {
    offsetMs = 3 * DAY_MS;
    const ada = await signUp();
    const root = await post(ada.b, "  hello\r\n\r\n\r\nworld  ");
    expect(root.body).toBe("hello\n\nworld");
    expect(root.author.handle).toBe(ada.handle);
    expect(root.viewer).toEqual({ liked: false, reposted: false, bookmarked: false });
    const reply = await post(ada.b, "a reply", { replyToId: root.id });
    expect(reply.replyTo).toEqual({ id: root.id, authorHandle: ada.handle });
    const quote = await post(ada.b, "a quote", { quoteOfId: root.id });
    expect(quote.quoteOf).toMatchObject({ id: root.id, body: "hello\n\nworld", quoteOf: null });

    const signedOut = await app.request(`/api/posts/${root.id}`);
    expect(signedOut.status).toBe(200);
    const view = PostView.parse(await signedOut.json());
    expect(view.viewer).toBeUndefined();
    expect(view.counts).toEqual({ likes: 0, reposts: 0, replies: 1, quotes: 1 });

    const thread = ThreadResponse.parse(await json(await app.request(`/api/posts/${reply.id}/thread`)));
    expect(thread.ancestors.map((a) => a.id)).toEqual([root.id]);
    expect(thread.post.id).toBe(reply.id);
    const both = await ada.b.fetch("/api/posts", { json: { body: "x", replyToId: root.id, quoteOfId: root.id } });
    expect(both.status).toBe(400);
    expect(await errorCode(both)).toBe("invalid_request");
  });

  test("follows, timelines, profiles and the follower lists", async () => {
    offsetMs = 3 * DAY_MS;
    const [ada, bob] = [await signUp(), await signUp()];
    const b1 = await post(bob.b, "from bob");

    const a1 = await post(ada.b, "from ada");
    const repost = EngagementResponse.parse(await json(await bob.b.fetch(`/api/posts/${a1.id}/repost`, { method: "POST" })));
    expect(repost.counts.reposts).toBe(1);

    const feed = TimelinePage.parse(await json(await ada.b.fetch("/api/timeline/following")));
    expect(feed.items.map((i) => (i.kind === "repost" ? `repost:${i.post.id}:${i.repostedBy.handle}` : `post:${i.post.id}`))).toEqual([
      `repost:${a1.id}:${bob.handle}`,

    expect(ProfileView.parse(await json(await app.request(`/api/profiles/${bob.handle}`))).viewer).toBeUndefined();

    expect(followersPage.items.map((i) => [i.handle, i.viewerFollows])).toEqual([[ada.handle, false]]);
    expect((await app.request(`/api/profiles/${bob.handle}/followers`)).status).toBe(401);

    expect(bobPosts.items.map((i) => i.kind)).toEqual(["repost", "post"]);
    expect((await ada.b.fetch(`/api/profiles/${bob.handle}/follow`, { method: "DELETE" })).status).toBe(200);
    expect(ProfileView.parse(await json(await app.request(`/api/profiles/${bob.handle}`))).counts.followers).toBe(0);

  test("likes, reposts and bookmarks with their private lists", async () => {

  test("blocks are directional in their errors, hide profiles both ways, and are listed for the blocker", async () => {
    offsetMs = 3 * DAY_MS;
    const [ada, bob] = [await signUp(), await signUp()];
    const adaPost = await post(ada.b, "ada's post");
    expect(await json(await ada.b.fetch(`/api/profiles/${bob.handle}/block`, { method: "POST" }))).toEqual({ blocked: true });

    const bobSeesAda = await bob.b.fetch(`/api/profiles/${ada.handle}`);
    expect(bobSeesAda.status).toBe(404);
    expect((await bob.b.fetch(`/api/posts/${adaPost.id}`)).status).toBe(404);
    const bobFollows = await bob.b.fetch(`/api/profiles/${ada.handle}/follow`, { method: "POST" });

    expect(bobLikes.status).toBe(404);

    expect(await errorCode(bobReplies)).toBe("post_unavailable");

    expect((await ada.b.fetch(`/api/profiles/${bob.handle}`)).status).toBe(404);
    const adaFollows = await ada.b.fetch(`/api/profiles/${bob.handle}/follow`, { method: "POST" });

    expect((await app.request(`/api/profiles/${ada.handle}`)).status).toBe(200);

  test("mutes are silent and hide the muted account from timelines only", async () => {

  test("new accounts get the low tier with Retry-After, and the tier lifts as the account ages", async () => {
    offsetMs = 0;

    const repost = await young.b.fetch(`/api/posts/${own.id}/repost`, { method: "POST" });

    const quote = await young.b.fetch("/api/posts", { json: { body: "quote", quoteOfId: own.id } });

    offsetMs = 3 * DAY_MS;
    expect((await young.b.fetch("/api/posts", { json: { body: "established now" } })).status).toBe(201);
    expect((await young.b.fetch(`/api/posts/${own.id}/repost`, { method: "POST" })).status).toBe(200);

    expect((await app.request(`/api/posts/${root.id}`)).status).toBe(404);
    const thread = ThreadResponse.parse(await json(await app.request(`/api/posts/${reply.id}/thread`)));
    expect(thread.ancestors).toEqual([{ id: root.id, deleted: true }]);
    expect(TimelinePage.parse(await json(await app.request(`/api/profiles/${ada.handle}/posts`))).items).toEqual([]);

  test("3e: while an account's suspension runs, its post, like, repost, bookmark and follow answer 403 account_suspended with no detail; undoing, deleting, blocking and muting answer as ever", async () => {
    offsetMs = 3 * DAY_MS;
    const [ada, bob] = await Promise.all([signUp(), signUp()]);
    const theirs = await post(bob.b, "bob's post");
    const own = await post(ada.b, "ada's post");
    expect((await ada.b.fetch(`/api/posts/${theirs.id}/like`, { method: "POST" })).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await ada.b.fetch(`/api/profiles/${bob.handle}/follow`, { method: "POST" })).status).toBe(200);
    const [row] = await apiDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from profiles where handle = ${ada.handle}`);
    await suspendRowForTest(migrateDb, row!.id);
    const refused = async (res: Response) => {
      expect(res.status).toBe(403);
      const body = ErrorEnvelope.parse(await res.json());
      expect(body.error.code).toBe("account_suspended");
      expect(body.error.details).toBeUndefined();
    };
    await refused(await ada.b.fetch("/api/posts", { json: { body: "while suspended" } }));
    await refused(await ada.b.fetch("/api/posts", { json: { body: "a reply", replyToId: theirs.id } }));
    for (const kind of ["repost", "bookmark"]) await refused(await ada.b.fetch(`/api/posts/${theirs.id}/${kind}`, { method: "POST" }));
    // Already following bob makes no difference: the follow's lock statement refuses before anything is written.
    await refused(await ada.b.fetch(`/api/profiles/${bob.handle}/follow`, { method: "POST" }));
    expect((await ada.b.fetch(`/api/posts/${theirs.id}/like`, { method: "DELETE" })).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await ada.b.fetch(`/api/profiles/${bob.handle}/follow`, { method: "DELETE" })).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await ada.b.fetch(`/api/profiles/${bob.handle}/mute`, { method: "POST" })).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await ada.b.fetch(`/api/posts/${own.id}`, { method: "DELETE" })).status).toBe(204);
    // What others do toward it is unchanged.
    expect((await bob.b.fetch(`/api/profiles/${ada.handle}/follow`, { method: "POST" })).status).toBe(200);
    // An app built without the moderation module answers /api/me's standing null.
    expect(MeResponse.parse(await (await ada.b.fetch("/api/me")).json()).standing).toBeNull();
    await liftRowForTest(migrateDb, row!.id);
    expect((await ada.b.fetch("/api/posts", { json: { body: "after" } })).status).toBe(201);
  });

  test("cursors page the Latest timeline and malformed ones are refused", async () => {
    offsetMs = 3 * DAY_MS;
    const ada = await signUp();
    const made = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) made.push((await post(ada.b, `page ${i}`)).id);
    const first = TimelinePage.parse(await json(await app.request("/api/timeline/latest?limit=2")));
    expect(first.items).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(first.nextCursor).not.toBeNull();
    const second = TimelinePage.parse(await json(await app.request(`/api/timeline/latest?limit=2&cursor=${encodeURIComponent(first.nextCursor!)}`)));
    expect(second.items.map((i) => i.post.id)).not.toEqual(first.items.map((i) => i.post.id));
    const bad = await app.request("/api/timeline/latest?cursor=not-a-cursor");
    expect(bad.status).toBe(400);
    expect(await errorCode(bad)).toBe("invalid_request");
    expect((await app.request("/api/profiles/no_such_handle_xyz")).status).toBe(404);
  });
});

import { existsSync, readdirSync, readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { MEDIA_MAX_BYTES, MediaStatusResponse, UploadResponse } from "@korbat/contracts";

import { status } from "../../src/media/flows/status";
import { upload } from "../../src/media/flows/upload";

import { liftRowForTest, suspendRowForTest } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { rejection } from "./social-harness";

describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: media upload, status and removal", () => {

  let migrateDb: Db;
  let h: MediaHarness;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    db = createDb(loadConfig().DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    // 3e: only the migrator writes a suspension into a profile row, as the ledger's standing_apply does.
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 1 });

  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    h.cleanup();
    await Promise.all([closeDb(db), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  const failure = async (promise: Promise<unknown>) => {
    try {
      await promise;
      return null;
    } catch (err) {
      const e = err as { code?: string; status?: number; message?: string };
      return { code: e.code, status: e.status, message: e.message };
    }
  };

  test("an upload is stored for the worker and owned by its account; the worker's verdict is recorded once", async () => {
    const ada = await h.established();
    const sent = UploadResponse.parse(await upload(h.deps, ada.id, h.jpeg()));
    expect(readFileSync(h.files.uploads.upload(sent.id))).toEqual(BYTES.jpeg);
    expect(readdirSync(h.files.uploads.tmp)).toEqual([]);
    expect(await status(h.deps, ada.id, sent.id)).toEqual({ id: sent.id, status: "processing" });

    h.worker.ready(sent.id, { width: 1600, height: 1200 });
    const ready = MediaStatusResponse.parse(await status(h.deps, ada.id, sent.id));
    expect(ready).toEqual({ id: sent.id, status: "ready", width: 1600, height: 1200, blurhash: "L2Eo_P_3jb_3~qoL" });
    expect(existsSync(h.files.uploads.upload(sent.id))).toBe(false);

    h.worker.failed(sent.id, "corrupt_image");
    expect(await status(h.deps, ada.id, sent.id)).toEqual(ready);
  });

  test("a refused image reports the worker's reason", async () => {
    const ada = await h.established();
    const sent = await upload(h.deps, ada.id, h.jpeg());
    h.worker.failed(sent.id, "animated_not_supported");
    expect(await status(h.deps, ada.id, sent.id)).toEqual({ id: sent.id, status: "failed", error: "animated_not_supported" });
    expect(existsSync(h.files.uploads.upload(sent.id))).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the status of an upload is for its owner only", async () => {
    const [ada, bob] = await Promise.all([h.established(), h.established()]);
    const sent = await upload(h.deps, ada.id, h.jpeg());
    expect(await rejection(status(h.deps, bob.id, sent.id))).toBe("not_found");
    expect(await rejection(status(h.deps, ada.id, h.newId()))).toBe("not_found");
  });

  test("the declared type must be an accepted image type; HEIC is told what to do", async () => {
    const ada = await h.established();
    for (const contentType of [undefined, "", "text/plain", "image/svg+xml", "image/tiff", "application/octet-stream"]) {
      expect(await failure(upload(h.deps, ada.id, { ...h.jpeg(), contentType })), String(contentType)).toMatchObject({ code: "unsupported_media_type", status: 415 });
    }

    expect((await upload(h.deps, ada.id, { ...h.jpeg(), contentType: "IMAGE/JPEG; charset=binary" })).status).toBe("processing");
  });

  test("the first bytes decide, and a refused file leaves no row and no file", async () => {

    expect((await failure(upload(h.deps, ada.id, { ...h.jpeg(), body: bodyOf(BYTES.heic) })))?.message).toMatch(/Export the photo as JPEG/);
    expect((await failure(upload(h.deps, ada.id, { contentType: "image/webp", contentLength: undefined, body: bodyOf(BYTES.animatedWebp) })))?.message).toMatch(/Animated images/);
    expect(await failure(upload(h.deps, ada.id, { ...h.jpeg(), body: null }))).toMatchObject({ code: "unsupported_media_type" });
    expect(await h.deps.repo.pendingCount(ada.id)).toBe(before);
    expect(readdirSync(h.files.uploads.tmp)).toEqual([]);
    expect((await upload(h.deps, ada.id, { contentType: "image/jpeg", contentLength: undefined, body: bodyOf(BYTES.png) })).status).toBe("processing");

    expect(await failure(upload(only.deps, ada.id, { contentType: "image/jpeg", contentLength: undefined, body: bodyOf(BYTES.png) }))).toMatchObject({ code: "unsupported_media_type" });
    expect((await upload(only.deps, ada.id, only.jpeg())).status).toBe("processing");
    only.cleanup();

  test("20 MiB is the limit, whether the length is declared or not", async () => {

    const mib = new Uint8Array(1024 * 1024);
    const chunks = [BYTES.jpeg, ...Array.from({ length: 20 }, () => mib)];
    expect(await failure(upload(h.deps, ada.id, { ...h.jpeg(), contentLength: "1000", body: bodyOf(...chunks) }))).toMatchObject({ code: "file_too_large", status: 413 });
    expect(readdirSync(h.files.uploads.tmp)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("an account holds at most 20 uploads that are not on a post", async () => {
    const ada = await h.established();

});

 * action, the authenticator's assertion, the auth module's verification, and then the moderation module's decide.

export interface RealStaff extends TestStaff {
  handle: string;
  soft: SoftAuthenticator;
  credentialId: string;
  session: ActiveStaffSession;
  /** The signature counter the authenticator last reported; each use reports the next. */
  counter: number;
}

export interface DeciderWorld {

  moderation: ReturnType<typeof createModeration>;
  /** A new staff account with a profile, a real key and a staff session. */
  staff(role?: "moderator" | "admin"): Promise<RealStaff>;
  /** A verified confirmation of exactly these params, by the member's own key in the member's session. */
  confirm(member: RealStaff, caseId: string, params: CaseDecidedParams): Promise<StaffStepUpConfirmed>;
  /** A whole confirmed decision on the case: the params as the console builds them, the confirmation, and decide. */
  decideAs(member: RealStaff, caseId: string, input?: DecisionInput, options?: DecideOptions): Promise<DecideOutcome>;
  /** A verified confirmation of exactly this review of the decision, by the member's own key in the member's session. */
  confirmReview(member: RealStaff, decisionId: string, params: AppealsReviewedParams): Promise<StaffStepUpConfirmed>;
  /** A whole confirmed review of the decision's pending appeal: the params as the console builds them, the confirmation, and review. */
  reviewAs(member: RealStaff, decisionId: string, input?: ReviewInput): Promise<DecideOutcome>;

  close(options?: { keepStaff?: boolean }): Promise<void>;
}

/** What a test may give the world in place of its own: the auth module's interface (none unless given: every member then throws) and the limit store. */
export interface DeciderOptions {

  rateLimitStore?: RateLimitStore;
}

export function deciderWorld(apiDb: Db, options: DeciderOptions = {}): DeciderWorld {
  const config = loadConfig();
  const authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 4 });
  // The migrate role issues enrolment links, which only it may; the test environment carries its URL.
  const migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
  const repo = createAuthRepo(authDb);

   * The harness's clock stands still unless moved, and a step-up challenge lives ten minutes from it; the audit row is
   * stamped by the database's clock. So the harness's clock is brought to the real time before every flow.

  const sync = () => h.clock.advance(Date.now() - h.clock.ms());

    const { session } = await signedIn(h, soft, enrolled.credentialId, 1);
    const member: RealStaff = { id: user.id, keyId: enrolled.key.id, role, handle, soft, credentialId: enrolled.credentialId, session, counter: 1 };
    members.push(member);
    return member;
  }

  async function confirm(member: RealStaff, caseId: string, params: CaseDecidedParams): Promise<StaffStepUpConfirmed> {
    sync();
    const request = { action: "case_decided" as const, target: { type: "case" as const, id: caseId }, params };
    const stepUp = await stepUpAssertion(h, member.soft, member.credentialId, member.session, request, { counter: ++member.counter });
    return verifyStepUp(h.deps, member.session, request, stepUp, { ...h.ctx, requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` });

  async function decideAs(member: RealStaff, caseId: string, input: DecisionInput = {}, options: DecideOptions = {}): Promise<DecideOutcome> {
    const params = await decisionParams(apiDb, member, caseId, input);

    const ctx = { requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` };

    const outcome = options.allKinds ? await decide(moderation.deps, member.session, confirmed, ctx, options) : await moderation.forStaff.decide(member.session, confirmed, ctx);
    // What a decision starts after its commit (the statement's mail, the staff alerts) has ended before the test goes on.
    await moderation.settle();
    return outcome;
  }

  async function confirmReview(member: RealStaff, decisionId: string, params: AppealsReviewedParams): Promise<StaffStepUpConfirmed> {
    sync();
    const request = { action: "appeals_reviewed" as const, target: { type: "decision" as const, id: decisionId }, params };
    const stepUp = await stepUpAssertion(h, member.soft, member.credentialId, member.session, request, { counter: ++member.counter });
    return verifyStepUp(h.deps, member.session, request, stepUp, { ...h.ctx, requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` });
  }

  async function reviewAs(member: RealStaff, decisionId: string, input: ReviewInput = {}): Promise<DecideOutcome> {
    const params = await reviewParams(apiDb, member, decisionId, input);
    const outcome = await moderation.forStaff.review(member.session, await confirmReview(member, decisionId, params), { requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` });
    // As after a decision: what the review started after its commit has ended before the test goes on.
    await moderation.settle();
    return outcome;
  }

  async function close(options: { keepStaff?: boolean } = {}): Promise<void> {
    try {
      if (!options.keepStaff && members.length > 0) await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from profiles where id = any(${uuids(members.map((member) => member.id))})`);
    } finally {
      await Promise.all([closeDb(authDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
    }
  }

  return { authDb, migrateDb, moderation, staff, confirm, decideAs, confirmReview, reviewAs, close };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- decideForTest

let world: DeciderWorld | null = null;
let admin: Promise<RealStaff> | null = null;
/** The posts decideForTest decided in this test file. */
const decidedPosts = new Set<string>();
/** The accounts suspendForTest suspended in this test file: their account cases go with closeDecisions. */
const decidedAccounts = new Set<string>();

/** The id of a committed decision, or a failure that says why none committed. */
function decided(outcome: DecideOutcome, what: string): string {
  if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`decideForTest: ${what} was not recorded (${outcome})`);
  return outcome.decisionId;
}

/**
 * Puts a post into a moderation state the only way one comes about: by a real, confirmed decision (3c design, section
 * 12). The suites of posting, timelines, Explore and images used to write posts.state themselves; the posts' guard now
 * refuses that for the API role, and nothing but the ledger of measures moves a post's level.
 *
 * - `withheld`: an admin's own finding under R1 opens a case on the post, and an interim decision withholds it.
 * - `removed`: the same finding, and a final decision removes it, which closes the case.
 * - `visible`: what was done is undone: the post's open case is closed by a final decision that finds no breach, which
 *   ends its interim withhold, and every removal in force is reversed in full by a correction.
 *
 * It takes the API's pool. The staff account, its key and its session are made once for each test file; closeDecisions
 * removes what the decisions left.
 */
export async function decideForTest(apiDb: Db, postId: string, state: "withheld" | "removed" | "visible"): Promise<void> {
  world ??= deciderWorld(apiDb);
  admin ??= world.staff("admin");
  const [w, staff] = [world, await admin];
  decidedPosts.add(postId);
  if (state === "visible") {
    const [open] = await apiDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from cases where target_type = 'post' and target_id = ${postId}::uuid and closed_at is null`);
    if (open) decided(await w.decideAs(staff, open.id, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" }), "the closing decision");
    const removals = await apiDb.execute<{ decision_id: string; case_id: string }>(sql`select decision_id, case_id from measures_in_force where post_id = ${postId}::uuid and kind = 'remove'`);
    for (const removal of removals) {
      decided(await w.decideAs(staff, removal.case_id, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: removal.decision_id, actions: [act("restore")] }), "the correction");
    }
    return;
  }
  const recorded = await recordIntake(w.moderation.deps, { ground: ground.finding(staff.id, "R1"), live: [{ type: "post", id: postId, position: 1 }] });
  const caseId = recorded.items[0]!.caseId!;
  decided(await w.decideAs(staff, caseId, state === "withheld" ? { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] } : { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] }), `the decision that makes the post ${state}`);
}

/**
 * Gives an account `n` strikes the way strikes come about (3e design, section 12): for each, a post the account makes
 * now, an admin's own finding on it under the rule, and a final removal through the decide route's own code, which signs
 * the strike the database computes. Each decision commits, and so is told to the account, before its next post is made,
 * so each post is newer than the newest strike and each removal gives one. Answers the decisions, oldest first; fails when
 * one gave no strike. closeDecisions removes what it committed, as for decideForTest; the account's posts stay.
 */
export async function strikeForTest(apiDb: Db, accountId: string, n: number, rule: RuleId = "R1"): Promise<string[]> {
  world ??= deciderWorld(apiDb);
  admin ??= world.staff("admin");
  const [w, staff] = [world, await admin];
  const decisions: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    // Made in a statement of its own after the previous decision committed: later than the time that decision was told.
    const postId = await newPostRow(apiDb, accountId, { createdAt: sql`clock_timestamp()`, body: `a post that breaks ${rule}` });
    decidedPosts.add(postId);
    const recorded = await recordIntake(w.moderation.deps, { ground: ground.finding(staff.id, rule), live: [{ type: "post", id: postId, position: 1 }] });
    const id = decided(await w.decideAs(staff, recorded.items[0]!.caseId!, { kind: "final", ruleId: rule, actions: [act("remove")] }), "a removal that gives a strike");
    const [struck] = await apiDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from decision_actions where decision_id = ${id}::uuid and kind = 'strike'`);
    if (struck!.n !== 1) throw new Error("strikeForTest: the removal gave no strike");
    decisions.push(id);
  }
  return decisions;
}

/** What suspendForTest made: the suspension's decision and case, and the decision it rests on. */
export interface SuspendedForTest {
  decisionId: string;
  caseId: string;
  basisDecisionId: string;
}

/**
 * Suspends an account at once the way a suspension at once comes about (3e design, section 12): through the decide
 * route's own code (moderation.forStaff.decide, with a real confirmation by an admin's key), on the basis `threat`, which
 * it makes first: a post the account makes now, an admin's own finding on it under R5 and a final removal, which gives
 * the strike the database computes. Then an admin's finding under R5 on the account opens its case, and a final decision
 * on it holds `{ kind: "suspend", days, announced: false }`. The suspension starts with that decision, and every write of
 * the account is refused from then on. Task 4 adds `announced: true`. closeDecisions removes what it committed, the
 * account's case included; the account's posts and profile stay.
 */
export async function suspendForTest(apiDb: Db, accountId: string, options: { days?: number; announced?: false } = {}): Promise<SuspendedForTest> {
  world ??= deciderWorld(apiDb);
  admin ??= world.staff("admin");
  const [w, staff] = [world, await admin];
  const postId = await newPostRow(apiDb, accountId, { createdAt: sql`clock_timestamp()`, body: "a post with a direct threat" });
  decidedPosts.add(postId);
  decidedAccounts.add(accountId);
  const finding = await recordIntake(w.moderation.deps, { ground: ground.finding(staff.id, "R5"), live: [{ type: "post", id: postId, position: 1 }] });
  const basisDecisionId = decided(await w.decideAs(staff, finding.items[0]!.caseId!, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: [act("remove")] }), "the R5 removal a suspension at once rests on");
  const [profile] = await apiDb.execute<{ handle: string }>(sql`select handle from profiles where id = ${accountId}::uuid`);
  const onAccount = await recordIntake(w.moderation.deps, { ground: ground.finding(staff.id, "R5"), live: [{ type: "account", id: accountId, position: 1, namedHandle: profile!.handle }] });
  const caseId = onAccount.items[0]!.caseId!;
  const decisionId = decided(await w.decideAs(staff, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: [timed("suspend", options.days ?? 7, false)] }), "the suspension at once");
  return { decisionId, caseId, basisDecisionId };
}

/**
 * Removes what decideForTest committed in this test file, if it was used, and closes the pools it opened: the cases of
 * the posts it decided with their items, decisions, measures, texts, snapshots and intakes, and the staff account's
 * profile; the posts' levels are derived again. Two kinds of row stay, and no suite counts either. The audit rows (the
 * staff account's enrolment and sign-in, and one case_decided row for each decision): the audit log is an append-only
 * chain, and audit-verify refuses a record with a row gone. And the staff account's rows in the auth schema (the account,
 * its key, its session and its events), which the auth suites leave for their own accounts too. Calling it again does
 * nothing.
 */
export async function closeDecisions(): Promise<void> {
  const [used, member, posts, accounts] = [world, admin, [...decidedPosts], [...decidedAccounts]];
  world = null;
  admin = null;
  decidedPosts.clear();
  decidedAccounts.clear();
  if (!used) return;
  try {
    const staff = member ? await member.catch(() => null) : null;
    await removeDecided(used.migrateDb, posts, staff ? [staff.id] : [], accounts);
  } finally {
    await used.close({ keepStaff: true });
  }
}

/**
 * Holds a test file that uses decideForTest to leaving no moderation row behind. Called last inside the file's describe,
 * with a getter of its pool: it reads the moderation tables' row counts before the file's first test, and adds the file's
 * last test, which removes what decideForTest committed and expects the counts unchanged. The file's own posts and
 * profiles stay, as they always did.
 */
export function leavesNoModerationRows(db: () => Db): void {
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  beforeAll(async () => {
    before = await moderationCounts(db());
  });
  test("this file left no moderation row behind: what put its posts into their states is removed, and the moderation tables hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await closeDecisions();
    expect(await moderationCounts(db())).toEqual(before);
  }, 30_000);
}
