```tsx
import { FINDING_CATEGORIES, MEASURES, RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY, type AppealsReviewedParams, type CaseDecision, type CaseView, type DecisionActionParams, type MeasureKind, type RuleId, type TdbCategory } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { RULES, statementParagraphs, type StatementInput } from "@korbat/rules";
import {
  COMPOSER,
  complete,
  correctable,
  correctionChoices,
  holds,
  kindsOffered,
  lawOffered,
  leftOpen,
  liftable,
  liftedKind,
  hiddenWhileDeciding,
  imagesOffered,
  measuresOffered,
  AT_ONCE_DAYS,
  AT_ONCE_ORDER,
  atOnceState,
  suspensionOf,
  withAtOnce,
  type AtOnceKey,
  noEffectOf,
  offeredDraft,
  outcomesListed,
  previewOf,
  previewable,
  retireMoved,
  retireOpen,
  reviewChoices,
  reviewOutcomeOf,
  reviewable,
  sealOffered,
  snapshotImages,
  standingStrikeOf,
  strikeCarriesStanding,
  strikeLine,
  statementSent,
  suspectOpen,
  throughSeqOf,
  toggled,
  type CaseDraft,
  type DraftTextKind,
  type StaffRole,
} from "../compose";
import { APPEAL_WORDS, COMPOSER_KINDS, COMPOSER_OUTCOMES, COMPOSER_WORDS, REVIEW_OUTCOMES, STANDING_WORDS } from "../messages";
import { dateTime, UserText } from "../ui";
import { categoryLabel } from "../words";

/**
 * The decision composer (3c design, section 8): the outcome first, then, for a restriction, the kind, the ground and the
 * measures this target and kind allow; the category; the facts and the reason; and the preview, which is the statement
 * exactly as its author will receive it. What it offers follows the case and the person's role; the database checks
 * every rule again when the key has confirmed. A correction ("Lift what was done while deciding", "Correct this
 * decision") takes the composer's place while it is open, and so does the review of an appeal ("Review this appeal").
 */

/** "Do not seal now": the reason as typed, and what became of saving it. */
export interface DecliningState {
  reason: string;
  busy: boolean;
  error: string | null;
}

export interface ComposerViewProps {
  view: CaseView;
  role: StaffRole;
  draft: CaseDraft;
  /** The time the preview is rendered for: the decision's time, were it confirmed now. */
  now: Date;
  busy: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  /** The refusal of a text's save, worded in place under its field. */
  textErrors: Partial<Record<DraftTextKind, string>>;
  declining: DecliningState | null;
  onChange(change: Partial<CaseDraft>): void;
  /** A text's field lost focus: the text is saved, without the key. */
  onTextBlur(kind: DraftTextKind): void;
  /** "Seal the images this case reaches". */
  onSeal(): void;
  onConfirm(): void;
  onDeclineOpen(): void;
  onDeclineChange(reason: string): void;
  onDeclineSave(): void;
  onDeclineClose(): void;
  onCancelCorrection(): void;
}

/**
 * The statement as its author will receive it, each paragraph as text in a frame of its own direction. In its place the
 * page says so when there is nothing to show yet (a restriction without a measure), nothing it can show (a post whose
 * snapshot cannot be shown: no creation time is made up), or nothing that is sent.
 */
function Preview({ view, draft, now }: Pick<ComposerViewProps, "view" | "draft" | "now">) {
  // A restriction without a measure has no statement yet: the page says so rather than show one that restricts nothing.
  if (draft.kind !== "correction" && draft.kind !== "review" && draft.outcome === "restricted" && !draft.actions.some((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null)) {
    return <p className="hint">{COMPOSER.previewNeedsMeasure}</p>;
  }
  if (!previewable(view)) return <p className="hint">{COMPOSER_WORDS.previewAfterSnapshot}</p>;
  let input: StatementInput;
  let paragraphs: string[];
  try {
    input = previewOf(view, draft, now);
    paragraphs = statementParagraphs(input);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
  // A decision that restricts nothing and ends nothing sends its author nothing: no statement is shown as if it were sent.
  if (!statementSent(input)) return <p className="hint">{COMPOSER_WORDS.noStatement}</p>;
  return (
    <div className="frame preview">
      <h4>Preview: the statement as its author will receive it</h4>
      {paragraphs.map((paragraph, index) => (
        <p key={index} className="frame-text">
          <UserText>{paragraph}</UserText>
        </p>
      ))}
      {draft.actions.some((action) => action.kind === "seal_media") ? <p className="hint">{COMPOSER_WORDS.sealSettled}</p> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

/** One of the draft's texts, as its person types it. It is saved when the field loses focus; a refusal of that save stands under the field. */
function TextField({ id, label, kind, rows, props, under }: { id: string; label: string; kind: DraftTextKind; rows: number; props: ComposerViewProps; under: string[] }) {
  const { draft } = props;
  const refused = props.textErrors[kind];
  return (
    <>
      <label htmlFor={id}>{label}</label>
      <textarea
        id={id}
        rows={rows}
        value={draft.written[kind]}
        disabled={props.busy}
        onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ written: { ...draft.written, [kind]: event.target.value } })}
        onBlur={() => props.onTextBlur(kind)}
      />
      {refused ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {refused}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {under.map((sentence) => (
        <p key={sentence} className="hint">
          {sentence}
        </p>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}

function Confirm({ props, onCancel }: { props: ComposerViewProps; onCancel?: () => void }) {
  return (
    <>
      {props.error ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {props.error}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <div className="actions">
        <button type="button" className="primary" onClick={props.onConfirm} disabled={props.busy || !complete(props.view, props.draft)} aria-busy={props.busy}>
          Confirm with your staff key
        </button>
        {onCancel ? (
          <button type="button" onClick={onCancel} disabled={props.busy}>
            Cancel
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * 3e (design, section 8.7): beside a correction or a review of a decision whose strike stands, that the strike falls only
 * with its whole finding, and, when a suspension or termination that stands rests on it, what reversing it does.
 */
function StrikeNotes({ decision }: { decision: CaseDecision }) {
  if (standingStrikeOf(decision) === undefined) return null;
  return (
    <>
      <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.reviewStrike}</p>
      {strikeCarriesStanding(decision) ? <p className="notice">{STANDING_WORDS.reviewRests}</p> : null}
    </>
  );
}

/** A correction of one decision: what of it to lift, the reason, and the preview. */
function CorrectionView(props: ComposerViewProps) {
  const { view, role, draft } = props;
  const decision = view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === draft.reviewsDecisionId);
  const choices = correctionChoices(view, draft, role);
  if (!decision || choices.length === 0) {
    return (
      <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
        <h3 id="composer-title">{COMPOSER.correctLabel}</h3>
        <p>Nothing of that decision is in force any more.</p>
        <div className="actions">
          <button type="button" onClick={props.onCancelCorrection}>
            Cancel
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }
  const deciding = decision.kind === "interim";
  return (
    <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
      <h3 id="composer-title">{deciding ? COMPOSER.liftLabel : COMPOSER.correctLabel}</h3>
      <p>{`The decision of ${dateTime(decision.decidedAt)}. A correction only lifts: choose what of it to lift.`}</p>
      <ul className="plain">
        {choices.map(({ measure, reversal }) => (
          <li key={measure.id}>
            <label>
              <input type="checkbox" checked={holds(draft, reversal)} disabled={props.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ actions: toggled(draft, reversal, event.target.checked) })} />{" "}
              <span>{MEASURES[reversal.kind].label}</span>
              {measure.mediaId === null ? null : (
                <>
                  {" "}
                  <code>{measure.mediaId}</code>
                </>
              )}
            </label>
            {reversal.kind === "unseal_media" ? <p className="notice">{deciding ? COMPOSER.sealInError : COMPOSER.sealForGood}</p> : null}
            {/* 3e (design, section 8.7): [review.handle] beside "Give the handle back". */}
            {reversal.kind === "unretire_handle" ? <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.reviewHandle}</p> : null}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <StrikeNotes decision={decision} />
      <StandingNotes decision={decision} />
      <TextField id="compose-review-reason" label="Reason of the correction" kind="review_reason" rows={3} props={props} under={[COMPOSER.personalData]} />
      <Preview view={view} draft={draft} now={props.now} />
      <Confirm props={props} onCancel={props.onCancelCorrection} />
    </section>
  );
}

const REVIEW_ANSWERS: AppealsReviewedParams["outcome"][] = ["kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"];

/**
 * The review of an appeal (3c design, section 8): Keep, Reverse in part or Reverse; the reversals of the decision's
 * measures that are still in force; the reason; and the preview of the review's statement. A review only lifts. "Keep"
 * lifts nothing and "Reverse" everything still in force, so the page sets those itself; "Reverse in part" is chosen
 * measure by measure. Once the appeal is answered, or for a person the API did not mark as its reviewer, nothing is
 * offered but the way back.
 */
function ReviewView(props: ComposerViewProps) {
  const { view, role, draft } = props;
  const decision = view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === draft.reviewsDecisionId);
  const offered = decision ? reviewable(view, decision) : null;
  if (!decision || offered === null) {
    return (
      <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
        <h3 id="composer-title">{COMPOSER.reviewLabel}</h3>
        <p>{APPEAL_WORDS.notYours}</p>
        <div className="actions">
          <button type="button" onClick={props.onCancelCorrection}>
            Cancel
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }
  const choices = reviewChoices(view, draft, role);
  const answer = reviewOutcomeOf(view, draft);
  // "Keep" lifts nothing and "Reverse" everything still in force; a part keeps what was chosen while it is one, and starts empty otherwise.
  const partial = draft.actions.length > 0 && draft.actions.length < choices.length;
  const choose = (next: AppealsReviewedParams["outcome"]) => props.onChange({ review: next, actions: next === "reversed" ? choices.map((choice) => choice.reversal) : next === "partly_reversed" && partial ? draft.actions : [] });
  return (
    <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
      <h3 id="composer-title">{COMPOSER.reviewLabel}</h3>
      <p>{`The decision of ${dateTime(decision.decidedAt)}. A review keeps it or lifts measures of it, and never adds one.`}</p>
      <fieldset>
        <legend>Answer</legend>
        {REVIEW_ANSWERS.map((option) => (
          <label key={option}>
            <input type="radio" name="compose-review" checked={answer === option} disabled={props.busy} onChange={() => choose(option)} /> <span>{REVIEW_OUTCOMES[option]}</span>
          </label>
        ))}
      </fieldset>
      <ul className="plain">
        {choices.map(({ measure, reversal }) => (
          <li key={measure.id}>
            <label>
              {/* What "Keep" and "Reverse" lift follows from the answer: only a part is chosen measure by measure. */}
              <input type="checkbox" checked={holds(draft, reversal)} disabled={props.busy || answer !== "partly_reversed"} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ actions: toggled(draft, reversal, event.target.checked) })} />{" "}
              <span>{MEASURES[reversal.kind].label}</span>
              {measure.mediaId === null ? null : (
                <>
                  {" "}
                  <code>{measure.mediaId}</code>
                </>
              )}
            </label>
            {reversal.kind === "unseal_media" ? <p className="notice">{COMPOSER.sealForGood}</p> : null}
            {reversal.kind === "unretire_handle" ? <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.reviewHandle}</p> : null}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <StrikeNotes decision={decision} />
      <StandingNotes decision={decision} />
      <TextField id="compose-review-reason" label="Reason of the review" kind="review_reason" rows={3} props={props} under={[COMPOSER.personalData]} />
      <Preview view={view} draft={draft} now={props.now} />
      <Confirm props={props} onCancel={props.onCancelCorrection} />
    </section>
  );
}

/**
 * 3e (design, section 8.7): beside a review or a correction, what reversing the decision ends: a suspension (or
 * termination) taken at once that rests on it ([review.basis]); and for a decision that holds a protective suspension,
 * that its review does not wait for the authorities ([review.protective]).
 */
function StandingNotes({ decision }: { decision: CaseDecision }) {
  const basis = (decision.standingOn ?? []).some((entry) => entry.basis === "threat" || entry.basis === "terrorist" || entry.basis === "protective" || entry.basis === "threat_repeat");
  const protective = decision.actions.some((action) => action.kind === "suspend" && action.basis === "protective");
  if (!basis && !protective) return null;
  return (
    <>
      {basis ? <p className="notice">{STANDING_WORDS.reviewBasis}</p> : null}
      {protective ? <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.reviewProtective}</p> : null}
    </>
  );
}

/** The sentence of one ground of a suspension at once, with the case answer's numbers where it has them. */
function groundSentence(view: CaseView, ground: AtOnceKey): string {
  const standing = view.standing;
  if (ground === "flood") return STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.flood(standing?.flood.posts ?? 0, dateTime(standing?.flood.from ?? ""), dateTime(standing?.flood.to ?? ""));
  if (ground === "protective") return standing?.seal ? STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.protective(standing.seal.decidedOn) : STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.noSeal;
  return STANDING_WORDS.atOnce[ground];
}

/** The sentence that greys "Suspend at once", by its key. */
const CLOSED_WORDS = {
  conflict: STANDING_WORDS.conflict,
  admin: STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.admin,
  other: STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.other,
  reportsFirst: STANDING_WORDS.reportsFirst,
  noSeal: STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.noSeal,
  unmet: STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.unmet,
} as const;

/**
 * 3e (design, section 8.3): "Suspend at once" on an account case's final restriction, offered to an admin when the ground
 * of the chosen rule is met, with its days, and greyed with its reason otherwise. The four grounds are listed, each marked
 * whether the database would accept it now. Choosing it adds the suspension and the ground's drafted facts.
 */
function AtOnce({ props }: { props: ComposerViewProps }) {
  const { view, role, draft } = props;
  const state = atOnceState(view, role, draft);
  if (state === null || view.standing === null) return null;
  const held = suspensionOf(draft);
  const max = state.ground === null ? 1 : AT_ONCE_DAYS[state.ground];
  const days = typeof held?.days === "number" ? held.days : max;
  const choose = (on: boolean, value: number) => {
    if (!state.open) return;
    props.onChange(on ? withAtOnce(view, draft, state.ground, Math.min(max, Math.max(1, value))) : { actions: draft.actions.filter((action) => action.kind !== "suspend") });
  };
  return (
    <li>
      <label>
        <input type="checkbox" checked={held !== undefined} disabled={props.busy || !state.open} onChange={(event) => choose(event.target.checked, days)} /> <span>{STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.label}</span>
      </label>
      {held !== undefined && state.open ? (
        <>
          {" "}
          <label htmlFor="compose-at-once-days">{STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.days(max)}</label>{" "}
          <input id="compose-at-once-days" type="number" min={1} max={max} value={days} disabled={props.busy} onChange={(event) => choose(true, Number(event.target.value) || 1)} />
        </>
      ) : null}
      {state.open ? null : <p className="hint">{CLOSED_WORDS[state.why]}</p>}
      <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.what}</p>
      <ul className="plain grounds">
        {AT_ONCE_ORDER.map((ground) => (
          <li key={ground}>
            <strong>{view.standing!.atOnce.includes(ground) ? STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.met : STANDING_WORDS.atOnce.unmet}</strong> <span>{groundSentence(view, ground)}</span>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      {held !== undefined ? (
        <>
          <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.facts}</p>
          <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.previewTimes}</p>
        </>
      ) : null}
    </li>
  );
}

/** One measure's checkbox, with the image it names for an image measure, and the sentence that it changes nothing now when it would not. */
function Measure({ measure, props, images }: { measure: MeasureKind; props: ComposerViewProps; images: string[] }) {
  const { view, draft } = props;
  const ofImage = MEASURES[measure].target === "image";
  const held = draft.actions.find((action) => action.kind === measure);
  const action: DecisionActionParams = { kind: measure, mediaId: ofImage ? (held?.mediaId ?? images[0] ?? null) : null };
  if (ofImage && images.length === 0) return null;
  // 3e (design, section 8.3): the retirement is greyed with [retire.none] while the profile holds a placeholder.
  const retiring = measure === "retire_handle";
  const closed = retiring && !retireOpen(view);
  return (
    <li>
      <label>
        <input type="checkbox" checked={held !== undefined} disabled={props.busy || closed} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ actions: toggled({ ...draft, actions: draft.actions.filter((other) => other.kind !== measure) }, action, event.target.checked) })} />{" "}
        <span>{MEASURES[measure].label}</span>
      </label>
      {ofImage && held !== undefined ? (
        <>
          {" "}
          <label htmlFor={`compose-image-${measure}`} className="visually-hidden">
            Which image
          </label>
          <select
            id={`compose-image-${measure}`}
            value={action.mediaId ?? ""}
            disabled={props.busy}
            onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ actions: [...draft.actions.filter((other) => other.kind !== measure), { kind: measure, mediaId: images.find((image) => image === event.target.value) ?? null }] })}
          >
            {/* Each image keeps its number in the snapshot, also when an image before it is not offered. */}
            {images.map((image) => (
              <option key={image} value={image}>
                {`Image ${snapshotImages(view).indexOf(image) + 1}`}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </>
      ) : null}
      {noEffectOf(view, action, draft.kind === "final" ? "final" : "interim") !== null ? <p className="hint">{COMPOSER.noEffect}</p> : null}
      {retiring ? <RetireNotes view={view} chosen={held !== undefined} closed={closed} /> : null}
    </li>
  );
}

/**
 * 3e (design, section 8.3): the sentences beside "Retire the handle": why it is greyed ([retire.none]); else what it does
 * ([retire.what]), that it is the decision's first measure once chosen ([retire.first]), and that the profile changed its
 * handle after the snapshot, whose handle is the one retired ([retire.moved]).
 */
function RetireNotes({ view, chosen, closed }: { view: CaseView; chosen: boolean; closed: boolean }) {
  if (closed) return <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.retire.none}</p>;
  return (
    <>
      <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.retire.what}</p>
      {chosen ? <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.retire.first}</p> : null}
      {retireMoved(view) ? <p className="notice">{STANDING_WORDS.retire.moved}</p> : null}
    </>
  );
}

export function ComposerView(shown: ComposerViewProps) {
  const { view, role } = shown;
  if (shown.draft.kind === "correction") return <CorrectionView {...shown} />;
  if (shown.draft.kind === "review") return <ReviewView {...shown} />;
  // What the draft holds is shown as far as it is offered, and that is what the key confirms.
  const draft = offeredDraft(view, role, shown.draft);
  const props: ComposerViewProps = { ...shown, draft };
  const kinds = kindsOffered(view, role);
  if (kinds.length === 0) {
    return (
      <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
        <h3 id="composer-title">Decide</h3>
        <p>{COMPOSER.closed}</p>
      </section>
    );
  }
  const kind = draft.kind === "final" ? "final" : "interim";
  const listed = outcomesListed(view, role);
  const outcome = draft.outcome;
  const restricts = outcome === "restricted";
  const law = restricts && draft.ground === "illegal";
  const suspect = suspectOpen(view);
  const sealChosen = draft.actions.some((action) => action.kind === "seal_media");
  const left = leftOpen(view);
  const rule = RULES.find((each) => each.id === draft.ruleId) ?? RULES[0];
  const postHidden = view.target.type === "post" && view.target.state !== null && view.target.state !== "visible";
  // Beside the two outcomes of a decision without a measure, whenever they are listed: on a post whose images cannot be
  // opened, such an answer to a report about an image is given unseen.
  const unseen = view.target.type === "post" && !view.imagesAllowed && listed.some((each) => each !== "restricted");
  // Under the facts and under the reason: on a case with an unanswered suspect item, never to say what the images are;
  // then the rule on personal data, with where the text goes. The texts of a decision without a measure never reach its author.
  const underTexts = [...(suspect.length > 0 ? [COMPOSER.neverWrite] : []), restricts ? COMPOSER.personalData : `${COMPOSER_WORDS.personalDataRule} ${COMPOSER_WORDS.staysInRecord}`];
  // 3e: the strike line on a post case, under "Restrict".
  const strike = strikeLine(view, draft);

  return (
    <section className="panel composer" aria-labelledby="composer-title">
      <h3 id="composer-title">Decide</h3>

      <fieldset>
        <legend>Outcome</legend>
        {kinds.includes("final") ? null : <p className="notice">{COMPOSER.adminFinal}</p>}
        {listed.map((each) => (
          <label key={each}>
            {/* An outcome without a measure is a final decision's: choosing it makes the decision final, and puts its measures away. */}
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="compose-outcome"
              checked={outcome === each}
              disabled={props.busy}
              onChange={() => props.onChange(each === "restricted" ? { outcome: each } : { outcome: each, kind: "final", actions: draft.actions.filter((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts !== null) })}
            />{" "}
            <span>{COMPOSER_OUTCOMES[each]}</span>
          </label>
        ))}
        {unseen ? <p className="notice">{COMPOSER.unseen}</p> : null}
      </fieldset>

      {restricts ? (
        <fieldset>
          <legend>When</legend>
          {kinds.map((each) => (
            <label key={each}>
              {/* A measure belongs to one kind: the other kind's measures are put away with the change. */}
              <input type="radio" name="compose-kind" checked={kind === each} disabled={props.busy} onChange={() => props.onChange({ kind: each, actions: [] })} /> <span>{COMPOSER_KINDS[each]}</span>
            </label>
          ))}
          {/* 3e (design, section 8.2): not a choice; the console signs the strike exactly when this says it is given. */}
          {strike === null ? null : <p className="hint">{strike === "due" ? STANDING_WORDS.strike.due : STANDING_WORDS.strike.none[strike]}</p>}
        </fieldset>
      ) : null}

      {suspect.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="banner suspect">
          <p>{(view.suspicion?.reach.served ?? 0) > 0 ? COMPOSER.onlySealEnds : COMPOSER.noteEnds}</p>
          {sealOffered(view, kind, role) ? (
            <div className="actions">
              <button type="button" onClick={props.onSeal} disabled={props.busy || sealChosen}>
                {MEASURES.seal_media.label}
              </button>
              {/* The choice not to seal belongs beside the seal taken while deciding: an admin deciding the case seals for good or answers without a seal. */}
              {kind === "interim" ? (
                <button type="button" onClick={props.onDeclineOpen} disabled={props.busy || props.declining !== null}>
                  Do not seal now
                </button>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          ) : null}
          {props.declining === null || kind !== "interim" ? null : (
            <div className="dialog" role="group" aria-labelledby="decline-title">
              <h4 id="decline-title">Do not seal now</h4>
              <p>{COMPOSER.declineWords}</p>
              <label htmlFor="decline-reason">Why you do not seal now</label>
              <textarea id="decline-reason" rows={3} value={props.declining.reason} disabled={props.declining.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onDeclineChange(event.target.value)} />
              {props.declining.error ? (
                <p role="alert" className="error">
                  {props.declining.error}
                </p>
              ) : null}
              <div className="actions">
                <button type="button" onClick={props.onDeclineSave} disabled={props.declining.busy || props.declining.reason.trim() === ""} aria-busy={props.declining.busy}>
                  Record this choice
                </button>
                <button type="button" onClick={props.onDeclineClose} disabled={props.declining.busy}>
                  Cancel
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          {role === "admin" && kind === "final" ? (
            <>
              <p>{COMPOSER.admin.endsFreeze}</p>
              <p>{COMPOSER.admin.unseen}</p>
              {view.target.type === "post" ? <p>{COMPOSER.admin.answersEarlier}</p> : null}
              <p>{COMPOSER.admin.afterwards}</p>
            </>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ) : view.lane === 0 && (postHidden || view.target.type === "account") ? (
        <p className="notice">{view.target.type === "account" ? COMPOSER.noteAdviceAccount : COMPOSER.noteAdvicePost}</p>
      ) : null}

      {restricts ? (
        <>
          <label htmlFor="compose-ground">Ground</label>
          <select
            id="compose-ground"
            value={law ? "illegal" : "incompatible"}
            disabled={props.busy}
            onChange={(event) => props.onChange(event.target.value === "illegal" ? { ground: "illegal", terrorist: false } : { ground: "incompatible", terrorist: false, category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY[draft.ruleId] })}
          >
            <option value="incompatible">A korbat rule</option>
            {lawOffered(view, kind) ? <option value="illegal">The law</option> : null}
          </select>
          {law ? (
            <>
              <TextField id="compose-legal" label="Legal reference" kind="legal_reference" rows={2} props={props} under={[]} />
              <label>
                <input type="checkbox" checked={draft.terrorist} disabled={props.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ terrorist: event.target.checked })} /> <span>Terrorist content (Regulation (EU) 2021/784, Article 2(7))</span>
              </label>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <label htmlFor="compose-rule">Rule</label>
              <select id="compose-rule" value={draft.ruleId} disabled={props.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ ruleId: event.target.value as RuleId, category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY[event.target.value as RuleId] })}>
                {/* A decision under R2 rests on a report or finding of child sexual abuse material: it is offered only where one is unanswered. */}
                {RULES.filter((each) => each.id !== "R2" || suspect.length > 0).map((each) => (
                  <option key={each.id} value={each.id}>{`${each.id}: ${each.title}`}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <p>{rule.text}</p>
              <div className="examples">
                <div>
                  <h5>Allowed</h5>
                  <ul>
                    {rule.allowed.map((example) => (
                      <li key={example}>{example}</li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h5>Not allowed</h5>
                  <ul>
                    {rule.notAllowed.map((example) => (
                      <li key={example}>{example}</li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </>
      ) : null}

      {/* Every decision carries a category, so every decision shows the one the key will confirm. */}
      <label htmlFor="compose-category">Category</label>
      <select id="compose-category" value={draft.category} disabled={props.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ category: event.target.value as TdbCategory })}>
        {FINDING_CATEGORIES.map((category) => (
          <option key={category} value={category}>
            {categoryLabel(category)}
          </option>
        ))}
      </select>

      {restricts ? (
        <fieldset>
          <legend>Measures</legend>
          <ul className="plain">
            {sealChosen ? (
              <li>
                <label>
                  <input type="checkbox" checked disabled={props.busy} onChange={() => props.onChange({ actions: draft.actions.filter((action) => action.kind !== "seal_media") })} /> <span>{`${MEASURES.seal_media.label}: chosen`}</span>
                </label>
              </li>
            ) : null}
            {measuresOffered(view, kind).map((measure) => (
              <Measure key={measure} measure={measure} props={props} images={imagesOffered(view, kind, measure)} />
            ))}
            {/* 3e (design, section 8.3): a suspension at once, on an account case's final restriction. */}
            <AtOnce props={props} />
            {kind === "interim" && view.target.type === "post" && hiddenWhileDeciding(view) ? (
              <li>
                <p className="hint">{COMPOSER.alreadyHidden}</p>
              </li>
            ) : null}
          </ul>
        </fieldset>
      ) : null}

      {/* A restriction needs both texts; a decision without a measure may carry them, for the case's record. */}
      <TextField id="compose-facts" label="Facts" kind="facts" rows={4} props={props} under={underTexts} />
      <TextField id="compose-reason" label="Reason" kind="reason" rows={4} props={props} under={underTexts} />

      {kind === "final" && left.length > 0 && liftable(view).length > 0 ? (
        <fieldset>
          <legend>Measures taken while deciding</legend>
          <ul className="plain">
            {liftable(view).map((reversal) => (
              <li key={`${reversal.kind} ${reversal.mediaId ?? ""}`}>
                <label>
                  <input type="checkbox" checked={holds(draft, reversal)} disabled={props.busy} onChange={(event) => props.onChange({ actions: toggled(draft, reversal, event.target.checked) })} />{" "}
                  <span>{`Lift: ${MEASURES[liftedKind(reversal)].label}`}</span>
                </label>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </fieldset>
      ) : null}
      {kind === "final" && suspect.length > 0 && left.length > 0 ? <p className="notice">{COMPOSER.staysOpen(throughSeqOf(view), left.length)}</p> : null}

      <Preview view={view} draft={draft} now={props.now} />
      <Confirm props={props} />
    </section>
  );
}

/** Beside a decision with a measure in force: "Lift what was done while deciding" or "Correct this decision", for whoever may. */
export function CorrectControl({ view, decision, role, disabled, onCorrect }: { view: CaseView; decision: CaseDecision; role: StaffRole; disabled: boolean; onCorrect(decision: CaseDecision): void }) {
  const offered = correctable(view, decision, role);
  if (offered === null) return null;
  return (
    <button type="button" onClick={() => onCorrect(decision)} disabled={disabled}>
      {offered.label}
    </button>
  );
}

/** Beside a pending appeal: "Review this appeal", for the person the API marked as one who may review it. */
export function ReviewControl({ view, decision, disabled, onReview }: { view: CaseView; decision: CaseDecision; disabled: boolean; onReview(decision: CaseDecision): void }) {
  if (reviewable(view, decision) === null) return null;
  return (
    <button type="button" onClick={() => onReview(decision)} disabled={disabled}>
      {APPEAL_WORDS.reviewLabel}
    </button>
  );
}
```

```ts
import type { MeResponse } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { Hono } from "hono";
import { bodyLimit } from "hono/body-limit";
import { cors } from "hono/cors";
import { HTTPException } from "hono/http-exception";
import type { Logger } from "pino";
import { AccountError, type Account } from "./account";
import { AuthError, type Auth } from "./auth";
import type { Config } from "./config";
import type { AppEnv } from "./env";
import { errorBody } from "./lib/errors";
import { MediaError, type Media } from "./media";
import { observability } from "./middleware/observability";
import { clientIpKey, rateLimit, type RateLimitStore } from "./middleware/rate-limit";
import { noStore, securityHeaders } from "./middleware/security-headers";
import { ModerationError, type Moderation } from "./moderation";
import { healthRoutes, type HealthChecks } from "./routes/health";
import { SocialError, type Social } from "./social";
import type { Staff } from "./staff";

/** JSON requests are small; the one raw upload route counts its own bytes and is exempt. */
export const JSON_BODY_LIMIT_BYTES = 64 * 1024;

/**
 * The staff console's paths (3a design, section 5): /api/staff and everything under it, never a path that merely begins
 * with the same letters. The app's CORS and session resolution pass over them, so a staff route never meets the app's
 * credentialed CORS, its Origin allow-list, its session or its CSRF check: the staff gate and the staff session are the
 * only origin and session logic there. Everything else in the chain (request id, access log, client identity, security
 * headers, no-store, the body limit, the global rate limit) applies to them as to any path.
 */
const isStaffPath = (path: string) => path === "/api/staff" || path.startsWith("/api/staff/");

export interface AppDeps {
  config: Config;
  logger: Logger;
  rateLimitStore: RateLimitStore;
  healthChecks: HealthChecks;
  auth: Auth;
  /** Posting and feed. Optional so auth-only tests need no database for it; the server always wires it. */
  social?: Social;
  /** Image uploads. Optional for the same reason; the server always wires it. */
  media?: Media;
  /** The account lifecycle (the data export). Optional for the same reason; the server always wires it. */
  account?: Account;
  /** The staff console's API. Mounted only while CONSOLE_ORIGIN is set; optional as the other modules are. */
  staff?: Staff;
  /** Reports and notices. Optional as the other modules are; the server always wires it, whether the console is on or off. */
  moderation?: Moderation;
  /** Checks that report a part being down without marking the API unhealthy, the image worker for one. */
  advisoryChecks?: HealthChecks;
}

export function createApp({ config, logger, rateLimitStore, healthChecks, auth, social, media, account, staff, moderation, advisoryChecks }: AppDeps) {
  const app = new Hono<AppEnv>();

  app.use(observability(logger));
  app.use(auth.clientIdentity);
  app.use(securityHeaders, noStore);
  const appCors = cors({ origin: config.TRUSTED_ORIGINS, credentials: true });
  app.use((c, next) => (isStaffPath(c.req.path) ? next() : appCors(c, next)));
  const jsonBodies = bodyLimit({
    maxSize: JSON_BODY_LIMIT_BYTES,
    onError: (c) => c.json(errorBody("payload_too_large", "The request body is too large", (c as typeof c & { get(key: "requestId"): string }).get("requestId")), 413),
  });
  app.use((c, next) => (c.req.method === "POST" && c.req.path === "/api/media" ? next() : jsonBodies(c, next)));
  // Image files come before the global limit and session resolution: they have their own bucket,
  // and a public image needs no session. Everything else under /api/media falls through to below.
  if (media) app.route("/api/media", media.fileRoutes);
  app.use(rateLimit({ name: "global", store: rateLimitStore, limit: 300, windowMs: 60_000, key: clientIpKey }));
  app.use((c, next) => (isStaffPath(c.req.path) ? next() : auth.resolveSession(c, next)));

  app.route("/api/health", healthRoutes(healthChecks, config.KORBAT_VERSION, advisoryChecks));
  app.route("/api/auth", auth.routes);
  // 3e (design, section 7.12): /api/me from the auth module's meFor and the moderation module's standingFor, read at
  // every request; null without the moderation module (an app built for some tests) or without a profile.
  app.get("/api/me", auth.requireOnboarding, async (c) => {
    const session = c.get("session")!;
    const base = await auth.meFor(session);
    const standing = moderation && base.profile !== null ? await moderation.standingFor(session.userId) : null;
    return c.json({ ...base, standing } satisfies MeResponse);
  });
  if (media) app.route("/api/media", media.routes);
  if (account) app.route("/api/account", account.routes);
  // The console is off while CONSOLE_ORIGIN is unset: nothing is mounted, and every staff path is the unknown route below.
  if (staff && config.CONSOLE_ORIGIN !== undefined) app.route("/api/staff", staff.routes(config.CONSOLE_ORIGIN));
  // Reports and notices are taken, kept and given receipts whether or not the console is on: anyone may send one, signed
  // in or not, so these routes stand after session resolution and behind no session guard of their own.
  if (moderation) app.route("/api", moderation.routes);
  if (social) app.route("/api", social.routes);

  app.notFound((c) => c.json(errorBody("not_found", "No such route", c.get("requestId")), 404));
  app.onError((err, c) => {
    if (err instanceof AuthError) {
      if (err.retryAfterSeconds) c.header("Retry-After", String(err.retryAfterSeconds));
      return c.json(errorBody(err.code, err.message, c.get("requestId"), err.details), err.status);
    }
    if (err instanceof HTTPException) return c.json(errorBody("invalid_request", err.message, c.get("requestId")), err.status);
    if (err instanceof MediaError) return c.json(errorBody(err.code, err.message, c.get("requestId")), err.status);
    if (err instanceof SocialError) {
      if (err.retryAfterSeconds) c.header("Retry-After", String(err.retryAfterSeconds));
      return c.json(errorBody(err.code, err.message, c.get("requestId")), err.status);
    }
    // The account routes render nothing themselves: their own errors and those of the three modules they call all land here.
    if (err instanceof AccountError) {
      if (err.retryAfterSeconds) c.header("Retry-After", String(err.retryAfterSeconds));
      return c.json(errorBody(err.code, err.message, c.get("requestId")), err.status);
    }
    // A moderation flow's refusal, from the app's routes or from the console's case routes.
    if (err instanceof ModerationError) {
      if (err.retryAfterSeconds) c.header("Retry-After", String(err.retryAfterSeconds));
      return c.json(errorBody(err.code, err.message, c.get("requestId")), err.status);
    }
    c.get("log").error({ err }, "unhandled error");
    return c.json(errorBody("internal", "Internal error", c.get("requestId")), 500);
  });

  return app;
}
```

```ts
import type { Mailer } from "../mail/mailer";
import { noticeTime } from "./flows/notify";
import type { AuthRepo, UserRole } from "./repo";
import type { Sessions } from "./sessions";

/** The audit log's actor for changes made from the server's command line rather than by a signed-in person. */
export const SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000";

/** What a role change did, for the command line's report. */
export interface RoleGranted {
  userId: string;
  previousRole: UserRole;
  staffSessionsRevoked: number;
  /** Unused enrolment links deleted, so none issued before the change enrols anything. */
  enrollmentsDeleted: number;
  /** Staff keys revoked: every live one on a change to user, none otherwise. */
  staffKeysRevoked: number;
  /** Why the staff_keys_revoked mail could not be sent, or null when it was sent or none was due. The change stands either way. */
  mailError: string | null;
  /**
   * Why the revoked app sessions' cache tombstones could not be written (Valkey unreachable), or null. The change stands:
   * the sessions are revoked in the database, and a cached copy lasts at most the cache's TTL.
   */
  tombstoneError: string | null;
}

/**
 * Changes an account's role. Used only by the server-side CLI; there is no API endpoint for it.
 * Every session and staff session of the account is revoked and every unused enrolment link deleted, so the new role (and
 * its MFA requirement) applies at once; a change to user also revokes every staff key (3a design, section 7). The change,
 * the revocations and their audit rows are one transaction on the auth role; after it commits, the cached sessions get
 * their tombstones and, when a staff key was revoked, the owner is mailed the keys' names. Both are best effort and
 * independent of each other: the change has committed, so a step that fails is reported to the caller, undoes nothing,
 * and never keeps the other from running (a Valkey outage must not cost the owner the mail that their keys went).
 */
export async function grantRole(deps: { repo: AuthRepo; sessions: Sessions; mailer: Mailer }, email: string, role: UserRole): Promise<RoleGranted | "standing"> {
  const now = new Date();
  const changed = await deps.repo.changeRole(email, role, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, now });
  if (!changed) throw new Error(`no account for ${email}`);
  // 3e (design, section 7.16): a promotion refused for the account's standing changed nothing; the caller says why.
  if (changed === "standing") return "standing";
  let tombstoneError: string | null = null;
  try {
    await deps.sessions.tombstone(changed.sessionIds);
  } catch (err) {
    tombstoneError = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
  }
  let mailError: string | null = null;
  if (changed.keysRevoked.length > 0) {
    try {
      await deps.mailer.send({
        to: changed.email,
        template: "staff_keys_revoked",
        data: { names: changed.keysRevoked.map((key) => `"${key.name}"`).join(", "), time: noticeTime(now) },
      });
    } catch (err) {
      mailError = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    }
  }
  return {
    userId: changed.userId,
    previousRole: changed.previousRole,
    staffSessionsRevoked: changed.staffSessionsRevoked,
    enrollmentsDeleted: changed.enrollmentsDeleted,
    staffKeysRevoked: changed.keysRevoked.length,
    mailError,
    tombstoneError,
  };
}
```

```ts
 * answer with a code; this is what a write that lost a race meets, and its caller answers the same.
 */
export function handleRefusal(err: unknown): "handle_retired" | "handle_reserved" | null {
  let current: unknown = err;
  for (let depth = 0; depth < 5 && current; depth++) {
    if (typeof current === "object" && (current as { code?: unknown }).code === "P0001") {
      const message = (current as { message?: unknown }).message;
      return message === "handle_retired" || message === "handle_reserved" ? message : null;
    }
    current = (current as { cause?: unknown }).cause;
  }
  return null;
}

/** True for a Postgres unique-constraint violation, however deeply the driver error is wrapped. */
export function isUniqueViolation(err: unknown): boolean {
  let current: unknown = err;
  for (let depth = 0; depth < 5 && current; depth++) {
    if (typeof current === "object" && (current as { code?: unknown }).code === "23505") return true;
    current = (current as { cause?: unknown }).cause;
  }
  return false;
}
```

```ts
import type { MeResponse, SessionsResponse } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { AuthError, type AuthDeps } from "../context";
import type { Session } from "../sessions";
import { notifyAccount } from "./notify";

/** /api/me without the account's standing, which the moderation module reads (3e design, section 7.12). */
export type MeWithoutStanding = Omit<MeResponse, "standing">;

/**
 * The signed-in account. The only response in the API that contains the email address. 3e: everything of /api/me but
 * the standing, which this module cannot read (it names no public table); the app composes the route from this and the
 * moderation module's standingFor.
 */
export async function me(deps: AuthDeps, session: Session): Promise<MeWithoutStanding> {
  const user = await deps.repo.findUserById(session.userId);
  if (!user) throw new AuthError("invalid_credentials", 401);
  return {
    user: {
      id: user.id,
      email: user.email,
      role: user.role,
      onboarded: user.onboardedAt !== null,
      mfaEnabled: user.totpEnabledAt !== null,
      hasPassword: user.passwordHash !== null,
      // The count only (1c design, section 7.5); the Security list is where the passkeys themselves are read.
      passkeys: await deps.repo.countPasskeys(user.id),
    },
    profile: await deps.profiles.find(user.id),
  };
}

/** The user's live sessions, each under its handle: the id that stays while the session's token rotates. */
export async function listSessions(deps: AuthDeps, session: Session): Promise<SessionsResponse> {
  return { sessions: await deps.sessions.list(session.userId, session.handle) };
}

/**
 * Revokes one of the user's own sessions, named by the handle the list gave, so a session that re-authenticated since
 * it was listed (its token rotated) is still revoked. False when no such live session belongs to them.
 */
export async function revokeSession(deps: AuthDeps, session: Session, handle: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const revoked = await deps.sessions.revoke(handle, session.userId);
  if (revoked) await deps.repo.appendEvent({ userId: session.userId, type: "session_revoked", deviceId: session.deviceId, metadata: { handle } });
  return revoked;
}

/** Signs out every session of the account, including the current one (the route requires fresh auth). */
export async function revokeAllSessions(deps: AuthDeps, session: Session): Promise<number> {
  const user = await deps.repo.findUserById(session.userId);
  const count = await deps.sessions.revokeAll(session.userId);
  await deps.repo.appendEvent({ userId: session.userId, type: "sessions_revoked_all", deviceId: session.deviceId, metadata: { count } });
  if (user) await notifyAccount(deps, user.email, "sessions_revoked_all", { count: String(count) });
  return count;
}

export async function signOut(deps: AuthDeps, session: Session): Promise<void> {
  await deps.sessions.revoke(session.handle, session.userId);
  await deps.repo.appendEvent({ userId: session.userId, type: "session_revoked", deviceId: session.deviceId, metadata: { signOut: true } });
}
```

```ts
import type { BadgeStartRequest, BadgeVerifyRequest, BadgeVerifyResponse } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { AuthError, isUniqueViolation, type AuthDeps, type RequestContext } from "../context";
import { randomToken, sha256Hex } from "../crypto";
import { phoneHash } from "../identifiers";
import { HOUR, enforceLimit } from "../limits";
import type { Session } from "../sessions";
import { VerifyUnavailable, type VerificationProvider } from "../verify/provider";
import { CODE_TTL_MS, MAX_CODE_ATTEMPTS } from "./email";
import { notifyAccount } from "./notify";

export const BADGE_STARTS_PER_HOUR = 3;
/** Per client address, as the sign-up starts limit theirs: one address cannot run many accounts' starts. */
export const BADGE_STARTS_PER_IP_PER_HOUR = 10;
/** On the whole instance: every start is a text the provider bills, so no crowd of fresh accounts can run up the bill. */
export const BADGE_STARTS_PER_DAY = 200;

/** A flow id is a bearer credential while its verification is pending, so the store holds only its hash. */
export const badgeKey = (flowId: string) => `badge:${sha256Hex(flowId)}`;
/** The flow's attempts, counted by the store's atomic counter under the hashed flow id. */
export const badgeAttemptsKey = (flowId: string) => `badge-attempts:${sha256Hex(flowId)}`;

/**
 * The verification a code is out for, kept under the hashed flow id until the code is right or the ten
 * minutes pass. It holds the number only as its keyed hash, which is what the account will store; the
 * number itself went to the provider and nowhere else. The expiry is kept so that a state the store has
 * not dropped yet at the end of its ten minutes is still treated as gone. It is written once and never
 * written back: attempts are counted apart, atomically.
 */
export interface PendingBadge {
  userId: string;
  phoneHash: string;
  reference: string;
  expiresAt: number;
}

/**
 * The configured provider, or badge_unavailable (404) when VERIFY_PROVIDER is off. The web app does not
 * learn this from the answer: its build flag (EXPO_PUBLIC_BADGE, from WEB_BADGE) decides whether the badge
 * section is shown, off by default like the provider.
 */
function provider(deps: AuthDeps): VerificationProvider {
  if (!deps.verify) throw new AuthError("badge_unavailable", 404);
  return deps.verify;
}

/** A provider that could not be asked is verify_unavailable (503): the user tries again later. Anything else is a bug and stays a 500. */
function unavailable(err: unknown): never {
  if (err instanceof VerifyUnavailable) throw new AuthError("verify_unavailable", 503);
  throw err;
}

/**
 * Has the provider text a code to the number. The answer is the same whether or not another account
 * holds the number: the conflict is reported only once the code has proved that the requester holds the
 * phone (verifyBadge), so this step tells nobody which numbers are registered. Every limit is counted
 * before the provider is asked, so a refused start costs no text; the number is never stored.
 */
export async function startBadge(deps: AuthDeps, session: Session, input: BadgeStartRequest, ctx: RequestContext): Promise<{ flowId: string }> {
  const verify = provider(deps);
  // 3e (design, section 7.2): the badge is a public mark, which a suspended account cannot ask for. A courtesy read, so
  // that no code is texted to it; the write in verifyBadge decides.
  if (await deps.profiles.suspended(session.userId)) throw new AuthError("account_suspended", 403);
  const hashed = phoneHash(deps.config.authHmacKey, input.phone);
  // The narrowest bucket first: a start the account's own limit refuses is not counted against the address or the
  // instance, so one account cannot spend their allowance with starts it was never going to get.
  await enforceLimit(deps.kv, `badge-start:${session.userId}`, BADGE_STARTS_PER_HOUR, HOUR);
  await enforceLimit(deps.kv, `badge-start:ip:${ctx.ipHash}`, BADGE_STARTS_PER_IP_PER_HOUR, HOUR);
  // Per number too, whoever asks, so one phone cannot be texted more than three times an hour through many accounts.
  await enforceLimit(deps.kv, `badge-start:phone:${hashed}`, BADGE_STARTS_PER_HOUR, HOUR);
  // The ceiling last, so it counts only starts every other bucket let through.
  await enforceLimit(deps.kv, "badge-start:all", BADGE_STARTS_PER_DAY, 24 * HOUR);
  const { reference } = await verify.start(input.phone).catch(unavailable);
  const flowId = randomToken();
  const pending: PendingBadge = { userId: session.userId, phoneHash: hashed, reference, expiresAt: deps.now().getTime() + CODE_TTL_MS };
  await deps.kv.set(badgeKey(flowId), JSON.stringify(pending), CODE_TTL_MS);
  return { flowId };
}

/**
 * Checks the code with the provider. Attempts are counted before the provider is asked, as the email
 * codes count theirs, with the store's atomic counter: concurrent requests each get their own count, so
 * a flow takes at most five codes whatever the provider answers and however many requests arrive at
 * once. On success the account's phone hash is written first (the partial unique index on it decides
 * conflicts, so a number another account verified is phone_in_use here and only here), then the
 * profile's verified_at, and the account is told.
 */
export async function verifyBadge(deps: AuthDeps, session: Session, input: BadgeVerifyRequest): Promise<BadgeVerifyResponse> {
  const verify = provider(deps);
  const key = badgeKey(input.flowId);
  const raw = await deps.kv.get(key);
  const pending = raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as PendingBadge) : null;
  // A flow another account started, an unknown one and one whose ten minutes passed are all no code at all,
  // settled before an attempt is counted: nobody can spend another account's attempts. The store drops the
  // state itself at the end of the ten minutes; a straggler it still holds is treated like a flow that is gone.
  if (!pending || pending.userId !== session.userId) throw new AuthError("invalid_code", 400);
  if (pending.expiresAt <= deps.now().getTime()) throw new AuthError("invalid_code", 400);
  // The counter's life starts at the first attempt and is never extended; it outlives the state by at most ten minutes.
  const attempts = await deps.kv.incr(badgeAttemptsKey(input.flowId), CODE_TTL_MS);
  if (attempts > MAX_CODE_ATTEMPTS) throw new AuthError("too_many_attempts", 429);

  const outcome = await verify.check(pending.reference, input.code).catch(unavailable);
  if (outcome === "invalid_code") throw new AuthError("invalid_code", 400);
  if (outcome === "code_expired") {
    // The provider has closed the request, so no code can be checked against it any more: the owner starts again.
    await deps.kv.del(key);
    throw new AuthError("code_expired", 400);
  }
  // The code was right and the provider has spent it: whatever happens next, this flow is over.
  await deps.kv.del(key);
  const user = await deps.repo.findUserById(session.userId);
  if (!user) throw new AuthError("invalid_credentials", 401);
  try {
    await deps.repo.setPhoneHash(user.id, pending.phoneHash);
  } catch (err) {
    if (isUniqueViolation(err)) throw new AuthError("phone_in_use", 409);
    throw err;
  }
  if (!(await deps.profiles.setVerified(user.id, deps.now()))) {
    // 3e: the one predicate refused the badge's write (a suspension started meanwhile): the phone hash written a moment
    // before is cleared again, so the account holds nothing of a badge it was refused.
    await deps.repo.setPhoneHash(user.id, null);
    throw new AuthError("account_suspended", 403);
  }
  await notifyAccount(deps, user.email, "badge_verified");
  // No metadata: the event log never holds the number, not even hashed, since the hash leaves the account with the badge.
  await deps.repo.appendEvent({ userId: user.id, type: "badge_verified", deviceId: session.deviceId });
  return { verified: true };
}

/**
 * Drops the badge: the phone hash and verified_at are cleared, the account is told and the event
 * recorded. Without a badge nothing is said or recorded, but both columns are cleared anyway, which also
 * finishes a removal that stopped between its two writes. Works with the provider off, so turning it
 * off strands nobody.
 */
export async function removeBadge(deps: AuthDeps, session: Session): Promise<void> {
  const user = await deps.repo.findUserById(session.userId);
  if (!user) throw new AuthError("invalid_credentials", 401);
  const held = user.phoneHash !== null;
  await deps.repo.setPhoneHash(user.id, null);
  await deps.profiles.setVerified(user.id, null);
  if (!held) return;
  await notifyAccount(deps, user.email, "badge_removed");
  await deps.repo.appendEvent({ userId: user.id, type: "badge_removed", deviceId: session.deviceId });
}
```
