```ts
        where n.erased_at is null and n.received_at <= now() - make_interval(days => ${periods.intakeDays}::int) and public.intake_due_at(n.id) < now() - interval '1 day') as intake_records,
      (select count(*)::int ${STATEMENT_HELD} and p.deleted_at < now() - make_interval(months => ${periods.statementMonths}::int) - interval '1 day') as statements,
      (select count(*)::int from decisions d join cases c on c.id = d.case_id
        where ${REDACTABLE} and public.decision_final_at(d.id) < now() - interval '1 day'
          and not (c.target_type = 'post' and public.post_frozen(c.target_id))) as redactions,
      (select count(*)::int from staff_texts t
        where t.kind not in ('note', 'seal_declined') and t.confirmed_at is null and t.created_at < now() - make_interval(hours => ${periods.draftHours}::int) - interval '1 day') as drafts,
      (select count(*)::int from case_access_log l where l.at < now() - make_interval(months => ${periods.accessLogMonths}::int) - interval '1 day') as access_log`,
  );
  return { caseEvidence: row!.case_evidence, intakeRecords: row!.intake_records, statements: row!.statements, redactions: row!.redactions, drafts: row!.drafts, accessLog: row!.access_log };
}
```

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { iso, rows, type Runner } from "./repo";

/**
 * The queries of account sanctions (3e design, sections 6.2 and 7.12): an account's standing as the views of the standing
 * ledger give it, the strike rule's answer for a post case, and the period of each standing measure. Every number comes
 * from the database's own standing_rules(), and every "now" is the database's clock, so the case answer reads what the
 * ledger's triggers would read at the same moment. Nothing here is stored: each answer is computed at the request.
 */

/** A UTC day of a timestamptz expression. The expression is written here, never input. */
const day = (expression: string) => sql.raw(`to_char(${expression} at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD')`);

/** An instant as JavaScript writes it, or null for an infinite one (a termination's end). */
const finite = (expression: string) => sql`case when isfinite(${sql.raw(expression)}) then ${iso(expression)} end`;

/**
 * What strike_due answers for a final restriction of this case on a korbat rule other than R2 that rests on no suspect
 * item (the rule passed is R1: strike_due asks only that it is not R2), and whether the case's post already carries a
 * strike that stands, which is the first of the two reasons it can answer false.
 */
export async function strikeDueOf(q: Runner, caseId: string): Promise<{ due: boolean; struck: boolean }> {
  const [row] = await rows<{ due: boolean; struck: boolean }>(
    q,
    sql`select public.strike_due(${caseId}::uuid, 'incompatible', 'R1', false, null) as due,
               exists (select 1 from cases c
                         join cases x on x.target_type = 'post' and x.target_id = c.target_id
                         join decisions d on d.case_id = x.id
                         join decision_actions a on a.decision_id = d.id and a.kind = 'strike'
                        where c.id = ${caseId}::uuid
                          and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id)) as struck`,
  );
  return { due: row?.due ?? false, struck: row?.struck ?? false };
}

/** An active strike of an account, as the case answer lists it. */
export interface StrikeRow {
  decisionId: string;
  caseId: string;
  ruleId: string;
  decidedAt: string;
  countsUntil: string;
}

/** The facts an account's standing is built from, each read from the ledger's views at the database's clock. */
export interface StandingFacts {
  /** The active strikes, oldest first. */
  strikes: StrikeRow[];
  /** The rule of the newest active strike. */
  ladderRule: string | null;
  /** Whether a strike is newer than the newest measure of the ladder that stands, or there is none. */
  newStrikeSinceLadder: boolean;
  /** The suspensions of the ladder that stand, whose basis holds, decided in the last ladder_memory_days, and the day of the newest. */
  suspensionsInYear: number;
  lastSuspendedOn: string | null;
  /** The live standing measure (standing_live), with its kind and its period's state now; null when none. */
  live: { kind: "suspend" | "terminate"; running: boolean } | null;
  /** The account's posts of the last flood_minutes, and the interval they were counted in. */
  flood: { posts: number; from: string; to: string };
  /** The grounds of a measure at once whose facts hold now, by the rows of decision_actions_check's table. */
  threat: boolean;
  terrorist: boolean;
  threatRepeat: boolean;
  /** The day of the newest seal for good of the account's images that a protective suspension may rest on now. */
  sealOn: string | null;
  /** The time of the decision each ground of a suspension at once would rest on now, or null (Task 3). */
  basisDecidedAt: { threat: string | null; terrorist: string | null; protective: string | null };
}

/**
 * An account's standing: its active strikes, its ladder, its live measure, and the facts of the grounds of a measure at
 * once, read as the rows of decision_actions_check's table read them. An aid to the console: the database decides at the
 * commit, and a fact that moves between this read and the key is refused there.
 */
export async function standingFacts(q: Runner, accountId: string): Promise<StandingFacts> {
  const account = sql`${accountId}::uuid`;
  const strikes = await rows<{ decision_id: string; case_id: string; rule_id: string; decided_at: string; counts_until: string }>(
    q,
    sql`select s.decision_id, d.case_id, d.rule_id, ${iso("d.decided_at")} as decided_at, ${iso("s.ends_at")} as counts_until
          from active_strikes s join decisions d on d.id = s.decision_id
         where s.account_id = ${account} order by s.created_at, s.action_id`,
  );
  const [ladder] = await rows<{ new_strike: boolean; in_year: number; last_on: string | null }>(
    q,
    sql`select coalesce((select max(s.created_at) from active_strikes s where s.account_id = ${account})
                          > (select max(a.created_at) from decision_actions a
                              where a.subject_account_id = ${account} and a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') and a.basis in ('strikes', 'ladder_end')
                                and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id)), true) as new_strike,
               count(y.id)::int as in_year, max(${day("y.decided_at")}) as last_on
          from (select 1) one
          left join (select a.id, d.decided_at from decision_actions a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id cross join standing_rules() k
                      where a.subject_account_id = ${account} and a.kind = 'suspend' and a.basis = 'strikes'
                        and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id)
                        and public.standing_basis_broken_at(a.id) is null
                        and d.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.ladder_memory_days)) y on true`,
  );
  const [live] = await rows<{ kind: "suspend" | "terminate"; running: boolean }>(
    q,
    sql`select a.kind, coalesce(p.starts_at <= clock_timestamp(), false) as running
          from standing_live s join decision_actions a on a.id = s.action_id left join suspension_periods p on p.action_id = s.action_id
         where s.account_id = ${account} limit 1`,
  );
  const [grounds] = await rows<{
    posts: number;
    from_at: string;
    to_at: string;
    threat_at: string | null;
    terrorist_at: string | null;
    threat_repeat: boolean;
    seal_on: string | null;
    seal_at: string | null;
  }>(
    q,
    sql`select (select count(*)::int from posts p where p.author_id = ${account} and p.created_at > now() - make_interval(mins => k.flood_minutes)) as posts,
               ${iso("(now() - make_interval(mins => k.flood_minutes))")} as from_at, ${iso("now()")} as to_at,
               (select ${iso("x.decided_at")} from decisions x join cases xc on xc.id = x.case_id and xc.target_type = 'post' join posts xp on xp.id = xc.target_id and xp.author_id = ${account}
                 where x.kind = 'final' and x.outcome = 'restricted' and x.rule_id = 'R5' and x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.basis_age_days)
                   and exists (select 1 from measures_in_force f where f.decision_id = x.id)
                 order by x.decided_at desc, x.id desc limit 1) as threat_at,
               (select ${iso("x.decided_at")} from decisions x join cases xc on xc.id = x.case_id and xc.target_type = 'post' join posts xp on xp.id = xc.target_id and xp.author_id = ${account}
                 where x.kind = 'final' and x.outcome = 'restricted' and x.ground = 'illegal' and x.category_keyword = 'KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT'
                   and x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.basis_age_days)
                   and exists (select 1 from measures_in_force f where f.decision_id = x.id)
                 order by x.decided_at desc, x.id desc limit 1) as terrorist_at,
               exists (select 1 from decision_actions a join decisions ad on ad.id = a.decision_id
                         join posts xp on xp.author_id = ${account} and xp.created_at > ad.informed_at
                         join cases xc on xc.target_type = 'post' and xc.target_id = xp.id
                         join decisions x on x.case_id = xc.id
                        where a.subject_account_id = ${account} and a.kind = 'suspend' and a.basis = 'threat'
                          and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id)
                          and public.standing_basis_broken_at(a.id) is null
                          and ad.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.ladder_memory_days)
                          and x.kind = 'final' and x.outcome = 'restricted' and x.rule_id = 'R5' and x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.basis_age_days)
                          and exists (select 1 from measures_in_force f where f.decision_id = x.id)) as threat_repeat,
               (select ${day("x.decided_at")} from measures_in_force m join decisions x on x.id = m.decision_id
                 where m.kind = 'seal_media' and m.decision_kind = 'final' and m.subject_account_id = ${account}
                   and x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.basis_age_days)
                   and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions p where p.kind = 'suspend' and p.basis = 'protective' and m.decision_id = any(p.rests_on))
                 order by x.decided_at desc, x.id desc limit 1) as seal_on,
               (select ${iso("x.decided_at")} from measures_in_force m join decisions x on x.id = m.decision_id
                 where m.kind = 'seal_media' and m.decision_kind = 'final' and m.subject_account_id = ${account}
                   and x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.basis_age_days)
                   and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions p where p.kind = 'suspend' and p.basis = 'protective' and m.decision_id = any(p.rests_on))
                 order by x.decided_at desc, x.id desc limit 1) as seal_at
          from standing_rules() k`
  );
  return {
    strikes: strikes.map((row) => ({ decisionId: row.decision_id, caseId: row.case_id, ruleId: row.rule_id, decidedAt: row.decided_at, countsUntil: row.counts_until })),
    ladderRule: strikes.at(-1)?.rule_id ?? null,
    newStrikeSinceLadder: ladder!.new_strike,
    suspensionsInYear: ladder!.in_year,
    lastSuspendedOn: ladder!.last_on,
    live: live ? { kind: live.kind, running: live.running } : null,
    flood: { posts: grounds!.posts, from: grounds!.from_at, to: grounds!.to_at },
    threat: grounds!.threat_at !== null,
    terrorist: grounds!.terrorist_at !== null,
    threatRepeat: grounds!.threat_repeat,
    sealOn: grounds!.seal_on,
    basisDecidedAt: { threat: grounds!.threat_at, terrorist: grounds!.terrorist_at, protective: grounds!.seal_at },
  };
}

/** Whether the case holds an unanswered item of a user's report: such a case holds the ladder's, the protective and the reporting measures back. */
export async function openReportsIn(q: Runner, caseId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const [row] = await rows<{ open: boolean }>(
    q,
    sql`select exists (select 1 from intake_items i join intakes n on n.id = i.intake_id where i.case_id = ${caseId}::uuid and i.answered_by is null and n.kind = 'user') as open`,
  );
  return row?.open ?? false;
}

/**
 * Whether the handle of the case's newest snapshot (the one a decision made now names) is retired: a retirement now would
 * change nothing (decision_actions_check step 10, no_effect `already`), which the composer says beside its control.
 */
export async function snapshotHandleRetired(q: Runner, caseId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const [row] = await rows<{ retired: boolean }>(
    q,
    sql`select exists (select 1 from handle_history h
                         where h.retired_at is not null
                           and h.handle_lower = (select lower(s.handle) from evidence_snapshots s where s.case_id = ${caseId}::uuid order by s.taken_at desc, s.id desc limit 1)) as retired`,
  );
  return row?.retired ?? false;
}

/** A ledger row's columns of 3e, and for a standing measure where its period stands now. */
export interface StandingColumns {
  days: number | null;
  announced: boolean | null;
  basis: string | null;
  restsOn: string[] | null;
  earliestStart: string | null;
  countsUntil: string | null;
  period: { startsAt: string | null; endsAt: string | null; state: string } | null;
  /** On a strike: the kinds of the standing measures that rest on its decision and stand (not lifted, basis whole). */
  restedOnBy: string[] | null;
  /** On a retirement: the handle it retired, from its decision's snapshot in lower case (Task 2); null on every other kind. */
  handle: string | null;
}

/**
 * The columns of 3e of a case's ledger rows, by id: what the key signed (days, announced), what the trigger forced (the
 * basis, what it rests on, the earliest start, a strike's or a warning's end of counting) and, for a suspension or a
 * termination, its period as suspension_periods gives it with its state at the database's clock: lifted (before its
 * start: never), its basis broken, ended, running, announced (a start fixed and ahead), held by a reply filed on time,
 * or unfixed.
 */
export async function standingColumns(q: Runner, caseId: string): Promise<Map<string, StandingColumns>> {
  const found = await rows<{
    id: string;
    days: number | null;
    announced: boolean | null;
    basis: string | null;
    rests_on: string[] | null;
    earliest_start: string | null;
    counts_until: string | null;
    rested_on_by: string[] | null;
    handle: string | null;
    standing: boolean;
    starts_at: string | null;
    ends_at: string | null;
    state: string | null;
  }>(
    q,
    sql`select a.id, a.days, a.announced, a.basis, a.rests_on::text[] as rests_on,
               case when a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') then ${iso("a.starts_at")} end as earliest_start,
               case when a.kind in ('strike', 'warn_reporting') then ${iso("a.ends_at")} end as counts_until,
               case when a.kind = 'strike' then coalesce((
                 select array_agg(distinct m.kind::text order by m.kind::text) from decision_actions m
                  where m.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') and a.decision_id = any(m.rests_on)
                    and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions x where x.reverses_action_id = m.id)
                    and public.standing_basis_broken_at(m.id) is null), '{}') end as rested_on_by,
               case when a.kind = 'retire_handle' then (select lower(s.handle) from evidence_snapshots s where s.id = d.snapshot_id) end as handle,
               a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') as standing,
               ${iso("p.starts_at")} as starts_at, ${finite("p.ends_at")} as ends_at,
               case
                 when l.id is not null then case when p.starts_at is null then 'never' else 'lifted' end
                 when public.standing_basis_broken_at(a.id) is not null then 'basis_ended'
                 when p.starts_at is not null and p.ends_at <= clock_timestamp() then 'ended'
                 when p.starts_at is not null and p.starts_at <= clock_timestamp() then 'running'
                 when p.starts_at is not null then 'announced'
                 when r.on_time and r.answered_by is null then 'held'
                 else 'unfixed'
               end as state
          from decision_actions a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id
          left join suspension_periods p on p.action_id = a.id
          left join decision_actions l on l.reverses_action_id = a.id
          left join suspension_replies r on r.action_id = a.id
         where d.case_id = ${caseId}::uuid`,
  );
  return new Map(
    found.map((row) => [
      row.id,
      {
        days: row.days,
        announced: row.announced,
        basis: row.basis,
        restsOn: row.rests_on,
        earliestStart: row.earliest_start,
        countsUntil: row.counts_until,
        restedOnBy: row.rested_on_by,
        handle: row.handle,
        period: row.standing ? { startsAt: row.starts_at, endsAt: row.ends_at, state: row.state ?? "unfixed" } : null,
      },
    ]),
  );
}

/** How many strikes of the account count now (active_strikes): what the app's block "Your standing" prints. */
export async function activeStrikesOf(q: Runner, accountId: string): Promise<number> {
  const [row] = await rows<{ n: number }>(q, sql`select count(*)::int as n from active_strikes s where s.account_id = ${accountId}::uuid`);
  return row?.n ?? 0;
}

/** A strike as the account's export lists it (3e design, section 18, W.8). */
export interface ExportedStrikeRow {
  decisionId: string;
  postId: string;
  ruleId: string;
  givenAt: string;
  countsUntil: string;
  overruledAt: string | null;
}

/**
 * Every strike the account was given, newest first: the decision that gave it, the post it was given for, the rule, when
 * it was given, until when it counts, and when it was overruled. A strike is the account's own data and names nobody else.
 */
export async function exportedStrikes(q: Runner, accountId: string): Promise<ExportedStrikeRow[]> {
  const found = await rows<{ decision_id: string; post_id: string; rule_id: string; given_at: string; counts_until: string; overruled_at: string | null }>(
    q,
    sql`select a.decision_id, c.target_id as post_id, d.rule_id, ${iso("a.created_at")} as given_at, ${iso("a.ends_at")} as counts_until,
               (select ${iso("r.created_at")} from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id) as overruled_at
          from decision_actions a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id join cases c on c.id = d.case_id
         where a.subject_account_id = ${accountId}::uuid and a.kind = 'strike'
         order by a.created_at desc, a.id desc`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => ({ decisionId: row.decision_id, postId: row.post_id, ruleId: row.rule_id, givenAt: row.given_at, countsUntil: row.counts_until, overruledAt: row.overruled_at }));
}

/** The facts of /api/me's standing (3e design, sections 7.12 and 10.2), as one statement reads them; null without a live profile. */
export interface AccountStandingRow {
  handle: string;
  activeStrikes: number;
  measure: {
    decisionId: string;
    kind: "suspend" | "terminate";
    days: number | null;
    earliestStart: string;
    startsAt: string | null;
    endsAt: string | null;
    running: boolean;
    reply: { filedAt: string; onTime: boolean; answeredAt: string | null } | null;
    replyAnswered: boolean;
    appealed: boolean;
    appealPending: boolean;
    appealDeadline: string;
    appealOpen: boolean;
  } | null;
}

/**
 * An account's standing as /api/me answers it, read at the request from the ledger's views: its active strikes, and its
 * one standing measure that stands and has not ended (standing_live), with the period suspension_periods gives it, its
 * reply and its appeal. The appeal's deadline is the database's own, from appeal_informed_at, as every appealUntil reads
 * it. Nothing here is stored a second time.
 */
export async function accountStandingRow(q: Runner, accountId: string): Promise<AccountStandingRow | null> {
  const [row] = await rows<{
    handle: string;
    active_strikes: number;
    decision_id: string | null;
    kind: "suspend" | "terminate" | null;
    days: number | null;
    earliest_start: string | null;
    starts_at: string | null;
    ends_at: string | null;
    running: boolean;
    reply_filed_at: string | null;
    reply_on_time: boolean | null;
    reply_answered_at: string | null;
    reply_answered: boolean;
    appealed: boolean;
    appeal_pending: boolean;
    appeal_deadline: string | null;
    appeal_open: boolean;
  }>(
    q,
    sql`select p.handle, (select count(*)::int from active_strikes s where s.account_id = p.id) as active_strikes,
               m.decision_id, m.kind, m.days, ${iso("m.starts_at")} as earliest_start,
               ${iso("sp.starts_at")} as starts_at, ${finite("sp.ends_at")} as ends_at,
               coalesce(sp.starts_at <= clock_timestamp(), false) as running,
               ${iso("r.filed_at")} as reply_filed_at, r.on_time as reply_on_time, ${iso("r.answered_at")} as reply_answered_at,
               coalesce(r.answered_by is not null, false) as reply_answered,
               exists (select 1 from appeals x where x.decision_id = m.decision_id) as appealed,
               exists (select 1 from appeals x where x.decision_id = m.decision_id and x.answered_at is null) as appeal_pending,
               ${iso("public.appeal_deadline(public.appeal_informed_at(m.decision_id))")} as appeal_deadline,
               coalesce(clock_timestamp() < public.appeal_deadline(public.appeal_informed_at(m.decision_id)), false) as appeal_open
          from profiles p
          left join lateral (select a.id, a.decision_id, a.kind::text as kind, a.days, a.starts_at
                               from standing_live l join decision_actions a on a.id = l.action_id
                              where l.account_id = p.id order by a.created_at desc limit 1) m on true
          left join suspension_periods sp on sp.action_id = m.id
          left join suspension_replies r on r.action_id = m.id
         where p.id = ${accountId}::uuid and p.deleted_at is null`,
  );
  if (!row) return null;
  const measure =
    row.decision_id === null || row.kind === null || row.earliest_start === null || row.appeal_deadline === null
      ? null
      : {
          decisionId: row.decision_id,
          kind: row.kind,
          days: row.days,
          earliestStart: row.earliest_start,
          startsAt: row.starts_at,
          endsAt: row.ends_at,
          running: row.running,
          reply: row.reply_filed_at === null ? null : { filedAt: row.reply_filed_at, onTime: row.reply_on_time === true, answeredAt: row.reply_answered_at },
          replyAnswered: row.reply_answered,
          appealed: row.appealed,
          appealPending: row.appeal_pending,
          appealDeadline: row.appeal_deadline,
          appealOpen: row.appeal_open,
        };
  return { handle: row.handle, activeStrikes: row.active_strikes, measure };
}

/**
 * The standing measures that rest on each decision of a case (3e Task 3): for every decision of the case, the suspensions
 * and terminations that stand (no reversal), whose basis holds and that name it in rests_on, with their bases. A review
 * or a correction of such a decision ends them, which the console says before the key is asked.
 */
export async function standingOnDecisions(q: Runner, caseId: string): Promise<Map<string, { kind: "suspend" | "terminate"; basis: string }[]>> {
  const found = await rows<{ decision_id: string; kind: "suspend" | "terminate"; basis: string }>(
    q,
    sql`select x.id as decision_id, m.kind::text as kind, m.basis
          from decisions x join decision_actions m on m.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') and x.id = any(m.rests_on)
         where x.case_id = ${caseId}::uuid
           and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = m.id)
           and public.standing_basis_broken_at(m.id) is null
         order by m.created_at, m.id`,
  );
  const byDecision = new Map<string, { kind: "suspend" | "terminate"; basis: string }[]>();
  for (const row of found) byDecision.set(row.decision_id, [...(byDecision.get(row.decision_id) ?? []), { kind: row.kind, basis: row.basis }]);
  return byDecision;
}
```

```ts
import { STANDING_RULES, isRetiredPlaceholder, type AccountStanding, type AtOnceGround, type AuthorStanding, type CaseStanding, type StrikeDue } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { accountStandingRow, openReportsIn, snapshotHandleRetired, standingFacts, strikeDueOf, type StandingFacts } from "./standing-repo";
import type { Runner } from "./repo";

/**
 * Account sanctions as the console reads them on a case (3e design, sections 7.4 and 10.3): on a post case whether a
 * final restriction gives a strike and the author's standing in bands, on an account case the account's standing with
 * what the database would accept now. Every member is an aid that lets a control say why it is greyed before the key is
 * asked; the database decides at the commit.
 */

/**
 * strikeDue of a post case: the database's strike_due for a final restriction on a korbat rule other than R2 that rests
 * on no suspect item, and why it answers false: the post already carries a strike that stands, or it was made before its
 * author was told of their newest strike (strike_due's third and fourth rules).
 */
export async function strikeDue(q: Runner, caseId: string): Promise<StrikeDue> {
  const answer = await strikeDueOf(q, caseId);
  if (answer.due) return { due: true, why: "due" };
  return { due: false, why: answer.struck ? "already_struck" : "before_last_strike" };
}

/** A count as the bands of the author's standing print it. */
const strikesBand = (n: number): AuthorStanding["activeStrikes"] => (n <= 0 ? "0" : n === 1 ? "1" : n === 2 ? "2" : "3_or_more");
const suspensionsBand = (n: number): AuthorStanding["suspensionsInYear"] => (n <= 0 ? "0" : n === 1 ? "1" : "2_or_more");

/** What the live standing measure of an account is now, in the words of the bands. */
function nowOf(facts: StandingFacts): AuthorStanding["now"] {
  if (facts.live === null) return "none";
  if (!facts.live.running) return "announced";
  return facts.live.kind === "terminate" ? "terminated" : "suspended";
}

/** authorStanding of a post case: the author's standing in bands, so that the moderator knows what a strike here leads to. */
export async function authorStanding(q: Runner, authorId: string): Promise<AuthorStanding> {
  const facts = await standingFacts(q, authorId);
  return { activeStrikes: strikesBand(facts.strikes.length), suspensionsInYear: suspensionsBand(facts.suspensionsInYear), now: nowOf(facts) };
}

/**
 * standing of an account case, read as decision_actions_check reads it. The ladder holds with at least ladderStrikes
 * active strikes of which one is newer than the account's newest measure of the ladder that stands; an announced
 * suspension then takes the rung of the suspensions of the ladder decided in the year, and a termination can be announced
 * after as many of them as there are rungs. While a standing measure is live nothing more can be taken (standing_conflict).
 */
export async function caseStanding(q: Runner, caseId: string, accountId: string): Promise<CaseStanding> {
  const facts = await standingFacts(q, accountId);
  const live = facts.live !== null;
  const rungs = STANDING_RULES.ladderDays;
  const ladder = !live && facts.strikes.length >= STANDING_RULES.ladderStrikes && facts.newStrikeSinceLadder;
  const atOnce: AtOnceGround[] = [];
  if (!live) {
    if (facts.threat) atOnce.push("threat");
    if (facts.terrorist) atOnce.push("terrorist");
    if (facts.flood.posts >= STANDING_RULES.floodPosts) atOnce.push("flood");
    if (facts.sealOn !== null) atOnce.push("protective");
    if (facts.threatRepeat) atOnce.push("threat_repeat");
  }
  return {
    activeStrikes: facts.strikes.length,
    strikes: facts.strikes.map((strike) => ({ ...strike, ruleId: strike.ruleId as CaseStanding["strikes"][number]["ruleId"] })),
    ladderRule: facts.ladderRule as CaseStanding["ladderRule"],
    suspensionsInYear: facts.suspensionsInYear,
    lastSuspendedOn: facts.lastSuspendedOn,
    maxDays: ladder ? rungs[Math.min(facts.suspensionsInYear, rungs.length - 1)]! : null,
    mayTerminate: ladder && facts.suspensionsInYear >= rungs.length,
    live,
    openReports: await openReportsIn(q, caseId),
    atOnce,
    flood: facts.flood,
    seal: facts.sealOn === null ? null : { decidedOn: facts.sealOn },
    // Task 2: whether a retirement now would change nothing, the newest snapshot's handle being retired already.
    snapshotHandleRetired: await snapshotHandleRetired(q, caseId),
    // Task 3: the decisions a suspension at once would rest on now, by their times, for the preview's basis sentence.
    basisDecidedAt: facts.basisDecidedAt,
  };
}

/**
 * /api/me's standing (3e design, sections 7.12 and 10.2), read fresh at the request and never kept in a session or a
 * cache, so the banner and a refusal's sentence are true of the row: the active strikes; the account's one standing
 * measure with its state now (running from its start; announced once a start is fixed and ahead; held while a reply sent
 * in time waits for its answer; unfixed while the notice mail's outcome is unknown), its times, its reply and its appeal;
 * the reporting measures (null until they exist, Task 5); whether the profile holds a retired handle's placeholder. Null
 * for an account without a live profile. Not auth.account_standing, the boolean grant-role asks.
 */
export async function standingFor(q: Runner, accountId: string): Promise<AccountStanding | null> {
  const row = await accountStandingRow(q, accountId);
  if (row === null) return null;
  const m = row.measure;
  return {
    activeStrikes: row.activeStrikes,
    measure:
      m === null
        ? null
        : {
            decisionId: m.decisionId,
            kind: m.kind,
            days: m.kind === "terminate" ? null : m.days,
            state: m.running ? "running" : m.startsAt !== null ? "announced" : m.reply?.onTime && !m.replyAnswered ? "held" : "unfixed",
            earliestStart: m.earliestStart,
            startsAt: m.startsAt,
            endsAt: m.kind === "terminate" ? null : m.endsAt,
            reply: m.reply,
            // One reply a measure; the reply route that takes it is Task 4's.
            replyOpen: m.reply === null,
            // Open while no appeal was filed and its six months run; one filed (pending or answered) closes it.
            appealUntil: !m.appealed && m.appealOpen ? m.appealDeadline : null,
            appealPending: m.appealPending,
          },
    reporting: null,
    handleRetired: isRetiredPlaceholder(row.handle.toLowerCase()),
  };
}
```

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { ActionKind } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { iso, rows, type Runner, type TargetType } from "./repo";

/** An instant as JavaScript writes it, or null for an infinite one (a termination's end). The expression is written here, never input. */
const finite = (expression: string) => sql`case when isfinite(${sql.raw(expression)}) then ${iso(expression)} end`;

/**
 * The queries a statement of reasons is read from (3c design, sections 7.5 and 10): the decision with its texts and the
 * decision it is about, its ledger rows, and the measures taken while deciding that ended with it. Every surface an
 * author reads a statement on (the decision's screen, the mail, the export, the answer to an appeal) is rendered from
 * these, so they are kept apart from the module's other queries: a test refuses the names of the tables of reports and
 * notices in this file, but for one pinned read in endedMeasures, which answers true or false of the case's own items.
 */

/** A decision as its statement is rendered from it, with what the mail and the staff alerts need beside it. */
export interface StatementDecisionRow {
  id: string;
  caseId: string;
  kind: "interim" | "final" | "review" | "correction";
  outcome: string;
  ground: string | null;
  ruleId: string | null;
  rulesVersion: number;
  redressVersion: number;
  source: string;
  decidedAt: string;
  suspect: boolean;
  authorMail: string;
  decidedBy: string;
  facts: string | null;
  reason: string | null;
  legalReference: string | null;
  targetType: TargetType;
  targetId: string;
  /** The post's creation time, which survives its deletion; null for an account case. */
  postCreatedAt: string | null;
  /** The account the decision is about: the post's author, or the account itself. */
  subjectId: string | null;
  /** The decision a review or a correction is about. */
  reviewed: { kind: "interim" | "final"; ground: string | null; ruleId: string | null; rulesVersion: number; legalReference: string | null; decidedAt: string } | null;
}

export async function statementDecision(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<StatementDecisionRow | null> {
  const [row] = await rows<Record<string, unknown>>(
    q,
    sql`select d.id, d.case_id, d.kind, d.outcome, d.ground, d.rule_id, d.rules_version, d.redress_version, d.source, ${iso("d.decided_at")} as decided_at, d.suspect, d.author_mail, d.decided_by,
               (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = d.facts_digest) as facts,
               (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = d.reason_digest) as reason,
               (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = d.legal_reference_digest) as legal_reference,
               c.target_type, c.target_id,
               (select ${iso("p.created_at")} from posts p where c.target_type = 'post' and p.id = c.target_id) as post_created_at,
               case when c.target_type = 'post' then (select p.author_id from posts p where p.id = c.target_id) else c.target_id end as subject_id,
               r.kind as reviewed_kind, r.ground as reviewed_ground, r.rule_id as reviewed_rule, r.rules_version as reviewed_rules_version, ${iso("r.decided_at")} as reviewed_at,
               (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = r.legal_reference_digest) as reviewed_legal
          from decisions d join cases c on c.id = d.case_id left join decisions r on r.id = d.reviews_decision_id
         where d.id = ${decisionId}::uuid`,
  );
  if (!row) return null;
  return {
    id: row.id as string,
    caseId: row.case_id as string,
    kind: row.kind as StatementDecisionRow["kind"],
    outcome: row.outcome as string,
    ground: row.ground as string | null,
    ruleId: row.rule_id as string | null,
    rulesVersion: row.rules_version as number,
    redressVersion: row.redress_version as number,
    source: row.source as string,
    decidedAt: row.decided_at as string,
    suspect: row.suspect as boolean,
    authorMail: row.author_mail as string,
    decidedBy: row.decided_by as string,
    facts: row.facts as string | null,
    reason: row.reason as string | null,
    legalReference: row.legal_reference as string | null,
    targetType: row.target_type as TargetType,
    targetId: row.target_id as string,
    postCreatedAt: row.post_created_at as string | null,
    subjectId: row.subject_id as string | null,
    reviewed:
      row.reviewed_kind === null
        ? null
        : { kind: row.reviewed_kind as "interim" | "final", ground: row.reviewed_ground as string | null, ruleId: row.reviewed_rule as string | null, rulesVersion: row.reviewed_rules_version as number, legalReference: row.reviewed_legal as string | null, decidedAt: row.reviewed_at as string },
  };
}

/** One ledger row of a decision as its statement tells of it: for a reversal the measure it lifts, for a seal what its list held. */
export interface StatementActionRow {
  kind: ActionKind;
  mediaId: string | null;
  noEffect: "already" | "deleted" | null;
  /** For a reversal: the decision that holds the lifted measure, its rule, whether that measure changed anything, and whether korbat still kept that decision's snapshot when this one was made. */
  lifted: { decisionId: string; ruleId: string | null; noEffect: string | null; snapshotKept: boolean } | null;
  sealedPosts: number;
  sealedImages: number;
  /** The seal's images on posts their author had deleted by the time it was recorded: nothing later is read. */
  sealedDeletedImages: number;
  /** A strike's end of counting, and the strikes of its account that stood and counted at its decision's time, this one included. */
  endsAt: string | null;
  activeThen: number | null;
  /** On a suspension or a termination: whether it was announced; null on every other kind. */
  announced: boolean | null;
  /**
   * On a retirement, the handle of its decision's snapshot in lower case, as the database retires it; on a reversal of one,
   * the same of the lifted decision. A snapshot keeps its handle through an erasure (3e design, section 6.7). Null otherwise.
   */
  handle: string | null;
  /** On a retirement that changed the profile, the placeholder it gave, made from the measure's id as the database makes it. */
  placeholder: string | null;
  /**
   * 3e (design, section 10.2), on a standing measure: its days, its basis, its earliest start (the row's starts_at), and
   * one entry for each decision it rests on (its time, its rule and the time of its post; for a protective suspension
   * the sealing decision's time alone). A measure taken at once also ends: `endsAt` is its created_at plus its days.
   */
  days: number | null;
  basis: string | null;
  earliestStart: string | null;
  restsOn: { decidedAt: string; ruleId: string | null; postCreatedAt: string | null }[] | null;
  /**
   * 3e, on the lift of a suspension or a termination: the lifted measure's kind and decision's time, where its period
   * stood at this decision's time (by suspension_periods, whose end a lift cuts to the lift's time), and whether the lift
   * was signed `replaced`.
   */
  liftedKind: "suspend" | "terminate" | null;
  liftedDecidedAt: string | null;
  periodThen: { state: "not_started" | "running" | "ended"; startedAt: string | null; endedAt: string | null } | null;
  replaced: boolean | null;
}

/** A decision's measures and reversals, in the ledger's order of kinds. */
export async function statementActions(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<StatementActionRow[]> {
  const found = await rows<Record<string, unknown>>(
    q,
    sql`select a.kind, a.media_id, a.no_effect, l.decision_id as lifted_decision, ld.rule_id as lifted_rule, l.no_effect as lifted_no_effect,
               (ls.erased_at is null or ls.erased_at > d.decided_at) as lifted_snapshot_kept,
               (select count(*)::int from seal_posts s where s.action_id = a.id) as sealed_posts,
               (select coalesce(sum(s.images), 0)::int from seal_posts s where s.action_id = a.id) as sealed_images,
               (select coalesce(sum(s.images), 0)::int from seal_posts s join posts p on p.id = s.post_id
                 where s.action_id = a.id and p.state = 'deleted_by_author' and p.deleted_at <= a.created_at) as sealed_deleted,
               case when a.kind = 'strike' then ${iso("a.ends_at")}
                    when a.kind = 'suspend' and a.announced is false then ${iso("(a.created_at + make_interval(days => a.days))")} end as ends_at,
               case when a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') then a.days end as days,
               case when a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') then a.basis end as basis,
               case when a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') then ${iso("a.starts_at")} end as earliest_start,
               -- The decisions a standing measure rests on, in the ledger's order: what korbat fixed for good about each.
               case when a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') and a.rests_on is not null then (
                 select json_agg(json_build_object('decidedAt', ${iso("x.decided_at")},
                                                   'ruleId', case when a.basis = 'protective' then null else x.rule_id end,
                                                   'postCreatedAt', case when a.basis = 'protective' then null else ${iso("xp.created_at")} end) order by u.ord)
                   from unnest(a.rests_on) with ordinality as u(id, ord)
                   join decisions x on x.id = u.id
                   join cases xc on xc.id = x.case_id
                   left join posts xp on xc.target_type = 'post' and xp.id = xc.target_id) end as rests_on,
               case when a.kind = 'lift_suspension' then l.kind::text end as lifted_kind,
               case when a.kind = 'lift_suspension' then ${iso("ld.decided_at")} end as lifted_decided_at,
               case when a.kind = 'lift_suspension' then a.replaced end as replaced,
               -- Where the lifted measure's period stood at this lift's time: the lift cuts its end to that time, so a period
               -- that ends before it had already ended, and one with no start, or a start not before it, never started.
               ${iso("lp.starts_at")} as lifted_started_at, ${finite("lp.ends_at")} as lifted_ended_at,
               case when a.kind <> 'lift_suspension' then null
                    when lp.starts_at is null or lp.starts_at >= a.created_at then 'not_started'
                    when lp.ends_at < a.created_at then 'ended' else 'running' end as lifted_state,
               -- What the ledger held at the decision's time, never later: a strike that counted then, and was not overruled by then.
               case when a.kind = 'strike' then (select count(*)::int from decision_actions s
                     where s.subject_account_id = a.subject_account_id and s.kind = 'strike' and s.created_at <= a.created_at and s.ends_at > a.created_at
                       and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = s.id and r.created_at <= a.created_at)) end as active_then,

    sealedPosts: row.sealed_posts as number,

/** A measure taken while deciding that ended with a final decision, without a reversal. */
export interface EndedMeasureRow {
  kind: ActionKind;
  mediaId: string | null;
  decisionId: string;
  ruleId: string | null;
  noEffect: string | null;
  snapshotKept: boolean;
}

/**
 * The measures taken while deciding that ended with this final decision, of those their author was told of: every one
 * that was still in force when the decision closed its case, and a seal taken while deciding whose suspect items the
 * decision answered, unless the decision itself seals (the images then stay sealed). It reads only what stood when the
 * decision was made: a reversal recorded later, or an item that arrived later, changes nothing here.
 */
export async function endedMeasures(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<EndedMeasureRow[]> {
  const found = await rows<Record<string, unknown>>(
    q,
    sql`select a.kind, a.media_id, i.id as decision_id, i.rule_id, a.no_effect, (s.erased_at is null or s.erased_at > d.decided_at) as snapshot_kept
          from decisions d
          join cases c on c.id = d.case_id
          join decisions i on i.case_id = d.case_id and i.kind = 'interim' and i.decided_at < d.decided_at and i.author_mail <> 'none'
          join decision_actions a on a.decision_id = i.id
          join evidence_snapshots s on s.id = i.snapshot_id
         where d.id = ${decisionId}::uuid and d.kind = 'final'
           and a.kind in ('withhold', 'seal_media', 'withhold_media', 'reset_display_name', 'reset_bio')
           and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id and r.created_at <= d.decided_at)
           and case when a.kind = 'seal_media'
                 then exists (select 1 from intake_items x where x.case_id = d.case_id and x.suspect and x.answered_by = d.id and x.created_at <= i.decided_at)
                      and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions own where own.decision_id = d.id and own.kind = 'seal_media')
                 else c.closed_at = d.decided_at end
         order by i.decided_at, a.kind, a.media_id`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => ({ kind: row.kind as ActionKind, mediaId: row.media_id as string | null, decisionId: row.decision_id as string, ruleId: row.rule_id as string | null, noEffect: row.no_effect as string | null, snapshotKept: row.snapshot_kept as boolean }));
}

/** A standing measure whose basis a reversal of a decision broke (3e design, sections 6.2 and 10.2). */
export interface EndedStandingRow {
  kind: "suspend" | "terminate";
  decidedAt: string;
  periodThen: { state: "not_started" | "running" | "ended"; startedAt: string | null; endedAt: string | null };
  seal: boolean;
  replyFiledAt: string | null;
}

/**
 * The suspensions and terminations whose basis this review or correction broke: those that name the reviewed decision in
 * rests_on and whose basis broke at this decision's time (standing_basis_broken_at answers the time of the reversal that
 * broke it, which is this decision's own). For each, where its period stood at this decision's time (the break cut its
 * end to that time), whether the basis was a seal, and the time of its reply when this decision answered it. The
 * restrictions of reporting a lifted warning ends join this list with the reporting task.
 */
export async function endedStanding(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<EndedStandingRow[]> {
  const found = await rows<{ kind: "suspend" | "terminate"; decided_at: string; state: "not_started" | "running" | "ended"; started_at: string | null; ended_at: string | null; seal: boolean; reply_filed_at: string | null }>(
    q,
    sql`select m.kind::text as kind, ${iso("md.decided_at")} as decided_at,
               case when p.starts_at is null or p.starts_at >= d.decided_at then 'not_started'
                    when p.ends_at < d.decided_at then 'ended' else 'running' end as state,
               ${iso("p.starts_at")} as started_at, ${finite("p.ends_at")} as ended_at,
               m.basis = 'protective' as seal,
               (select ${iso("r.filed_at")} from suspension_replies r where r.action_id = m.id and r.answered_by = d.id) as reply_filed_at
          from decisions d
          join decision_actions m on m.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') and d.reviews_decision_id = any(m.rests_on)
          join decisions md on md.id = m.decision_id
          left join suspension_periods p on p.action_id = m.id
         where d.id = ${decisionId}::uuid and d.kind in ('review', 'correction')
           and public.standing_basis_broken_at(m.id) = d.decided_at

  );
```

```ts
import { MEASURES, type DecisionStatement, type MeasureKind, type ReversalKind, type RuleId, type StandingBasis } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { statementParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { DecisionMessage } from "../auth";
import type { ModerationDeps } from "./context";
import { beginMailRecord, lockPendingAuthorMail, recordAuthorMail, type MailState } from "./repo";
import { endedMeasures, endedStanding, statementActions, statementDecision, type StatementDecisionRow } from "./statement-repo";

/**
 * The data a statement of reasons and its mail are rendered from (3c design, sections 7.5 and 10). A decision is the
 * statement: every element is a column, a ledger row or a saved text, read here into the one shape that @korbat/rules
 * renders for the mail, the author's screen and the console's preview. Nothing read here is changed by a later event, so
 * a statement reads as it was sent whenever it is rendered.
 */

/** A decision's statement with what mailing it needs: whom it is about, and whether its mail is still owed. */
export interface StatementFound {
  statement: DecisionStatement;
  decision: StatementDecisionRow;
}

/** Whether a field reset's old value was still kept when the decision that ends or lifts it was made, and where it can be read. */
function resetFacts(kind: MeasureKind | ReversalKind, held: { decisionId: string; ruleId: string | null; noEffect: string | null; snapshotKept: boolean }) {
  const target = MEASURES[kind].target;
  if (target !== "display_name" && target !== "bio") return { resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null };
  // The reset's own snapshot holds the old value, by its compare-and-set; a reset that changed nothing removed none.
  return { resetDecisionId: held.decisionId, oldValueKept: held.noEffect === null && held.snapshotKept, resetRuleId: held.ruleId as RuleId | null };
}

/** The statement's data of one decision, or null when no decision has the id. */
export async function decisionStatement(q: ModerationDeps["apiDb"], decisionId: string): Promise<StatementFound | null> {
  const decision = await statementDecision(q, decisionId);
  if (!decision) return null;
  const actions = await statementActions(q, decisionId);
  const ended = decision.kind === "final" ? await endedMeasures(q, decisionId) : [];
  // 3e: the standing measures whose basis a reversal of this decision broke; absent from a statement that holds none.
  const brokenBasis = decision.kind === "review" || decision.kind === "correction" ? await endedStanding(q, decisionId) : [];
  // The facts and the reason are told with a decision that restricts (it holds a measure), with a correction and with a
  // review. Those of a decision without a measure are the case's record, for staff: such a decision tells its author at
  // most that what korbat did while deciding has ended, so the statement's data holds neither, and no mail, screen or
  // export that is rendered from it can carry them.
  const told = decision.kind === "correction" || decision.kind === "review" || actions.some((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null);
  const statement: DecisionStatement = {
    kind: decision.kind,
    outcome: decision.outcome as DecisionStatement["outcome"],
    ground: decision.ground as DecisionStatement["ground"],
    ruleId: decision.ruleId as RuleId | null,
    rulesVersion: decision.rulesVersion,
    redressVersion: decision.redressVersion,
    legalReference: decision.legalReference,
    facts: told ? decision.facts : null,
    reason: told ? decision.reason : null,
    source: decision.source as DecisionStatement["source"],
    decidedAt: decision.decidedAt,
    post: decision.targetType === "post" && decision.postCreatedAt !== null ? { id: decision.targetId, createdAt: decision.postCreatedAt } : null,
    measures: actions
      .filter((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null)
      .map((action) => ({
        kind: action.kind as MeasureKind,
        mediaId: action.mediaId,
        noEffect: action.noEffect,
        sealed: action.kind === "seal_media" ? { posts: action.sealedPosts, images: action.sealedImages, deletedImages: action.sealedDeletedImages } : null,
        // 3e: what the ledger fixed for good about a strike, a standing measure and a retirement, so its statement reads as
        // it was sent (a retirement's sentence reads its end from whether the decision suspends or terminates at once).
        ...(action.kind === "strike" ? { endsAt: action.endsAt, activeThen: action.activeThen } : {}),
        ...(action.kind === "suspend" || action.kind === "terminate"
          ? {
              announced: action.announced,
              days: action.days,
              basis: action.basis as StandingBasis | null,
              earliestStart: action.earliestStart,
              endsAt: action.endsAt,
              restsOn: action.restsOn === null ? null : action.restsOn.map((entry) => ({ ...entry, ruleId: entry.ruleId as RuleId | null })),
            }
          : {}),
        ...(action.kind === "retire_handle" ? { handle: action.handle, placeholder: action.placeholder } : {}),
      })),
    reversals: actions
      .filter((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts !== null)
      .map((action) => ({
        kind: action.kind as ReversalKind,
        mediaId: action.mediaId,
        ...(action.lifted === null ? { resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null } : resetFacts(action.kind, action.lifted)),
        // 3e: the handle a reversal of a retirement gives back.
        ...(action.kind === "unretire_handle" ? { handle: action.handle } : {}),
        // 3e: what a lift of a suspension lifted, where its period stood then, and whether it was a withdrawal for another measure.
        ...(action.kind === "lift_suspension" ? { liftedKind: action.liftedKind, liftedDecidedAt: action.liftedDecidedAt, periodThen: action.periodThen, replaced: action.replaced } : {}),
      })),
    endedMeasures: ended.map((measure) => ({ kind: measure.kind as MeasureKind, mediaId: measure.mediaId, ...resetFacts(measure.kind, measure) })),
    ...(brokenBasis.length > 0 ? { endedStanding: brokenBasis } : {}),
    reviewed:
      decision.reviewed === null
        ? null
        : {
            kind: decision.reviewed.kind,
            ground: decision.reviewed.ground as DecisionStatement["ground"],
            ruleId: decision.reviewed.ruleId as RuleId | null,
            // The reviewed decision's own rulebook version: its rule is rendered as it was worded when that decision was made.
            rulesVersion: decision.reviewed.rulesVersion,
            legalReference: decision.reviewed.legalReference,
            decidedAt: decision.reviewed.decidedAt,
          },
  };
  return { statement, decision };
}

/**
 * The subject of the statement's mail, by the decision's kind and outcome (3c design, section 7.15), as a key of the mail
 * template's own table: a seal first, whatever else the decision holds; then a decision taken while deciding, on a post
 * or on an account; a final restriction; a final decision that restricts nothing but ends or lifts what was done while
 * deciding, and a correction of a decision taken while deciding; a reversal of a final decision; and a kept appeal.
 */
export function mailSubjectOf(statement: DecisionStatement): Extract<DecisionMessage, { template: "moderation_decision" }>["subject"] {
  const seals = statement.measures.some((measure) => measure.kind === "seal_media");
  const post = statement.post !== null;
  if (statement.kind === "interim") return seals ? "seal_deciding" : post ? "post_deciding" : "profile_deciding";
  if (statement.kind === "final") {
    if (seals) return "seal_final";
    if (statement.outcome === "restricted") return post ? "post_restricted" : "profile_restricted";
    return "lifted_deciding";
  }
  if (statement.kind === "correction") return statement.reviewed?.kind === "interim" ? "lifted_deciding" : "reversed";
  return statement.outcome === "kept" ? "appeal_kept" : "reversed";
}

/**
 * The template a decision's statement is mailed under (3e design, sections 7.15 and 18, W.6): the first row of 7.15's
 * table that fits, and moderation_decision otherwise, so that a strike, a retirement and their reversals ride on 3c's
 * mail. Task 3 builds two rows: a suspension or a termination taken at once, and a lift of one, or a decision whose
 * reversal ended one by breaking its basis. The announced measures, the answer to a reply and the reporting measures
 * join with the tasks that build them.
 */
export function mailTemplateOf(statement: DecisionStatement, paragraphs: readonly string[]): DecisionMessage {
  const standing = statement.measures.find((measure) => measure.kind === "suspend" || measure.kind === "terminate");
  if (statement.kind === "final" && standing !== undefined && standing.announced === false) {
    const measure = standing.kind === "terminate" ? "terminate" : "suspend";
    return { template: "suspension_started_at_once", measure, days: standing.days ?? null, endsAt: standing.endsAt ?? null, paragraphs };
  }
  const lift = statement.reversals.find((reversal) => reversal.kind === "lift_suspension");
  if ((statement.kind === "review" || statement.kind === "correction") && lift !== undefined && lift.periodThen) {
    return { template: "suspension_lifted", measure: lift.liftedKind === "terminate" ? "terminate" : "suspend", why: "lifted", period: lift.periodThen.state, paragraphs };
  }
  const broken = (statement.endedStanding ?? []).find((entry) => entry.kind === "suspend" || entry.kind === "terminate");
  if (broken !== undefined) return { template: "suspension_lifted", measure: broken.kind === "terminate" ? "terminate" : "suspend", why: "basis", period: broken.periodThen.state, paragraphs };
  return { template: "moderation_decision", subject: mailSubjectOf(statement), paragraphs };
}

/**
 * Mails a decision's statement to its author when that mail is still owed, and records what became of it: `sent`,
 * `no_address` for an account that is gone, `failed` when the relay refused the address for good. A failure of the relay
 * is thrown, and the mail stays pending for the dispatch job. Answers what was recorded, or "none" when nothing was owed.
 *
 * The decision's row is taken before the mail is sent, in the transaction that records the result (beginMailRecord): a
 * database that cannot write refuses that, and nothing is sent, so a mail is never sent again and again for want of a
 * record. Two senders of one statement (the decision's own request and the dispatch job) then send it once: the second
 * waits for the row and finds the mail recorded.
 */
export async function sendStatement(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb" | "auth">, decisionId: string): Promise<MailState | "none"> {
  const found = await decisionStatement(deps.apiDb, decisionId);
  if (!found || found.decision.authorMail !== "pending") return "none";
  const subject = found.decision.subjectId;
  // The statement is rendered before anything is sent: one that cannot be rendered is no mail, and stays pending.
  const message = mailTemplateOf(found.statement, statementParagraphs(found.statement));
  return deps.apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await beginMailRecord(tx);
    if (!(await lockPendingAuthorMail(tx, decisionId))) return "none";
    const result = subject === null ? "no_address" : await deps.auth.mailAccount(subject, message);
    // A stop of the address never holds a statement back, so "suppressed" is never answered for it.
    const state: MailState = result === "sent" ? "sent" : result === "refused" ? "failed" : "no_address";
    await recordAuthorMail(tx, decisionId, state);
    return state;
  });
}
```

```ts
import { and, eq, isNotNull, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { handleHistory, profiles, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { handleRefusal, isUniqueViolation, type ProfileStore } from "../auth";
import { WRITE_CLOCK, liveNotSuspended } from "../lib/standing";

/**
 * Public profiles through the korbat_api pool. Onboarding writes the profile and the reservation of
 * its handle in one transaction; the unique index on lower(handle) and the primary key of
 * handle_history decide races and refuse a handle another profile holds or ever held. A handle korbat retired (3e) is
 * refused first, in the same transaction, with its own answer; the database's guard of handles refuses the same, and a
 * placeholder's form, under a race or to a caller that skipped the handle rule, and is answered alike.
 */
export function createProfileStore(apiDb: Db): ProfileStore {
  const columns = { id: profiles.id, handle: profiles.handle, displayName: profiles.displayName };
  return {
    async create({ id, handle, displayName }) {
      try {
        const profile = await apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
          // 3e: a retired handle is nobody's, so it is refused before the unique index would call it taken.
          const [retired] = await tx
            .select({ handle: handleHistory.handleLower })
            .from(handleHistory)
            .where(and(eq(handleHistory.handleLower, handle.toLowerCase()), isNotNull(handleHistory.retiredAt)))
            .limit(1);
          if (retired) return null;
          const [created] = await tx.insert(profiles).values({ id, handle, displayName }).returning(columns);
          // The handle chosen at onboarding is reserved like every later one (1b design, section 6); a row for it under another profile ends the transaction.
          await tx.insert(handleHistory).values({ handleLower: handle.toLowerCase(), profileId: id });
          return created!;
        });
        return profile === null ? { ok: false, reason: "handle_retired" } : { ok: true, profile };
      } catch (err) {
        const guarded = handleRefusal(err);
        if (guarded !== null) return { ok: false, reason: guarded };
        if (isUniqueViolation(err)) return { ok: false, reason: "handle_taken" };
        throw err;
      }
    },
    async find(id) {
      const [profile] = await apiDb
        .select({ ...columns, handleChangedAt: profiles.handleChangedAt, verifiedAt: profiles.verifiedAt, showInExplore: profiles.showInExplore })
        .from(profiles)
        .where(eq(profiles.id, id))
        .limit(1);
      if (!profile) return null;
      const { handleChangedAt, verifiedAt, showInExplore, ...pub } = profile;
      // The badge is a fact of the profile row (verified_at), read here so the account screen sees it on /me; so is the
      // author's Explore switch, which the privacy screen shows and the public profile never carries.
      return { ...pub, handleChangedAt: handleChangedAt?.toISOString() ?? null, verified: verifiedAt !== null, showInExplore };
    },
    /**
     * The badge, profiles.verified_at, which the auth module decides and cannot write. 3e (design, section 7.2): setting it
     * is a write of the account, so the one predicate joins the update's WHERE and the answer says whether a row changed;
     * removing it is open to everyone, and answers true.
     */
    async setVerified(id, at) {
      if (at === null) {
        await apiDb.update(profiles).set({ verifiedAt: null }).where(eq(profiles.id, id));
        return true;
      }
      const updated = await apiDb.update(profiles).set({ verifiedAt: at }).where(and(eq(profiles.id, id), liveNotSuspended("profiles", WRITE_CLOCK))).returning({ id: profiles.id });
      return updated.length === 1;
    },
    /** A plain read of the same fact, which startBadge asks first as a courtesy, so that no code is sent to a suspended account; the write decides. */
    async suspended(id) {
      const [row] = (await apiDb.execute(sql`select not ${liveNotSuspended("p", WRITE_CLOCK)} as suspended from profiles p where p.id = ${id}::uuid and p.deleted_at is null`)) as unknown as { suspended: boolean }[];
      return row?.suspended ?? false;
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
type HandleErrorCode = Extract<AuthErrorCode, "handle_invalid" | "handle_reserved" | "handle_taken" | "handle_cooldown" | "handle_retired">;

/** The social codes plus the shared ones the module also raises. */
export type SocialErrorKind = SocialErrorCode | HandleErrorCode | "not_found" | "invalid_request" | "rate_limited" | "service_unavailable";
export type SocialErrorStatus = 400 | 403 | 404 | 409 | 429 | 503;

const MESSAGES: Record<SocialErrorKind, string> = {
  post_unavailable: "That post is not available to reply to or quote.",
  not_author: "Only the author can delete this post.",
  blocked: "You blocked this account. Unblock it in your privacy settings first.",
  self_target: "You cannot do that to your own account.",
  account_too_new: "New accounts can repost and quote after 48 hours.",
  // The page asked for belongs to an Explore ranking that is no longer kept; the app starts again from the current one.
  explore_refreshed: "Explore was refreshed.",
  not_found: "Not found.",
  invalid_request: "Some details are missing or invalid.",
  rate_limited: "Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.",
  service_unavailable: "That could not be done right now. Try again in a moment.",
  handle_invalid: "Handles are 3 to 20 characters: lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.",
  handle_reserved: "That handle is reserved.",
  handle_taken: "That handle is taken.",
  handle_cooldown: "Handles can change once every 30 days.",
  // 3e (design, section 9.5): the auth module's words for the same code.
  handle_retired: "That handle was retired by korbat. Nobody can use it.",
  // 3e (design, sections 7.2 and 9.8): a write of an account while its suspension runs; no detail, the app reads /me.
  account_suspended: "Your account is suspended, so you cannot do this now.",
};

/** An expected, user-facing failure. The HTTP layer turns it into an ErrorEnvelope with this code and status. */
export class SocialError extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly code: SocialErrorKind,
    readonly status: SocialErrorStatus,
    message: string = MESSAGES[code],
    /** Set for rate_limited, service_unavailable and handle_cooldown so the response can carry Retry-After. */
    readonly retryAfterSeconds?: number,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "SocialError";
  }
}

export function socialErrorMessage(code: SocialErrorKind): string {
  return MESSAGES[code];
}

/** The account making a request, or null when signed out. Reads accept null; writes never do. */
export type ViewerId = string | null;

/** Posts without images: what the module runs with when no media module is wired, as in the 2a tests. */
export const WITHOUT_MEDIA: MediaForPosts = {
  attach: async (_tx, input) => {
    if (input.items.length > 0) throw new MediaError("media_unavailable", 400);
  },
  detachAll: async () => [],
  requestDeletion: async () => undefined,
  forPosts: async () => new Map(),
};

/** Security events about an account go to the auth module's table; this is its appendEvent, as the server wires it. */

  append(userId: string, type: AuthEventType, metadata?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void>;
}

  repo: SocialRepo;

  moderation?: ModerationForSocial;

  limits: RateLimitStore;

  events?: SocialEvents;
```

```ts
import type { BlockResponse, FollowResponse, MuteResponse, Pagination, ProfileListItem, ProfilePage } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { SocialError, type SocialDeps } from "../context";
import { decodeCursor } from "../cursor";
import { enforceWriteLimit } from "../limits";
import type { ProfileRow, Relation } from "../repo";
import { authorOf, pageCursor } from "../views";
import { onceMoreOnDeadlock, ownProfile } from "./posts";
import { lookupProfile } from "./profiles";

/**
 * The account a graph action targets. Never yourself. For an action, an account that blocks the
 * viewer is `not_found`, like every other read or write towards it; undoing the viewer's own block
 * or mute needs no such answer, since the viewer is looking at their own list.
 */
async function target(deps: SocialDeps, viewer: string, handle: string, on: boolean): Promise<{ profile: ProfileRow; relation: Relation }> {
  const profile = await lookupProfile(deps, handle);
  if (profile.id === viewer) throw new SocialError("self_target", 400);
  const relation = await deps.repo.relation(viewer, profile.id);
  if (on && relation.blockedBy) throw new SocialError("not_found", 404);
  return { profile, relation };
}

/**
 * Follow or unfollow. Following someone you block is `blocked`; someone who blocks you is
 * `not_found`, like every other read or write towards them. Only the follow itself is limited.
 * 3e (design, section 5, the lock order, item 3): a follow or an unfollow between an account being purged and one of its
 * counterparts can cross the purge's locks; PostgreSQL ends one of the two, and the follow or unfollow, which changed
 * nothing, is run once more and then finds the purge committed. A suspended account's follow is refused account_suspended.
 */
export async function setFollow(deps: SocialDeps, viewer: string, handle: string, on: boolean): Promise<FollowResponse> {
  const { profile, relation } = await target(deps, viewer, handle, on);
  if (relation.blocked) throw new SocialError("blocked", 403);
  if (relation.blockedBy) throw new SocialError("not_found", 404);
  if (on) {
    const me = await ownProfile(deps, viewer);
    await enforceWriteLimit(deps.limits, viewer, "follow", me.createdAt, deps.now());
    await onceMoreOnDeadlock(() => deps.repo.follow(viewer, profile.id, deps.now(), true));
  } else {
    await onceMoreOnDeadlock(() => deps.repo.unfollow(viewer, profile.id));
  }
  const fresh = (await deps.repo.findProfiles([profile.id])).get(profile.id)!;
  return { following: on, followerCount: fresh.followerCount };
}

/** Block or unblock. Blocking removes follows, reposts and likes in both directions; unblocking restores nothing. */
export async function setBlock(deps: SocialDeps, viewer: string, handle: string, on: boolean): Promise<BlockResponse> {
  const { profile } = await target(deps, viewer, handle, on);
  if (on) {
    const me = await ownProfile(deps, viewer);
    await enforceWriteLimit(deps.limits, viewer, "block", me.createdAt, deps.now());
    await deps.repo.block(viewer, profile.id, deps.now());
  } else {
    await deps.repo.unblock(viewer, profile.id);
  }
  return { blocked: on };
}

/** Mute or unmute. Silent: the muted account is never told and nothing else changes. */
export async function setMute(deps: SocialDeps, viewer: string, handle: string, on: boolean): Promise<MuteResponse> {
  const { profile } = await target(deps, viewer, handle, on);
  if (on) {
    const me = await ownProfile(deps, viewer);
    await enforceWriteLimit(deps.limits, viewer, "mute", me.createdAt, deps.now());
    await deps.repo.mute(viewer, profile.id, deps.now());
  } else {
    await deps.repo.unmute(viewer, profile.id);
  }
  return { muted: on };
}

async function ownList(deps: SocialDeps, viewer: string, rows: { profileId: string; sortAt: Date }[], limit: number): Promise<ProfilePage> {
  const ids = rows.map((row) => row.profileId);
  const [profiles, followed] = await Promise.all([deps.repo.findProfiles(ids), deps.repo.followedBy(viewer, ids)]);
  const items: ProfileListItem[] = [];
  for (const id of ids) {
    const row = profiles.get(id);
    if (row) items.push({ ...authorOf(row), bio: row.bio, viewerFollows: followed.has(id) });
  }
  return { items, nextCursor: pageCursor(rows, limit) };
}

/** The viewer's own blocked accounts, newest block first. This is where unblocking starts. */
export async function blockedList(deps: SocialDeps, viewer: string, query: Pagination): Promise<ProfilePage> {
  const rows = await deps.repo.blockedList(viewer, query.cursor ? decodeCursor(query.cursor) : undefined, query.limit);
  return ownList(deps, viewer, rows, query.limit);
}

export async function mutedList(deps: SocialDeps, viewer: string, query: Pagination): Promise<ProfilePage> {
  const rows = await deps.repo.mutedList(viewer, query.cursor ? decodeCursor(query.cursor) : undefined, query.limit);
  return ownList(deps, viewer, rows, query.limit);
}
```

```ts
import type { CreatePostRequest, Pagination, PostView, ThreadResponse } from "@korbat/contracts";

import { SocialError, type SocialDeps, type ViewerId } from "../context";

/** The viewer's own profile row; the tiers need its creation time. */
export async function ownProfile(deps: SocialDeps, viewer: string): Promise<ProfileRow> {

  if (!profile) throw new SocialError("not_found", 404);

 * the viewer blocked the author it is `blocked`; when the author blocked the viewer it is
 * `hiddenCode`, which reveals nothing.

export async function targetPost(deps: SocialDeps, viewer: string, id: string, hiddenCode: "not_found" | "post_unavailable" = "not_found"): Promise<PostRow> {
  const hidden = () => new SocialError(hiddenCode, hiddenCode === "not_found" ? 404 : 400);
  const row = (await deps.repo.findPosts([id])).get(id);
  if (!row) throw hidden();
  if (postAccess(viewer, row, false) !== "shown") throw hidden();
  if (row.authorId !== viewer) {
    const relation = await deps.repo.relation(viewer, row.authorId);
    if (relation.blocked) throw new SocialError("blocked", 403);
    if (relation.blockedBy) throw hidden();
  }
  return row;
}

/**
 * A post, a reply or a quote by the viewer. 3e (design, section 5, the lock order, item 3): the repository takes the
 * author's row before the replied-to or quoted author's, and a purge takes its own row before its followers'; a quote of
 * the purged account's post by one of its followers can cross that purge, and PostgreSQL ends one of the two. The post's
 * transaction then changed nothing, so it is run once more: the second try finds the purge committed and answers as for
 * any deleted account. A second deadlock is the caller's.
 */
export async function createPost(deps: SocialDeps, viewer: string, input: CreatePostRequest): Promise<PostView> {
  const me = await ownProfile(deps, viewer);
  const action = input.replyToId ? "reply" : input.quoteOfId ? "quote" : "post";
  const targetId = input.replyToId ?? input.quoteOfId;
  const target = targetId ? await targetPost(deps, viewer, targetId, "post_unavailable") : null;
  await enforceWriteLimit(deps.limits, viewer, action, me.createdAt, deps.now());
  const write = () =>
    deps.repo.createPost({
      authorId: viewer,
      body: input.body,
      replyToId: input.replyToId ?? null,
      quoteOfId: input.quoteOfId ?? null,
      now: deps.now(),
      lockWith: target && target.authorId !== viewer ? target.authorId : null,
      within: (tx, postId) => deps.media.attach(tx, { postId, ownerId: viewer, items: input.media }),
    });
  const id = await onceMoreOnDeadlock(write);
  return (await postView(deps, viewer, id))!;
}

/** Runs a write, and once more when the database chose it to give way in a deadlock: it changed nothing (3e design, section 5). */
export async function onceMoreOnDeadlock<T>(write: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  try {
    return await write();
  } catch (err) {
    if (!isDeadlock(err)) throw err;
    return write();
  }
}

export async function getPost(deps: SocialDeps, viewer: ViewerId, id: string): Promise<PostView> {
  const view = await postView(deps, viewer, id);
  if (!view) throw new SocialError("not_found", 404);
  return view;
}

/** Author only. Deleting twice is a no-op. Someone who may not see the post learns nothing. */
export async function deletePost(deps: SocialDeps, viewer: string, id: string): Promise<void> {
  const row = (await deps.repo.findPosts([id])).get(id);
  if (!row) throw new SocialError("not_found", 404);
  if (row.authorId === viewer) {
    // The image rows go with the post, in its transaction. Their files are deleted after the commit: files cannot be rolled back.
    // The media module answers only the rows that are gone: an image a case holds as evidence, and every image of a frozen
    // post, keeps its row, served to nobody, and no deletion is asked for its files.
    let images: string[] = [];
    const remove = () =>
      deps.repo.deletePost(id, viewer, deps.now(), async (tx) => {
        images = await deps.media.detachAll(tx, id);
      });
    try {
      await remove();
    } catch (err) {
      // The deletion takes its posts in the order a report takes them, so the two never deadlock. An account's purge
      // still writes the counters of other accounts' posts in no order (its own comment says so), and the database may
      // end this transaction to break such a cycle. It has then changed nothing, so it is run once more: the author who
      // takes content down is not answered with an error for a wait that is over. A second deadlock is the caller's.
      if (!isDeadlock(err)) throw err;
      images = [];
      await remove();
    }
    await deps.media.requestDeletion(images);
    return;
  }
  const blocked = (await deps.repo.blockedEitherWay(viewer, [row.authorId])).has(row.authorId);
  if (postAccess(viewer, row, blocked) !== "shown") throw new SocialError("not_found", 404);
  throw new SocialError("not_author", 403);
}

/** The post, its ancestors root first (tombstones where needed), and a page of direct replies oldest first. */
export async function thread(deps: SocialDeps, viewer: ViewerId, id: string, query: Pagination): Promise<ThreadResponse> {
  const post = await getPost(deps, viewer, id);
  const ancestorIds = await deps.repo.ancestorIds(id);
  const loaded = await loadPostViews(deps, viewer, ancestorIds);
  const ancestors = ancestorIds.map((ancestorId) => loaded.get(ancestorId)!);
  const cursor = query.cursor ? decodeCursor(query.cursor) : undefined;
  const rows = await deps.repo.replies(id, viewer, cursor, query.limit);
  const items = await postViews(deps, viewer, rows);
  return { ancestors: ancestors.map((a) => (isTombstone(a) ? a : a)), post, replies: { items, nextCursor: pageCursor(rows, query.limit) } };
}
```
