```tsx
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Pressable, ScrollView, Text, View } from "react-native";
import { useLocalSearchParams } from "expo-router";
import type { AuthorCaseRow, ReportItem, ReportRow } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { AppShell } from "@/components/AppShell";
import { DecisionsList, ReportsList, StandingBlock } from "@/components/moderation/CasesLists";
import { SettingsNav } from "@/components/SettingsNav";
import { ErrorText, TextButton } from "@/components/ui";
import { errorMessage } from "@/lib/api";
import { moderation } from "@/lib/moderation";
import { CASES_WORDS, STATUS_WORDS } from "@/lib/moderation-words";
import { useSession } from "@/lib/session";

type Tab = "about" | "reports";

/** A list read a page at a time: its rows so far, the cursor of the next page, and whether a read is out or failed. */
interface Pages<T> {
  rows: T[];
  next: string | null;
  loaded: boolean;
  busy: boolean;
  error: string | null;
}

const EMPTY = { rows: [], next: null, loaded: false, busy: false, error: null };

/**
 * Cases (3c design, section 9), inside the settings layout, which lets in only a signed-in account with a handle: two
 * tabs. "About you" lists the decisions about the account; "Your reports" lists the reports it sent, with their outcomes
 * once released and, when the account's address stopped korbat's report mails, the notice and the button that resumes
 * them. A link from the report form opens the second tab (`?tab=reports`).
 */
export default function Cases() {
  const params = useLocalSearchParams<{ tab?: string }>();
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>(params.tab === "reports" ? "reports" : "about");
  // 3e: the block "Your standing" reads the account's measure from /me, which the session holds fresh.
  const { state } = useSession();
  const [decisions, setDecisions] = useState<Pages<AuthorCaseRow>>(EMPTY);
  const [reports, setReports] = useState<Pages<ReportRow>>(EMPTY);
  const [mailStopped, setMailStopped] = useState(false);
  // 3e: how many of the account's strikes count now, as every page of "About you" says.
  const [activeStrikes, setActiveStrikes] = useState(0);
  const [resuming, setResuming] = useState(false);
  const [resumeError, setResumeError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  /** Reads the first page of the decisions, or the page after `cursor`. */
  const loadDecisions = useCallback(async (cursor?: string) => {
    setDecisions((current) => ({ ...current, busy: true, error: null }));
    try {
      const page = await moderation.cases(cursor);
      setActiveStrikes(page.activeStrikes);
      setDecisions((current) => ({ rows: cursor ? [...current.rows, ...page.decisions] : page.decisions, next: page.nextCursor, loaded: true, busy: false, error: null }));
    } catch (err) {
      setDecisions((current) => ({ ...current, busy: false, error: errorMessage(err) }));
    }
  }, []);

  /** The same for the reports; every page says whether korbat's report mails to the account are stopped. */
  const loadReports = useCallback(async (cursor?: string) => {
    setReports((current) => ({ ...current, busy: true, error: null }));
    try {
      const page = await moderation.reports(cursor);
      setMailStopped(page.reportMailStopped);
      setReports((current) => ({ rows: cursor ? [...current.rows, ...page.reports] : page.reports, next: page.nextCursor, loaded: true, busy: false, error: null }));
    } catch (err) {
      setReports((current) => ({ ...current, busy: false, error: errorMessage(err) }));
    }
  }, []);

  // Each tab reads its list the first time it is shown.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (tab === "about" && !decisions.loaded && !decisions.busy && decisions.error === null) void loadDecisions();
    if (tab === "reports" && !reports.loaded && !reports.busy && reports.error === null) void loadReports();
  }, [tab, decisions, reports, loadDecisions, loadReports]);

  async function resume() {
    if (resuming) return;
    setResuming(true);
    setResumeError(null);
    try {
      await moderation.resumeReportMail();
      setMailStopped(false);
    } catch (err) {
      setResumeError(errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setResuming(false);
    }
  }

  /**
   * "Ask for a re-examination" of one item of the account's own reports, by its id; the list is then read again from
   * its start. A refusal is thrown to the control that asked, which words it in place.
   */
  async function reexamine(item: ReportItem, statement: string) {
    await moderation.reexamineOwn(item.id, statement);
    await loadReports();
  }

  const shown = tab === "about" ? decisions : reports;
  return (
    <AppShell>
      <ScrollView>
        <View className="border-b border-zinc-800 px-4 pt-4">
          <Text accessibilityRole="header" className="text-xl font-bold text-zinc-50">
            {CASES_WORDS.title}
          </Text>
          <SettingsNav current="cases" />
          <View accessibilityRole="tablist" className="mt-4 flex-row">
            {(["about", "reports"] as Tab[]).map((t) => (
              <Pressable key={t} accessibilityRole="tab" aria-selected={tab === t} onPress={() => setTab(t)} className={`mr-6 border-b-2 pb-2 ${tab === t ? "border-zinc-50" : "border-transparent"}`}>
                <Text className={`text-base ${tab === t ? "font-semibold text-zinc-50" : "text-zinc-400"}`}>{CASES_WORDS.tabs[t]}</Text>
              </Pressable>
            ))}
          </View>
        </View>
        {tab === "about" && decisions.loaded ? <StandingBlock activeStrikes={activeStrikes} standing={state.status === "signed-in" ? state.me.standing : null} /> : null}
        {tab === "about" && decisions.loaded ? <DecisionsList decisions={decisions.rows} /> : null}
        {tab === "reports" && reports.loaded ? <ReportsList page={{ reports: reports.rows, reportMailStopped: mailStopped }} onResume={() => void resume()} onReexamine={reexamine} busy={resuming} error={resumeError} /> : null}
        <View className="px-4 pb-10">
          <ErrorText message={shown.error} />
          {/* A first read that failed is asked again by hand; the tab does not ask in a loop. */}
          {shown.error && !shown.loaded ? <TextButton label={STATUS_WORDS.retry} onPress={() => void (tab === "about" ? loadDecisions() : loadReports())} /> : null}
          {shown.next ? <TextButton label={CASES_WORDS.more} onPress={() => void (tab === "about" ? loadDecisions(shown.next!) : loadReports(shown.next!))} /> : null}
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </AppShell>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { ScrollView, Text, View } from "react-native";
import { BIO_MAX_LENGTH, isRetiredPlaceholder, postLength, type MeResponse, type ProfileView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { AppShell } from "@/components/AppShell";

import { ApiError, errorMessage } from "@/lib/api";
import { useSession } from "@/lib/session";
import { social } from "@/lib/social";
import { refusalSentence, runningMeasure, STANDING_TEXTS } from "@/lib/standing";

/** The DisplayName contract's limit, in the code points the counter shows. */
const DISPLAY_NAME_MAX = 50;
/** The API lets a handle change again this long after the last change (1b design, section 7.2); mirrored so the date shows before a refused attempt. */
const HANDLE_COOLDOWN_MS = 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

type Run = (action: () => Promise<void>) => Promise<void>;
type Refresh = () => Promise<unknown>;

function Counter({ length, max }: { length: number; max: number }) {
  return (
    <Text className={`mt-1 text-right text-xs ${length > max ? "text-red-400" : "text-zinc-400"}`}>
      {length}/{max}
    </Text>
  );
}

/** Display name and bio. /api/me carries no bio, so the form starts from the public profile, which has both. */
function ProfileForm({ handle, refresh }: { handle: string; refresh: Refresh }) {
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState<ProfileView | null>(null);
  const [displayName, setDisplayName] = useState("");
  const [bio, setBio] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [done, setDone] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    social
      .profile(handle)
      .then((profile) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setSaved(profile);
        setDisplayName(profile.displayName);
        setBio(profile.bio);
      })
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        if (!cancelled) setError(errorMessage(err));
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [handle]);

  const name = displayName.trim();
  const text = bio.trim();
  const nameLength = postLength(name);
  const bioLength = postLength(text);
  const changed = saved !== null && (name !== saved.displayName || text !== saved.bio);
  const ready = changed && nameLength >= 1 && nameLength <= DISPLAY_NAME_MAX && bioLength <= BIO_MAX_LENGTH;

  // Enter in the bio calls this as the button does, so the button's conditions come first: nothing unchanged or invalid is
  // sent, and a second Enter while the first request is out sends nothing.
  async function save() {
    if (!saved || !ready || busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    setDone(null);
    try {
      // Only what changed is sent: the contract refuses an empty edit, and the server records an event per call.
      const { profile } = await social.editProfile({ ...(name !== saved.displayName ? { displayName: name } : {}), ...(text !== saved.bio ? { bio: text } : {}) });
      setSaved(profile);
      setDisplayName(profile.displayName);
      setBio(profile.bio);
      setDone("Profile saved.");
      // The shell's Profile link and the profile page read the session, so it follows the new name.
      await refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  if (!saved) {
    return error ? <ErrorText message={error} /> : <Text className="mt-3 text-sm text-zinc-400">Loading your profile...</Text>;
  }
  return (
    <View>
      <Body>Your display name is shown next to your posts. The bio is one line on your profile.</Body>
      <Field label="Display name" autoComplete="name" value={displayName} onChangeText={setDisplayName} />
      <Counter length={nameLength} max={DISPLAY_NAME_MAX} />
      {/* The Bio contract refuses control characters, which a line break is, so the field stays single-line. */}
      <Field label="Bio" value={bio} onChangeText={setBio} onSubmitEditing={() => void save()} />
      <Counter length={bioLength} max={BIO_MAX_LENGTH} />
      <ErrorText message={error} />
      <Notice message={done} />
      <Button label="Save" onPress={() => void save()} busy={busy} disabled={!ready} />
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * The handle and its 30-day rule. The change needs fresh authentication, so it runs through useReauth. While the profile
 * holds a placeholder (3e design, section 9.5) the section says that korbat retired the handle and that the wait does not
 * apply: the retirement cleared the change time, so the form is open at once. Exported for the server-rendered check.
 */
export function HandleSection({ me, run, refresh }: { me: MeResponse; run: Run; refresh: Refresh }) {
  const current = me.profile?.handle ?? "";
  const [handle, setHandle] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [done, setDone] = useState<string | null>(null);
  // The moment a handle_cooldown answer named through Retry-After; until one comes, the last change plus 30 days says it.
  const [refusedUntil, setRefusedUntil] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const fromLastChange = me.profile?.handleChangedAt ? new Date(me.profile.handleChangedAt).getTime() + HANDLE_COOLDOWN_MS : null;
  const until = refusedUntil ?? fromLastChange;
  const allowedAt = until !== null && until > Date.now() ? new Date(until) : null;
  const normalized = handle.trim().replace(/^@/, "").toLowerCase();
  // Keyed on the placeholder's form; while /me carries a running measure the sentence waits for its end (Task 3).
  const retired = isRetiredPlaceholder(current.toLowerCase());
  const running = runningMeasure(me.standing);
  const ready = normalized.length > 0 && normalized !== current.toLowerCase();

  // Enter in the field calls this as the button does, so the button's conditions come first.
  async function change() {
    if (!ready || busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    setDone(null);
    try {
      await run(async () => {
        const { profile } = await social.changeHandle(normalized);
        setHandle("");
        setRefusedUntil(null);
        setDone(`Your handle is now @${profile.handle}. The old one stays reserved for you.`);
        // The shell's Profile link and this screen's heading read the session.
        await refresh();
      });
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof ApiError && err.code === "handle_cooldown") setRefusedUntil(err.retryAfter ? Date.now() + err.retryAfter * 1000 : fromLastChange);
      setError(errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  // 3e (design, sections 9.4 and 9.5): while a suspension or termination runs, the form is replaced by the refusal's
  // sentence (a terminated account never chooses one, so it reads that sentence alone).
  if (running !== null) {
    return (
      <View>
        {retired && running.kind === "suspend" ? <Notice message={STANDING_TEXTS.handle.retiredSuspended} /> : null}
        <Body>{STANDING_TEXTS.handle.standing(current)}</Body>
        <Text accessibilityRole="alert" className="mt-4 text-sm text-amber-300">
          {refusalSentence(me.standing)}
        </Text>
      </View>
    );
  }
  return (
    <View>
      {retired ? <Notice message={STANDING_TEXTS.handle.retired} /> : null}
      <Body>{STANDING_TEXTS.handle.standing(current)}</Body>
      {allowedAt ? <Text className="mt-2 text-sm text-amber-300">Your next change is allowed on {allowedAt.toLocaleDateString()}.</Text> : null}
      <Field label="New handle" autoCapitalize="none" autoComplete="username" placeholder="@yourname" value={handle} onChangeText={setHandle} onSubmitEditing={() => void change()} />
      <ErrorText message={error} />
      <Notice message={done} />
      <Button label="Change handle" onPress={() => void change()} busy={busy} disabled={!ready} />
    </View>
  );
}

export default function ProfileSettings() {
  const { state, refresh } = useSession();
  const reauth = useReauth();

  if (state.status !== "signed-in") return <Loading />;
  const { me } = state;
  // The settings layout sends an account without a handle to onboarding, so the profile is there; the type still allows null.
  if (!me.profile) return <Loading />;

  return (
    <AppShell>
      <ScrollView className="flex-1 bg-zinc-950" contentContainerClassName="px-4 py-6">
        <Text accessibilityRole="header" className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-zinc-50">
          Profile
        </Text>
        <Text className="mt-2 text-base text-zinc-400">@{me.profile.handle}</Text>
        <SettingsNav current="profile" />

        {reauth.pending ? <ReauthPanel me={me} pending={reauth.pending} onClose={reauth.clear} /> : null}
        {/* After a recovery code confirmed the handle change: the screen stays as it is and says where two-factor is set up again. */}
        <ReenrollNotice me={me} />

        <Section title="Name and bio">
          {/* 3e (design, section 9.4): while a suspension or termination runs, the form is replaced by the refusal's sentence. */}
          {runningMeasure(me.standing) !== null ? (
            <Text accessibilityRole="alert" className="mt-3 text-sm text-amber-300">
              {refusalSentence(me.standing)}
            </Text>
          ) : (
            <ProfileForm handle={me.profile.handle} refresh={refresh} />
          )}
        </Section>
        <Section title="Handle">
          <HandleSection me={me} run={reauth.run} refresh={refresh} />
        </Section>
      </ScrollView>
    </AppShell>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { Pressable, Text, View, useWindowDimensions } from "react-native";
import { Link, usePathname } from "expo-router";
import { useSession } from "@/lib/session";
import { HandleBox } from "./HandleBox";
import { StandingBanner } from "./StandingBanner";
import { PopularNow } from "./PopularNow";

interface NavItem {
  label: string;
  href: string;
  /** Marks the item current on every page under this prefix, when that is wider than the href. */
  match?: string;
}

const WIDE = 1024;
const MEDIUM = 768;

/**
 * The layout from the design brief: navigation, timeline and context columns on wide screens, the
 * context column dropped on tablets, and a single column with a bottom tab bar on phones. Screens
 * render their own scrolling content inside it. The context column holds Explore's Popular now above
 * the handle box (2c design, section 11).
 */
export function AppShell({ children, floating }: { children: ReactNode; floating?: ReactNode }) {
  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();
  const { state } = useSession();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const signedIn = state.status === "signed-in";
  const handle = signedIn ? state.me.profile?.handle : undefined;
  // 3e (design, section 9.1): above every signed-in screen while /me's standing holds a measure.
  const banner = signedIn ? <StandingBanner standing={state.me.standing} /> : null;

  const items: NavItem[] = signedIn
    ? [
        { label: "Home", href: "/" },
        { label: "Bookmarks", href: "/bookmarks" },
        { label: "Profile", href: handle ? `/u/${handle}` : "/handle" },
        { label: "Settings", href: "/settings/security", match: "/settings" },
      ]
    : [
        { label: "Home", href: "/" },
        { label: "Sign in", href: "/signin" },
      ];
  const active = (item: NavItem) => (item.href === "/" ? pathname === "/" : pathname.startsWith(item.match ?? item.href));

  if (width >= MEDIUM) {
    return (
      <View className="flex-1 flex-row justify-center bg-zinc-950">
        <View className="w-56 border-r border-zinc-800 px-4 py-6">
          <Text className="mb-6 text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-zinc-50">korbat</Text>
          {items.map((item) => (
            <Link key={item.href} href={item.href} asChild>
              <Pressable aria-current={active(item) ? "page" : undefined} className="rounded-lg px-3 py-2">
                <Text className={`text-base ${active(item) ? "font-semibold text-zinc-50" : "text-zinc-300"}`}>{item.label}</Text>
              </Pressable>
            </Link>
          ))}
          {floating ? <View className="mt-6">{floating}</View> : null}
        </View>
        <View className="w-full max-w-2xl border-r border-zinc-800">
          {banner}
          {children}
        </View>
        {width >= WIDE ? (
          <View className="w-72 px-4 py-6">
            <PopularNow />
            <HandleBox />
          </View>
        ) : null}
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View className="flex-1 bg-zinc-950">
      <View className="flex-1">
        {banner}
        {children}
      </View>
      {floating ? <View className="absolute bottom-16 right-4">{floating}</View> : null}
      <View className="flex-row border-t border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950">
        {items.map((item) => (
          <Link key={item.href} href={item.href} asChild>
            <Pressable aria-current={active(item) ? "page" : undefined} className="flex-1 items-center py-3">
              <Text className={`text-sm ${active(item) ? "font-semibold text-zinc-50" : "text-zinc-400"}`}>{item.label}</Text>
            </Pressable>
          </Link>
        ))}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Pressable, Text, View } from "react-native";
import { Link } from "expo-router";
import { MEASURES, type AccountStanding, type AuthorCaseRow, type ReportItem, type ReportsPage } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { Button, ErrorText } from "@/components/ui";
import { utcMinute } from "@/lib/moderation";
import { CASES_WORDS } from "@/lib/moderation-words";
import { CASE_ROW_WORDS, rowStrike, runningMeasure, STANDING_TEXTS } from "@/lib/standing";
import { ItemLines } from "./ItemLines";

/** 3e: the kinds whose words in a row are the row's own (9.4), not the measure's label. */
const ROW_KINDS: Partial<Record<AuthorCaseRow["actions"][number], string>> = {
  overrule: CASE_ROW_WORDS.overrule,
  retire_handle: CASE_ROW_WORDS.retired,
  unretire_handle: CASE_ROW_WORDS.unretired,
  suspend: CASE_ROW_WORDS.suspended,
  lift_suspension: CASE_ROW_WORDS.lifted,
};

/**
 * What a decision did, in the measures' own labels; a decision without a measure ended what was done while deciding, or
 * took no action. A review that kept the decision is worded by its outcome first: it lifts nothing, and the restriction
 * it answered stands.
 */
function done(row: AuthorCaseRow, now: Date): string {
  if (row.kind === "review" && row.outcome === "kept") return CASES_WORDS.keptDecision;
  // 3e (design, section 9.4): a strike is named with where it stands, its overruling, a retirement and its reversal in
  // the row's own words.
  const labels: string[] = row.actions.map((kind) => (kind === "strike" && row.strike ? rowStrike(row.strike, now) : (ROW_KINDS[kind] ?? MEASURES[kind].label)));
  if (row.endedInterim) labels.push(CASES_WORDS.ended);
  return labels.length > 0 ? labels.join(", ") : CASES_WORDS.noAction;
}

/** Which kind of decision it is, where that is not plain from what it did. */
function kindWords(row: AuthorCaseRow): string | null {
  if (row.kind === "interim") return CASES_WORDS.whileDeciding;
  if (row.kind === "review") return CASES_WORDS.review;
  if (row.kind === "correction") return CASES_WORDS.correction;
  return null;
}

/**
 * "About you" (3c design, section 9): the decisions about the account that its holder was told of, newest first. Each
 * row is a link to the decision's screen and says what it is about (the post, by its creation time, or the profile), the
 * decision's day, what was done, the rule or the law, and where its appeal stands.
 */
export function DecisionsList({ decisions, now = new Date() }: { decisions: readonly AuthorCaseRow[]; now?: Date }) {
  if (decisions.length === 0) return <Text className="px-4 py-8 text-base text-zinc-400">{CASES_WORDS.noDecisions}</Text>;
  return (
    <View>
      {decisions.map((row) => {
        const kind = kindWords(row);
        return (
          <Link key={row.id} href={`/settings/cases/${row.id}`} asChild>
            <Pressable className="border-b border-zinc-800 px-4 py-3">
              <Text className="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-50">{row.post ? CASES_WORDS.post(utcMinute(row.post.createdAt)) : CASES_WORDS.profile}</Text>
              <Text className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-400">
                {CASES_WORDS.decidedOn(row.decidedOn)}
                {kind ? ` (${kind})` : ""}
              </Text>
              <Text className="mt-1 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-200">{done(row, now)}</Text>
              {row.ruleId || row.legal ? <Text className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-300">{row.ruleId ? CASES_WORDS.rule(row.ruleId) : CASES_WORDS.law}</Text> : null}
              {row.appealUntil ? <Text className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-300">{CASES_WORDS.appealOpen(utcMinute(row.appealUntil))}</Text> : null}
              {row.appeal ? <Text className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-300">{CASES_WORDS.appealState[row.appeal]}</Text> : null}
              {row.reversedOn ? <Text className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-300">{CASES_WORDS.reversed(row.reversedOn)}</Text> : null}
            </Pressable>
          </Link>
        );
      })}
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * "Your standing" (3e design, section 9.4), above "About you": how many of the account's strikes count now, and what that
 * many leads to; then (Task 3) the line of a suspension that runs, in the banner's words, from /me's standing. The lines of
 * an announced or held measure and of the reporting measures come with the tasks that build them.
 */
export function StandingBlock({ activeStrikes, standing = null }: { activeStrikes: number; standing?: AccountStanding | null }) {
  const running = runningMeasure(standing);
  return (
    <View className="border-b border-zinc-800 px-4 pb-4 pt-3">
      <Text accessibilityRole="header" aria-level={2} className="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-50">
        {STANDING_TEXTS.cases.title}
      </Text>
      <Text className="mt-1 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-200">{activeStrikes > 0 ? STANDING_TEXTS.cases.strikes(activeStrikes) : STANDING_TEXTS.cases.none}</Text>
      {running !== null && running.kind === "suspend" && running.endsAt !== null ? <Text className="mt-1 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-200">{STANDING_TEXTS.banner.running(running.endsAt)}</Text> : null}
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * "Your reports" (3c design, section 9): the account's reports with each item as the status page words it. When the
 * account's address stopped korbat's report mails (someone who holds it asked for that on a status page), the tab says so
 * above the list, with the button that resumes them: the outcomes are listed here either way. With `onReexamine` each
 * item whose answer can still be examined again carries "Ask for a re-examination", asked by the item's id.
 */
export function ReportsList({
  page,
  onResume,
  onReexamine,
  busy = false,
  error = null,
}: {
  page: Pick<ReportsPage, "reports" | "reportMailStopped">;
  onResume?: () => void;
  onReexamine?: (item: ReportItem, statement: string) => Promise<void>;
  busy?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
}) {
  return (
    <View>
      {page.reportMailStopped ? (
        <View className="border-b border-zinc-800 px-4 pb-4 pt-3">
          <Text className="text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-200">{CASES_WORDS.mailStopped}</Text>
          <Button label={CASES_WORDS.resume} onPress={() => onResume?.()} busy={busy} tone="secondary" />
          <Text className="mt-2 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-400">{CASES_WORDS.resumeHint}</Text>
          <ErrorText message={error} />
        </View>
      ) : null}
      {page.reports.length === 0 ? <Text className="px-4 py-8 text-base text-zinc-400">{CASES_WORDS.noReports}</Text> : null}
      {page.reports.map((report) => (
        <View key={report.ref} className="border-b border-zinc-800 px-4 pb-4 pt-3">
          <Text className="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-50">{CASES_WORDS.report(report.ref, utcMinute(report.receivedAt))}</Text>
          <ItemLines items={report.items} onReexamine={onReexamine} />
        </View>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Pressable, Text, View } from "react-native";
import { Link } from "expo-router";
import { Turnstile, type TurnstileInstance } from "@marsidev/react-turnstile";

/** One entry of a list of choices: a choice with its label and an optional line under it, or a line of text that stands in a choice's place. */
type ChoiceEntry<T extends string> = { value: T; label: string; hint?: string; disabled?: string } | { note: string };

/**
 * One question with its answers, of which one is chosen: a radio group, each answer a radio that says whether it is
 * checked. Every answer has the same weight on the page; a note among them is plain text and no control.
 */
function Choice<T extends string>({ label, entries, value, onChange }: { label: string; entries: ChoiceEntry<T>[]; value: T | null; onChange: (value: T) => void }) {
  return (
    <View accessibilityRole="radiogroup" aria-label={label} className="mt-6">
      <Text className="text-sm font-medium text-zinc-300">{label}</Text>
      {entries.map((entry) =>
        "note" in entry ? (
          <Text key={entry.note} className="mt-2 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-700 px-4 py-3 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-400">
            {entry.note}
          </Text>
        ) : (
          <Pressable
            key={entry.value}
            accessibilityRole="radio"
            aria-checked={value === entry.value}
            aria-disabled={entry.disabled !== undefined}
            disabled={entry.disabled !== undefined}
            onPress={() => onChange(entry.value)}
            className={`mt-2 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 ${value === entry.value ? "border-zinc-50 bg-zinc-900" : "border-zinc-700"}`}
          >
            <Text className={`text-base ${entry.disabled !== undefined ? "text-zinc-500" : value === entry.value ? "font-semibold text-zinc-50" : "text-zinc-200"}`}>{entry.label}</Text>
            {entry.hint ? <Text className="mt-1 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-400">{entry.hint}</Text> : null}
            {/* A disabled choice keeps its reason as text beside it (9.8). */}
            {entry.disabled !== undefined ? <Text className="mt-1 text-sm leading-5 text-amber-300">{entry.disabled}</Text> : null}
          </Pressable>
        ),
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

/** A statement the person may tick: a checkbox that says whether it is checked. */
function Check({ label, checked, onChange }: { label: string; checked: boolean; onChange: (checked: boolean) => void }) {
  return (
    <Pressable accessibilityRole="checkbox" aria-checked={checked} onPress={() => onChange(!checked)} className="mt-6 flex-row items-start gap-3">
      <View className={`mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded border ${checked ? "border-zinc-50 bg-zinc-50" : "border-zinc-500"}`}>
        {checked ? <Text className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-950">x</Text> : null}
      </View>
      <Text className="flex-1 text-base leading-6 text-zinc-200">{label}</Text>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

const Hint = ({ children }: { children: string }) => <Text className="mt-2 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-400">{children}</Text>;

/** The rules a report may cite, each with its title and one line; R2 is no choice: in its place stands the pointer to the anonymous path. */
function ruleEntries(withPointer: boolean): ChoiceEntry<ReportRuleId>[] {
  const reportable: readonly string[] = REPORT_RULE_IDS;
  return RULES.flatMap((rule): ChoiceEntry<ReportRuleId>[] => {
    if (reportable.includes(rule.id)) return [{ value: rule.id as ReportRuleId, label: `${rule.id}: ${rule.title}`, hint: ruleLine(rule) }];
    return withPointer ? [{ note: REPORT_WORDS.r2Instead }] : [];
  });
}

const GROUNDS: ChoiceEntry<Ground>[] = [
  { value: "rule", label: REPORT_WORDS.grounds.rule },
  { value: "illegal", label: REPORT_WORDS.grounds.illegal },
  { value: "csam", label: REPORT_WORDS.grounds.csam },
];
const CATEGORIES: ChoiceEntry<NoticeCategoryChoice>[] = [
  { value: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE", label: REPORT_WORDS.categoryNotSure },
  ...TDB_FORM_CATEGORIES.map((category) => ({ value: category, label: CATEGORY_LABELS[category] })),
];
const KEYWORDS: ChoiceEntry<CsamKeywordChoice>[] = (Object.keys(REPORT_WORDS.keywords) as CsamKeywordChoice[]).map((keyword) => ({ value: keyword, label: REPORT_WORDS.keywords[keyword] }));
/** The illegal ground's optional rule: none, or one of the rules a report may cite. */
const NO_RULE = "none";

/** What the form was opened on, as a link to it; a form opened without an item asks for its link instead. */
function GivenItem({ given }: { given: GivenTarget }) {

  return (
    <View className="mt-6">
      <Text className="text-sm font-medium text-zinc-300">{REPORT_WORDS.item}</Text>
      <Link href={href} asChild>
        <Pressable className="mt-2 self-start">
          <Text className="text-base text-sky-400 underline">{label}</Text>
        </Pressable>
      </Link>

  );
}

/**

 * shows the answer's screen once korbat took the report. `given` is the post, image or profile "Report" was pressed on,

 * `initial` is what a test starts the form with.
 */
export function ReportForm({ signedIn, given, initial, standing = null }: { signedIn: boolean; given: GivenTarget | null; initial?: Partial<ReportDraft>; standing?: AccountStanding | null }) {
  // 3e (design, section 9.6): read from /me before anything is sent. While a suspension runs, the first choice is disabled
  // with its sentence; a notice of illegality and the path for child sexual abuse material stay open.
  const running = runningMeasure(standing);
  const ruleClosed = running === null ? undefined : running.kind === "suspend" && running.endsAt !== null ? STANDING_TEXTS.report.suspended(running.endsAt) : STANDING_TEXTS.refused.terminated;
  const grounds = GROUNDS.map((entry) => ("value" in entry && entry.value === "rule" && ruleClosed !== undefined ? { ...entry, disabled: ruleClosed } : entry));
  const turnstile = useRef<TurnstileInstance | null>(null);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<ReportDraft>({ ...EMPTY_DRAFT, ...initial });
  const [token, setToken] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sent, setSent] = useState<NoticeResponse | null>(null);
  const set = (patch: Partial<ReportDraft>) => setDraft((current) => ({ ...current, ...patch }));
  const built = noticeFrom(draft, given, { signedIn, turnstileToken: token });
  const anonymous = draft.ground === "csam";

  async function send() {
    if (busy || !("request" in built)) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const answer = await moderation.send(built.request);
      setSent(answer);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(reportFailure(err, draft.ground === "csam"));

      turnstile.current?.reset();
      setToken(null);

      setBusy(false);
    }

  if (sent) return <ReportSent answer={sent} signedIn={signedIn} origin={(globalThis as { location?: { origin?: string } }).location?.origin ?? ""} />;

        </>
      ) : null}

      {draft.ground === "illegal" ? (
        <>
          <Choice label={REPORT_WORDS.category} entries={CATEGORIES} value={draft.category} onChange={(category) => set({ category })} />
          <Hint>{REPORT_WORDS.csamInstead}</Hint>
          <Field label={REPORT_WORDS.citedLaw} maxLength={NOTICE_LIMITS.citedLawMax} value={draft.citedLaw} onChangeText={(citedLaw) => set({ citedLaw })} />
          <Field label={REPORT_WORDS.whyIllegal} multiline numberOfLines={4} maxLength={NOTICE_LIMITS.explanationMax} value={draft.explanation} onChangeText={(explanation) => set({ explanation })} />
          <Choice
            label={REPORT_WORDS.alsoRule}
            entries={[{ value: NO_RULE, label: REPORT_WORDS.noRule }, ...ruleEntries(false)]}
            value={draft.ruleId ?? NO_RULE}
            onChange={(ruleId) => set({ ruleId: ruleId === NO_RULE ? null : (ruleId as ReportRuleId) })}
          />
          <Check label={REPORT_WORDS.bonaFide} checked={draft.bonaFide} onChange={(bonaFide) => set({ bonaFide })} />
          {signedIn ? null : (
            <>
              <Field label={REPORT_WORDS.name} autoComplete="name" value={draft.name} onChangeText={(name) => set({ name })} />
              <Field label={REPORT_WORDS.email} autoComplete="email" autoCapitalize="none" inputMode="email" value={draft.email} onChangeText={(email) => set({ email })} />
              <Hint>{REPORT_WORDS.contactHint}</Hint>
            </>
          )}
        </>
      ) : null}

          {profileOnly(draft, given) ? <Hint>{REPORT_WORDS.profileOnly}</Hint> : null}
          <Field label={REPORT_WORDS.csamExplanation} multiline numberOfLines={4} maxLength={NOTICE_LIMITS.explanationMax} value={draft.explanation} onChangeText={(explanation) => set({ explanation })} />
          <Check label={REPORT_WORDS.bonaFide} checked={draft.bonaFide} onChange={(bonaFide) => set({ bonaFide })} />

              <Text className="text-sm text-zinc-400 underline">{REPORT_WORDS.removeLink}</Text>

        {/* Said before anything is sent: the anonymous path's one report reaches every image of the profile it names. */}
        {tooManyProfiles(draft, given) ? <ErrorText message={REPORT_WORDS.oneProfile} /> : null}
      </View>

      <Text className="mt-8 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-400">
        {/* Who sees the sender is not said on the anonymous path, which records none. */}
        {[REPORT_WORDS.privacy.use, ...(anonymous ? [] : [REPORT_WORDS.privacy.sender]), REPORT_WORDS.privacy.access].join(" ")}
      </Text>
      {signedIn ? null : (
        <View className="mt-6">
          <Turnstile
            ref={turnstile}
            siteKey={SITE_KEY}
            options={{ theme: "dark", refreshExpired: "manual" }}
            onSuccess={setToken}
            onExpire={() => {
              setToken(null);
              turnstile.current?.reset();
            }}
            onError={() => setError(reportFailure(new ApiError(403, "human_check_failed", ""), anonymous))}
          />
          <Hint>{REPORT_WORDS.turnstile}</Hint>
        </View>
      )}

      <ErrorText message={error} />
      {/* What is still missing, in place of a button that silently does nothing; the one-profile sentence stands above already. */}
      {"problem" in built && built.problem !== REPORT_WORDS.oneProfile ? <Hint>{built.problem}</Hint> : null}
      <Button label={REPORT_WORDS.send} onPress={() => void send()} busy={busy} disabled={!("request" in built)} />
      <TextLink label="Back to korbat" href="/" replace />
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * What the form shows once korbat took the report: its reference and how to follow it. A report sent signed out, or on
 * the anonymous path, is followed with a link that is shown only now, its token in the fragment, which no server is sent;
 * a signed-in report on a rule or on the law is in the account's own list. The answer carries a token exactly in the
 * first case, so the token decides.
 */
export function ReportSent({ answer, signedIn, origin }: { answer: { ref: string; token?: string }; signedIn: boolean; origin: string }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const link = answer.token ? statusLink(origin, answer.ref, answer.token) : null;

  async function copy() {
    if (!link) return;
    const clipboard = (globalThis as { navigator?: { clipboard?: { writeText(text: string): Promise<void> } } }).navigator?.clipboard;
    try {
      await clipboard?.writeText(link);
      setCopied(clipboard !== undefined);
    } catch {
      // The browser refused the clipboard: the link stays on screen to be selected.
      setCopied(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <View>
      <Title>{REPORT_WORDS.sent}</Title>
      <Body>{REPORT_WORDS.reference(answer.ref)}</Body>
      {link ? (
        <>
          <Body>{REPORT_WORDS.keepLink}</Body>
          <Text selectable className="mt-4 rounded-lg bg-zinc-900 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-zinc-100">
            {link}
          </Text>
          <Button label={copied ? REPORT_WORDS.copied : REPORT_WORDS.copy} onPress={() => void copy()} tone="secondary" />
        </>
      ) : signedIn ? (
        <>
          <Body>{REPORT_WORDS.followInSettings}</Body>
          <TextLink label={REPORT_WORDS.yourReports} href="/settings/cases?tab=reports" />
        </>
      ) : null}
      <TextLink label="Back to korbat" href="/" replace />
    </View>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { Modal, Pressable, Text, View } from "react-native";
import { useReducedMotion } from "react-native-reanimated";
import type { PostView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { useSession } from "@/lib/session";
import { refusalSentence, runningMeasure, STANDING_TEXTS } from "@/lib/standing";
import { Composer } from "./Composer";

interface ComposeSheetProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onPosted: (post: PostView) => void;
  replyTo?: PostView;
  quoteOf?: PostView;
}

/**
 * The composer as a sheet over the current screen, for narrow layouts and for quoting from a thread.
 * The backdrop closes it but is no tab stop, so the keyboard lands on the text; a draft with content
 * is not thrown away by a stray tap: closing then asks first. The slide is skipped under reduced motion.
 */
export function ComposeSheet({ open, onClose, onPosted, replyTo, quoteOf }: ComposeSheetProps) {
  const still = useReducedMotion();
  // 3e (design, section 9.4): while /me shows a running suspension or termination, the sheet says so in place of its fields.
  const { state } = useSession();
  const standing = state.status === "signed-in" ? state.me.standing : null;
  const refused = runningMeasure(standing) !== null;
  const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false);
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);
  const close = () => {
    if (dirty) setConfirming(true);
    else onClose();
  };
  const discard = () => {
    setConfirming(false);
    setDirty(false);
    onClose();
  };
  return (
    <Modal visible={open} transparent animationType={still ? "none" : "slide"} onRequestClose={close}>
      <Pressable accessibilityLabel="Close the composer" tabIndex={-1} onPress={close} className="flex-1 justify-end bg-black/60">
        <View onStartShouldSetResponder={() => true} className="rounded-t-2xl border-t border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950 pb-6 pt-2">
          <View className="mb-1 items-center">
            <View className="h-1 w-10 rounded-full bg-zinc-700" />
          </View>
          <Text accessibilityRole="header" aria-level={2} className="px-4 text-base font-semibold text-zinc-50">
            {replyTo ? "Reply" : quoteOf ? "Quote" : "New post"}
          </Text>
          {confirming ? (
            <View role="dialog" aria-labelledby="discard-title" className="mx-4 mt-2 flex-row flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-700 px-3 py-2">
              <Text nativeID="discard-title" className="text-sm text-zinc-200">
                Discard this draft?
              </Text>
              <Pressable accessibilityRole="button" onPress={discard} className="rounded-lg bg-red-600 px-3 py-1.5">
                <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-50">Discard</Text>
              </Pressable>
              <Pressable accessibilityRole="button" onPress={() => setConfirming(false)} className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-600 px-3 py-1.5">
                <Text className="text-sm text-zinc-200">Keep writing</Text>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          ) : null}
          {refused ? (
            <View className="px-4 pt-3">
              <Text accessibilityRole="alert" className="text-base leading-6 text-zinc-200">
                {refusalSentence(standing)}
              </Text>
              <Text className="mt-2 text-sm text-zinc-400">{STANDING_TEXTS.refused.read}: Settings, Cases.</Text>
            </View>
          ) : (
          <Composer
            replyTo={replyTo}
            quoteOf={quoteOf}
            autoFocus
            onDirtyChange={setDirty}
            onCancel={close}
            onPosted={(post) => {
              setDirty(false);
              onPosted(post);
              onClose();
            }}
          />
          )}
        </View>
      </Pressable>
    </Modal>
  );
}

/** The floating action button that opens the sheet on phones. */
export function ComposeButton({ onPress }: { onPress: () => void }) {
  return (
    <Pressable accessibilityRole="button" accessibilityLabel="New post" onPress={onPress} className="h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-50 shadow-lg">
      <Text className="text-3xl leading-8 text-zinc-950">+</Text>
    </Pressable>
  );
}
```

```ts
import { Platform } from "react-native";
import { ErrorEnvelope, HealthResponse, type AuthErrorCode, type ModerationErrorCode } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { z } from "zod";

/** Same origin on web (Caddy proxies /api). Native needs an absolute URL. */
export const API_BASE = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL ?? (Platform.OS === "web" ? "" : "http://localhost:3000");

const CSRF_COOKIE = "__Host-korbat_csrf";
const DEVICE_KEY = "korbat.deviceId";

/** Browser globals, typed locally so this file does not depend on the DOM type library. */
const web = globalThis as unknown as {
  document?: { cookie: string };
  localStorage?: { getItem(key: string): string | null; setItem(key: string, value: string): void };
  crypto: { getRandomValues<T extends Uint8Array>(array: T): T };
};

let onUnauthenticated: (() => void) | null = null;
let onSuspended: (() => void) | null = null;

/**
 * 3e (design, sections 7.2 and 9.1): called when a write answers 403 account_suspended. The refusal carries no detail;
 * the session provider registers this to read /api/me again, which carries the standing fresh from the row.
 */
export function setSuspendedHandler(handler: (() => void) | null): void {
  onSuspended = handler;
}

/**
 * Called when a request outside the sign-in flow answers 401: the session ended elsewhere (signed
 * out everywhere, revoked, expired). The session provider registers it to drop the signed-in state.
 */
export function setUnauthenticatedHandler(handler: (() => void) | null): void {
  onUnauthenticated = handler;
}

/** A failed API call with the server's error code and a message fit to show the user. */
export class ApiError extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly status: number,
    readonly code: string,
    message: string,
    /** Seconds until the request may be repeated, from Retry-After: a rate limit or the handle cooldown. */
    readonly retryAfter?: number,
    /** What the server sent beside the code (1c design, section 7.1): for reauth_required the level and the factors held, for passkey_limit the bound and its wait. */
    readonly details?: unknown,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "ApiError";
  }
}

const MESSAGES: Partial<Record<AuthErrorCode | ModerationErrorCode | "account_suspended" | "unauthenticated" | "invalid_request" | "not_found" | "internal" | "network", string>> = {
  invalid_code: "That code is not valid. Check the latest email or request a new code.",
  code_expired: "That code has expired. Request a new one.",
  too_many_attempts: "Too many attempts. Start again.",
  invalid_credentials: "Email or password is incorrect.",
  mfa_required: "Turn on two-factor authentication first.",
  invalid_mfa_code: "That authentication code is not valid.",
  reauth_required: "Confirm it's you to continue.",
  csrf_failed: "This request could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.",
  turnstile_failed: "We could not verify that you are human. Try again.",
  disposable_email: "Disposable email addresses cannot be used.",
  age_requirement: "You must be at least 16 to use korbat.",
  terms_required: "Accept the current terms to continue.",
  handle_taken: "That handle is taken.",
  handle_invalid: "Handles are 3 to 20 characters: lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.",
  handle_reserved: "That handle is reserved.",
  // 3e (design, sections 9.5 and 9.8): a handle korbat retired, refused to everyone, its former holder included.
  handle_retired: "That handle was retired by korbat. Nobody can use it.",
  password_too_short: "Passwords need at least 12 characters.",
  password_too_long: "Passwords can have at most 128 characters.",
  password_breached: "That password appears in known data breaches. Choose a different one.",
  password_check_unavailable: "We could not check that password right now. Try again in a moment.",
  staff_mfa_required: "Staff accounts must keep two-factor authentication on.",
  onboarding_required: "Choose a handle to finish setting up your account.",
  mail_unavailable: "We could not send the email. Try again in a moment.",
  rate_limited: "Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.",
  handle_cooldown: "Handles can change once every 30 days.",
  email_in_use: "That email address already belongs to an account.",
  phone_in_use: "That phone number is already verified on another account.",
  badge_unavailable: "Verification is not available on this korbat.",
  verify_unavailable: "We could not reach the verification service. Try again in a moment.",
  // Passkeys (1c design, section 9). The cap's sentence; the daily bound's wait is worded by messageFor from the details.
  passkey_invalid: "That passkey did not work. Try again or use your email.",
  passkey_unsupported: "This passkey provider is not supported. Try another one.",
  passkey_limit: "You have 10 passkeys. Remove one to add another.",
  passkey_suspended: "This passkey was switched off because a copy of it may exist. Remove it and add a new one.",
  passkey_not_found: "That passkey is gone.",
  challenge_expired: "That took too long. Try again.",
  // Reports and notices (3c design, section 9): the codes a person who reports can meet. The report form words three
  // failures itself, with the users' contact address: the human check, the limits and an API that cannot take reports.
  notice_link_invalid: "That link does not name a post or a profile on korbat.",
  notice_link_offsite: "Only links to this korbat can be reported.",
  human_check_failed: "We could not verify that you are human. Try again.",
  already_reported: "You already reported this; it is being looked at.",
  staff_cannot_report: "A staff account does not send reports. Open a finding in the staff console instead.",
  notice_not_found: "We could not find a report with this link.",
  // Appeals and re-examination (3c design, section 9): one answer for every reason one is not open.
  appeal_not_open: "This decision cannot be appealed now.",
  appeal_exists: "You have already appealed this decision.",
  reexamination_not_open: "A re-examination cannot be asked for this item now.",
  reexamination_exists: "A re-examination of this item has already been asked for.",
  // 3e (design, section 9.8): the fallback when /me cannot be read; with it the screens say until when (9.4).
  account_suspended: "Your account is suspended, so you cannot do this now.",
  unauthenticated: "Sign in to continue.",
  invalid_request: "Some details are missing or invalid.",
  not_found: "That no longer exists.",
  internal: "Something went wrong on our side. Try again.",
  network: "Cannot reach korbat. Check your connection.",
};

/** The daily passkey bound as the API details it: 5 added in a day, and the seconds until the day has a slot again. */
function dailyPasskeyBound(details: unknown): number | null {
  const bound = details as { reason?: unknown; retryAfter?: unknown } | null;
  return bound && typeof bound === "object" && bound.reason === "daily" && typeof bound.retryAfter === "number" && bound.retryAfter > 0 ? bound.retryAfter : null;
}

/** The message for a code; `details` is what the server sent beside it, which turns the daily passkey bound into its wait in hours. */
export function messageFor(code: string, fallback?: string, details?: unknown): string {
  const wait = code === "passkey_limit" ? dailyPasskeyBound(details) : null;
  if (wait !== null) {
    const hours = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(wait / 3600));
    return `You added 5 passkeys today. You can add another in about ${hours === 1 ? "1 hour" : `${hours} hours`}.`;
  }
  return MESSAGES[code as keyof typeof MESSAGES] ?? fallback ?? "Something went wrong. Try again.";
}

/** The message to show for any thrown value. */
export function errorMessage(err: unknown): string {
  return err instanceof ApiError ? err.message : "Something went wrong. Try again.";
}

function readCookie(name: string): string | undefined {
  const cookies = web.document?.cookie;
  if (!cookies) return undefined;
  for (const part of cookies.split("; ")) {
    const separator = part.indexOf("=");
    if (part.slice(0, separator) === name) return decodeURIComponent(part.slice(separator + 1));
  }
  return undefined;
}

const BASE64URL = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_";

/** 32 random bytes as unpadded base64url (43 characters). */
function randomDeviceId(): string {
  const bytes = web.crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(33));
  let out = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 3) {
    const n = (bytes[i]! << 16) | (bytes[i + 1]! << 8) | bytes[i + 2]!;
    out += BASE64URL[(n >> 18) & 63]! + BASE64URL[(n >> 12) & 63]! + BASE64URL[(n >> 6) & 63]! + BASE64URL[n & 63]!;
  }
  return out.slice(0, 43);
}

/** A random id created once per browser. The server stores only a keyed hash of it. */
export function deviceId(): string {
  try {
    const existing = web.localStorage?.getItem(DEVICE_KEY);
    if (existing && /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{22,64}$/.test(existing)) return existing;
    const created = randomDeviceId();
    web.localStorage?.setItem(DEVICE_KEY, created);
    return created;
  } catch {
    return randomDeviceId();
  }
}

export const platform: "web" | "ios" | "android" = Platform.OS === "ios" || Platform.OS === "android" ? Platform.OS : "web";

interface RequestOptions<T> {
  method?: "GET" | "POST" | "PATCH" | "DELETE";
  json?: unknown;
  /** A raw body sent as it is, with its declared type: how an image is uploaded. */
  raw?: { type: string; body: Blob };
  /** Schema for a JSON response body. Omit for 204 responses. */
  schema?: z.ZodType<T>;
}

/**
 * Calls the API with the session cookie and answers with the raw response, for a body that is not
 * JSON (the account export's ZIP). State-changing requests echo the CSRF cookie in X-CSRF-Token; the
 * session cookie itself is HttpOnly and never readable here. A failed call throws an ApiError.
 */
export async function apiResponse(path: string, options: Omit<RequestOptions<unknown>, "schema"> = {}): Promise<Response> {
  const method = options.method ?? (options.json === undefined && options.raw === undefined ? "GET" : "POST");
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
  if (options.json !== undefined) headers["content-type"] = "application/json";
  if (options.raw) headers["content-type"] = options.raw.type;
  if (method !== "GET") {
    const csrf = readCookie(CSRF_COOKIE);
    if (csrf) headers["x-csrf-token"] = csrf;
  }

  let res: Response;
  try {
    res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, {
      method,
      headers,
      credentials: "include",
      body: options.raw ? options.raw.body : options.json === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(options.json),
    });
  } catch {
    throw new ApiError(0, "network", messageFor("network"));
  }

  if (!res.ok) {
    if (res.status === 401 && !path.startsWith("/api/auth/") && path !== "/api/me") onUnauthenticated?.();
    const parsed = ErrorEnvelope.safeParse(await res.json().catch(() => null));
    const code = parsed.success ? parsed.data.error.code : "internal";
    const details = parsed.success ? parsed.data.error.details : undefined;
    // 3e: a write refused for a running suspension: /me is read again, so the screens say until when.
    if (res.status === 403 && code === "account_suspended") onSuspended?.();
    // The server's message is written for people and can be more specific than the generic text for
    // its code ("Two-factor setup expired. Start again."). Only validation and internal errors use
    // the local wording, because their server messages are technical, and the passkey bounds do, so
    // the daily bound's wait is worded here from the details.
    const local = code === "invalid_request" || code === "internal" || code === "passkey_limit" || !parsed.success;
    // Retry-After is whole seconds: on a rate limit, and on the handle cooldown, where it says when the next change is allowed.
    const retryAfter = Number(res.headers.get("retry-after"));
    throw new ApiError(res.status, code, local ? messageFor(code, undefined, details) : parsed.data.error.message, Number.isFinite(retryAfter) && retryAfter > 0 ? retryAfter : undefined, details);
  }
  return res;
}

/** Calls the API as `apiResponse` does and parses the JSON answer with `schema`; omit it for a 204 response. */
export async function api<T = void>(path: string, options: RequestOptions<T> = {}): Promise<T> {
  const res = await apiResponse(path, options);
  if (!options.schema) return undefined as T;
  return options.schema.parse(await res.json());
}

export async function fetchHealth(): Promise<HealthResponse> {
  return api("/api/health", { schema: HealthResponse });
}
```

```tsx
import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { AppState, Pressable, Text, View } from "react-native";
import { MeResponse } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { api, ApiError, errorMessage, setSuspendedHandler, setUnauthenticatedHandler } from "./api";

type SessionState =
  | { status: "loading" }
  | { status: "signed-out" }
  | { status: "signed-in"; me: MeResponse };

interface SessionValue {
  state: SessionState;
  /** Reloads /api/me, for example after sign-in, onboarding or sign-out. */
  refresh(): Promise<SessionState>;
}

const SessionContext = createContext<SessionValue | null>(null);

async function loadSession(): Promise<SessionState> {
  try {
    return { status: "signed-in", me: await api("/api/me", { schema: MeResponse }) };
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof ApiError && err.status === 401) return { status: "signed-out" };
    throw err;
  }
}

/**
 * Only a 401 means signed out. Any other failure to load the session (no network, a 5xx, a limit)
 * is shown as such with a retry, instead of sending someone with a valid cookie back through sign-in.
 */
function SessionFailure({ message, onRetry }: { message: string; onRetry: () => void }) {
  return (
    <View className="flex-1 items-center justify-center bg-zinc-950 px-6">
      <Text accessibilityRole="alert" className="text-center text-base text-zinc-200">
        {message}
      </Text>
      <Pressable accessibilityRole="button" onPress={onRetry} className="mt-6 rounded-lg bg-zinc-50 px-4 py-3">
        <Text className="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-950">Try again</Text>
      </Pressable>
    </View>
  );
}

export function SessionProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [state, setState] = useState<SessionState>({ status: "loading" });
  const [failure, setFailure] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    setFailure(null);
    try {
      const next = await loadSession();
      setState(next);
      return next;
    } catch (err) {
      setFailure(errorMessage(err));
      return { status: "loading" } as const;
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void refresh();
  }, [refresh]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setUnauthenticatedHandler(() => setState((current) => (current.status === "signed-in" ? { status: "signed-out" } : current)));
    return () => setUnauthenticatedHandler(null);
  }, []);

  // 3e (design, section 9.1): /me again when the app gains focus and after a refusal account_suspended, so the banner and
  // a refusal's sentence are true of the row. Quietly: a read that fails keeps what is shown, and never the failure screen.
  useEffect(() => {
    const quiet = () => {
      loadSession()
        .then(setState)
        .catch(() => undefined);
    };
    setSuspendedHandler(quiet);
    const focus = AppState.addEventListener("change", (next) => {
      if (next === "active") quiet();
    });
    return () => {
      setSuspendedHandler(null);
      focus.remove();
    };
  }, []);

  const value = useMemo(() => ({ state, refresh }), [state, refresh]);
  return <SessionContext.Provider value={value}>{failure ? <SessionFailure message={failure} onRetry={() => void refresh()} /> : children}</SessionContext.Provider>;
}

export function useSession(): SessionValue {
  const value = useContext(SessionContext);
  if (!value) throw new Error("useSession must be used inside SessionProvider");
  return value;
}
```

```ts
import { STANDING_RULES, type AccountStanding, type AuthorCaseRow, type DecisionStrike } from "@korbat/contracts";

/**
 * The app's sentences about an account's standing (3e design, section 9), one table with the design's keys in brackets.
 * Every number in a sentence is printed from STANDING_RULES, never typed. Task 1 of 3e builds the strike's: the block
 * "Your standing" on Cases, the strike on its decision's screen, a case row's words for a strike and its overruling, and
 * the chip of a removed post whose strike counts. The other measures' sentences come with the tasks that build them.
 */

const MONTHS = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"] as const;
const two = (n: number): string => String(n).padStart(2, "0");

/** A day on the device's own calendar: "16 Oct 2026". */
export function standingDay(at: string): string {
  const d = new Date(at);
  return `${d.getDate()} ${MONTHS[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getFullYear()}`;
}

/**
 * A time as the app prints a measure's (section 9): the device's local date and time, then the UTC time in brackets, so
 * that the screen and korbat's mails name the same minute: "16 Oct 2026, 16:05 (14:05 UTC)".
 */
export function standingTime(at: string): string {
  const d = new Date(at);
  return `${standingDay(at)}, ${two(d.getHours())}:${two(d.getMinutes())} (${two(d.getUTCHours())}:${two(d.getUTCMinutes())} UTC)`;
}

export const STANDING_TEXTS = {
  /** 9.4: the block above "About you". */
  cases: {
    title: "Your standing",
    /** [cases.strikes] */
    strikes: (n: number) =>
      `Active strikes: ${n} of ${STANDING_RULES.ladderStrikes}. At ${STANDING_RULES.ladderStrikes}, a moderator may announce a suspension; you would be told first and could reply.`,
    /** [cases.none] */
    none: "You have no active strikes.",
  },
  /** 9.2: a strike, on its post decision's screen. */
  strike: {
    /** [strike.counts] */
    counts: (endsAt: string) => `Strike: counts until ${standingTime(endsAt)}.`,
    /** [strike.expired] */
    expired: (endsAt: string) => `Strike: no longer counts since ${standingTime(endsAt)}.`,
    /** [strike.overruled] */
    overruled: (at: string) => `Strike: overruled on ${standingDay(at)}.`,
  },
  /** 9.4: the chip of a removed post while its strike stands and counts: "Removed: R3, strike until 10 Jan 2027". */
  chip: (chip: string, strikeUntil: string) => `${chip}, strike until ${standingDay(strikeUntil)}`,
  /** 9.5: Settings, Profile, the handle. */
  handle: {
    /**
     * [handle.retired], while the profile holds a placeholder. Task 3 adds [handle.retired.suspended] and the refusals that
     * replace the form, which read /me's standing.
     */
    retired: "korbat retired your handle; the decision is under Settings, Cases. Choose a new one: the 30-day wait does not apply this time.",
    /** The standing sentence above the form. */
    standing: (current: string) => `Your handle is @${current}. You can change it once every 30 days. Handles you used before stay yours, except one that korbat retired.`,
    /** [handle.retired.suspended] (Task 3), while /me carries a running suspension: the form waits for its end. */
    retiredSuspended: "korbat retired your handle; the decision is under Settings, Cases. You can choose a new one when your suspension ends: the 30-day wait will not apply.",
  },
  /** 9.1: the banner above every signed-in screen while /me carries a standing measure. Task 3 builds its running suspension. */
  banner: {
    /** The region's label. */
    label: "Your account's standing",
    /** [banner.running] */
    running: (endsAt: string) =>
      `Your account is suspended until ${standingTime(endsAt)}. You can read, reply to korbat, appeal, export your data and delete your account. You cannot post, like, repost, bookmark, follow, edit your profile, upload images or report under korbat's rules.`,
    read: "Read the decision",
    appeal: "Appeal",
    export: "Export my data",
    delete: "Delete account",
  },
  /** 9.4: a write refused account_suspended, worded from /me's standing read after the refusal. */
  refused: {
    /** [refused.suspended] */
    suspended: (endsAt: string) => `Your account is suspended until ${standingTime(endsAt)}, so you cannot do this now.`,
    /** [refused.terminated] */
    terminated: "korbat has terminated your account, so you cannot do this.",
    /** [refused.over], when /me then shows no running measure. */
    over: "The suspension has just ended. Try again.",
    /** The link beside the sentence. */
    read: "Read the decision",
  },
  /** 9.6: the report form while the account is suspended: the rule choice is disabled. */
  report: {
    /** [report.suspended] */
    suspended: (endsAt: string) =>
      `Your account is suspended until ${standingTime(endsAt)}, so it cannot report under korbat's rules. You can still report illegal content: choose "It is illegal". For the sexual abuse or exploitation of a child, choose the third answer.`,
  },
} as const;

/** The measure of /me's standing that runs now (a suspension or a termination), or null: what the banner, the refusals and the forms read. */
export function runningMeasure(standing: AccountStanding | null | undefined): NonNullable<AccountStanding["measure"]> | null {
  const measure = standing?.measure ?? null;
  return measure !== null && measure.state === "running" ? measure : null;
}

/**
 * The sentence a refused write shows (9.4), from /me's standing read after the refusal: a running suspension's end, a
 * termination, or, when /me then shows nothing running, that the suspension has just ended.
 */
export function refusalSentence(standing: AccountStanding | null | undefined): string {
  const running = runningMeasure(standing);
  if (running === null) return STANDING_TEXTS.refused.over;
  if (running.kind === "terminate" || running.endsAt === null) return STANDING_TEXTS.refused.terminated;
  return STANDING_TEXTS.refused.suspended(running.endsAt);
}

/** 9.4: what a row of "About you" says of a strike and of its overruling (CASE_ROW_WORDS). */
export const CASE_ROW_WORDS = {
  strike: "a strike",
  counts: (endsAt: string) => `counts until ${standingDay(endsAt)}`,
  expired: "no longer counts",
  overruled: "overruled",
  overrule: "strike overruled",
  /** A decision that retired the account's handle, and one that gave it back. */
  retired: "your handle retired",
  unretired: "handle given back",
  /** Task 3: a suspension (its days and whether it was announced come with Task 4's row members), and its lift. */
  suspended: "a suspension",
  lifted: "suspension lifted",
} as const;

/** The sentence of a decision's strike on its screen. */
export function strikeLine(strike: DecisionStrike): string {
  if (strike.state === "overruled") return STANDING_TEXTS.strike.overruled(strike.overruledAt ?? strike.countsUntil);
  return strike.state === "expired" ? STANDING_TEXTS.strike.expired(strike.countsUntil) : STANDING_TEXTS.strike.counts(strike.countsUntil);
}

/** What a row says of the strike its decision gave, after the post measure: "a strike (counts until 10 Jan 2027)". */
export function rowStrike(strike: NonNullable<AuthorCaseRow["strike"]>, now: Date): string {
  const where = strike.overruledAt !== null ? CASE_ROW_WORDS.overruled : Date.parse(strike.countsUntil) <= now.getTime() ? CASE_ROW_WORDS.expired : CASE_ROW_WORDS.counts(strike.countsUntil);
  return `${CASE_ROW_WORDS.strike} (${where})`;
}
```

```ts
  "handle_cooldown",
  "email_in_use",
  "phone_in_use",
  "badge_unavailable",

  "passkey_not_found",

  // 3e (design, section 10.5): a handle korbat retired, refused to everyone, its former holder included; the social
  // module's handle change answers it too.
  "handle_retired",
]);
export type AuthErrorCode = z.infer<typeof AuthErrorCode>;

export const Platform = z.enum(["web", "ios", "android"]);
export type Platform = z.infer<typeof Platform>;

export const Role = z.enum(["user", "moderator", "admin"]);
export type Role = z.infer<typeof Role>;

/** Random id created once per app install. The server stores only a keyed hash of it. */
export const DeviceId = z.string().regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{22,64}$/);
/** 32 random bytes as base64url without padding: flow ids, MFA tickets, single-use link tokens. */
export const OpaqueId = z.string().regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/);
export const Email = z.string().trim().toLowerCase().max(254).pipe(z.email());
export const EmailCode = z.string().regex(/^\d{6}$/);
export const TotpCode = z.string().regex(/^\d{6}$/);
/**
 * A phone number in E.164 once the spaces, hyphens and parentheses people type are dropped: a plus and
 * 7 to 15 digits, the first not zero. Whether the number exists is the verification provider's call.
 */
export const Phone = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .max(64)
  .transform((raw) => raw.replace(/[\s()-]/g, ""))
  .pipe(z.string().regex(/^\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$/, "phone numbers are written like +447911123456"));
/** The six-digit code the verification provider texts to a phone; the development provider's is 000000. */
export const PhoneCode = z.string().regex(/^\d{6}$/);
export const RecoveryCode = z
  .string()

  .toLowerCase()
  .regex(/^[a-z2-7]{4}-[a-z2-7]{4}-[a-z2-7]{4}$/);
/**
 * The prefix of a retired handle's placeholder (3e design, sections 6.2 and 10.1): the placeholder is the prefix and 12
 * lower-case hex digits made from the retirement's id, 20 characters, so it is a valid handle that every reader of a handle
 * reads unchanged. The handle rule reserves the whole prefix, so nobody can choose one, and a trigger refuses it to every
 * role but the migrator.
 */
export const RETIRED_HANDLE_PREFIX = "retired_";

/** Whether a handle has a placeholder's form: the prefix and exactly 12 lower-case hex digits. */
export function isRetiredPlaceholder(handle: string): boolean {
  if (!handle.startsWith(RETIRED_HANDLE_PREFIX)) return false;
  const digits = handle.slice(RETIRED_HANDLE_PREFIX.length);
  return digits.length === 12 && [...digits].every((digit) => "0123456789abcdef".includes(digit));
}

/** Handle rules (3-20 of a-z, 0-9, _; reserved names) are enforced by the flow so it can return a specific error code. */
export const HandleInput = z.string().trim().toLowerCase().min(1).max(64);
export const DisplayName = z
  .string()
```
